While working in a convenience store, she ends up befriending Miyabi Enaga, an aloof girl shunned because his father once killed a person. Based on a novel by Ayano Takeda, the author of Sound! Euphonium.
title: Love Doesn't Matter to Me

overview: A Jaipur tour guide's romance with an NRI unravels when a fellow tourist goes missing. As suspicion mounts, he vanishes-sparking a nationwide hunt that leads to one of modern India's most shocking crime twists.
title: Murderbaad

overview: After finding out that their father left a huge sum of money behind after his death, Mariam and Noura come up with an elaborate scheme to abscond with the money before their brother — who is legally entitled to half the inheritance — finds out about their father’s death.
title: Thank You for Banking with Us

overview: Abang Joe, a motorsport center owner, hired a young man named Rudy who had been jailed for his involvement in illegal racing activities. Rudy began carrying out his duties in the arena with determination to improve himself and feels that this is his chance to gain as much knowledge as possible if he wants to become a legal car racer and drifter. However, this journey will bring challenges and heartache as he encounters both new friends and foes.
title: Impak Maksima 2

overview: While backpacking in the deep woods, a women’s bereavement support group discovers a teen girl being held captive in a cabin. Now they must band together to save her from her survivalist abductors.
title: Little Girl in the Woods

overview: An ageing Kaalidhar escapes his family after overhearing their plans to abandon him. He meets the free-spirited Ballu, and they embark on an adventure to tick things off Kaalidhar's bucket list.
title: Kaalidhar Laapata

overview: A vlogging couple chasing online popularity, desperately go to great lengths and does things to remain in the limelight as the “trending” pair, and their relationship begins to deteriorate.
tagline: How far would you go?
title: Trending

overview: A photographer receives a tip that could finally shed some light on her childhood UFO sighting. But a deadly heat wave and unexpected guests threaten to derail her obsessive search for answers.
tagline: Venture out of your world.
title: Star People

overview: Two mothers, disillusioned by failed marriages, team up to orchestrate a master plan to unite their freshman kids, Chandru and Madhu. But things get muddied when their Gen Z kids have other plans, leading to a clash of wills and generational divide.
title: Bun Butter Jam

overview: The Life of Mirrors is one of the sections of the exhibition Luis Miguel Cintra - Small Theatre of the World. A commission by Serralves Foundation to Regina Guimarães and Saguenail, and constructed after an unpublished interview with Luis Miguel Cintra, this film is the result of a long and painstaking exercise of selecting and editing excerpts from films by Manoel de Oliveira in which Cintra participates as an actor. In this way, The Life of Mirrors is a reflective, retrospective essay film, which opens the Carte Blanche, thus establishing a gateway to Luis Miguel Cintra's cinematographic and cinephile career.
title: The Life of Mirrors

overview: Featuring unheard songs and exclusive archive footage, The Essence of Eva is a portrait of legendary singer Eva Cassidy from the perspective of her parents, family and friends.
title: The Essence of Eva

original_title: Simple Plan: The Kids in the Crowd
overview: A captivating and nostalgic look at one of the most popular pop-punk bands of the 2000s. Packed with never-before-seen archival footage and exclusive access to their sold-out 2024 World Tour, the members of Simple Plan and a cast of punk-rock superstars recount the highs and lows of the first 25 years of their career. Stage-dive into a story of brotherhood, fans and resilience.
title: Simple Plan: The Kids in the Crowd

overview: Shari Lewis was a dancer, singer, and magician but is best known as the ventriloquist behind sock puppets Charlie Horse, Hush Puppy and, of course, Lamb Chop. This lively doc charts the life, loves, and career hits and misses of this spunky perfectionist, who forever changed the face of children’s television.
title: Shari & Lamb Chop

overview: A young couple from the US, struggling with their marriage, decides to move to Mexico. As liberal artists, they seek inspiration and freedom in a new country ready to be discovered. But the reality is far from what they are imagining.
title: Good Savage

overview: Sophia and baby daughter, Emily, are forced to go into witness protection after she has to testify against her ex-husband Mason for his crimes. After years of living a seemingly normal life with new friends and relationships, Sophia learns that Mason has escaped from his maximum security prison. Knowing his strength and connections, Sophia is forced to reveal the truth to her now teenage daughter about who her father really is – and having to leave everything behind. Escaping to an old remote cabin in the woods together, Sophia and Emily must do everything it takes to survive Mason and his ruthless intent to make the family whole again.
title: Before Your Father Finds Us

overview: After years of toxic relationship with Joachim, Laura is raising their daughter on her own. Joachim's new partner, Shirine, shows up at Laura's door in trouble. Laura realizes that they are both under the same harmful influence. The two women try to help each other find a path out of the toxic relationship.
title: No Way Back

overview: Gevi is a Tamil Survival Thriller Film That Follows Mandharai and Malaiyan's Struggle for Justice in a Rural Village Near Kodaikanal. The Film Explores Themes of Love, Survival, and Bureaucratic Apathy, Highlighting the Community's Fight Against Corruption and Adversity. A Powerful Story of Hope and Resilience
title: Gevi

overview: Eunjin, who has a spinal cord disability, finds out that she is pregnant. After much thought with her husband, Hoseon, she decides to give birth. Eunjin is hospitalized due to a fever and meets Jihoo, who is also pregnant and bonds with her. Eunjin gets courage from Jihoo whenever she is frustrated, and endure the pregnancy, but as she is about to give birth, discovers Jihoo’s true identity.
title: Between the Two of Us

overview: Set against the sweeping backdrop of China’s Inner Mongolian grasslands in the early 1990s, Impossible to Escape is a visceral crime-action thriller that pits relentless justice against ruthless lawlessness. Directed by Feng Baoning, the film follows veteran detective Zhang Xiao (played by Su Xin), a seasoned officer leading a task force to dismantle the brutal criminal empire of Guan Xiongfei (Du Yiheng), a merciless gangster terrorizing the region with audacious heists and savage violence.
title: No Escape

original_title: Urban Legend Sumiati: Teror Angkot Makassar
title: Urban Legend Sumiati: Teror Angkot Makassar

overview: A life-long alien abductee figures out a clever way to record his alien encounters using a micro camera, and shares high-res video of telepathic beings, human hybrids and more.
tagline: I've been recording my own alien abductions.
title: The Alien Report

overview: An exchange of strawberries and a used household appliance turns into a nightmare for Sun-kyung when her partner turns up dead. Now she must follow the trail of a disturbing stranger.
title: The Woman

overview: Across 29 shows in 22 cities around the world, SEVENTEEN's [BE THE SUN] tour was the moment SEVENTEEN became the sun, shining as one with CARAT! Relive the electrifying start in Seoul, and feel the heat once more in cinemas from July 10-13, 2025, as part of HYBE Cine Fest in Asia!
title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR [BE THE SUN]

overview: Visionary composer and performer Meredith Monk overcame hostile critics to become one of the great artists of her time. In her seventh decade of creativity, she ponders how such singular work can continue without her.
tagline: "She among all of us was--and still is--the uniquely gifted one." -Phillip Glass
title: Monk in Pieces

overview: The Story revolves around Christo Xavier, a circle inspector, who mentors 11th-class students in his spare time and turns his station into a community place to benefit the kids of the town. As his regular work and tutoring go on, one day he finds a suspicious electronic device from a student’s fair exhibit model.
title: Soothravakyam

overview: Frankenscience and religious ideology reanimate a cohort of recently deceased fetishists to create the perfectly subservient woman only to unleash hell on the patriarchy.
tagline: They rose from the dead with one thing in mind...
title: Frankenbabes from Beyond the Grave!

overview: A lone survivor of the Mortuus Strain outbreak scavenges his new reality, narrowly escaping the infected casualties still walking the earth.
tagline: The undead returns... for 10 nail-biting minutes!
title: The Stillness

overview: The clock is ticking for Kai. His psychotic brother has just been granted an early release from prison and by this afternoon, he'll come around to collect the money Kai has been holding for him. The problem - all the money's been spent.
title: Fresh

overview: Marseille, the holidays. Omar, 20, oversees the children summer camp with his longtime friends. The adolescents are full of dreams, principles, and prejudices. When Carmen returns after years being away, the group dynamic is put to the test. In a group where reputation is everything, the electric and free spirit Carmen triggers everyone to question his own belief, desire, and sexuality.
title: The Girls We Want

overview: The Arrogant District Judge Venkitesh Balaji and his naive Personal Security Officer Jyothi Kuttan are abducted and held hostage by a Maoist Group demanding release of their leader in prison. As both men face the impending death, their hierarchy equations change and it becomes a fight for survival.
title: Flask

overview: A young South Boston realtor decides to sell the family home, against the wishes of his townie uncle. But after making a gruesome discovery, the two have to get rid of the problem before developers come.
tagline: A Southie Crime Story
title: Mulvahill

overview: Sera glances into the silhouette of 'The one who died standing on the brick wall.' Detectives are tongue-in-cheek, calling it a bizarre case, and Pil-joong, who works in the film industry together, spreads trivial rumors and adds that he doesn't know why he committed suicide unfairly. Sera asks "Would it have been less unfair if you killed at least one person?" unravels the inner side of a character full of resentment, anger, and 'han' in a black comedy way.
title: The Happy Ending for Sera

overview: A cop ventures into a remote village to investigate a gruesome series of inexplicable events and soon finds himself in the center of an otherworldly storm of local witchcraft and death. It becomes clear that the curse of Albasty, a spirit said to devour infants, is horrifyingly real. Produced as an anthology series, first three episodes premiering at Fantasia Film Festival as a feature film.
title: Kazakh Scary Tales

overview: In a coastal Florida town threatened by an impending hurricane, locals prepare for a mandatory evacuation. As the last tourists depart and residents board up their homes, a few wanderers choose to remain.
title: No Sleep Till

overview: Shuji has been suffering from insomnia since he became unemployed. Hoping to receive a reward of 100,000 yen, he starts a search for a missing woman named Midori.
tagline: Where does it lead?
title: Rope

overview: Stripped of purpose and poisoned by corporate evil, the Toxic Avenger is turned against Tromaville. Now, in this definitive cut of Parts II and III, he must confront the monster he's become before his town and soul are lost forever.
tagline: Fighting crime doesn’t pay. Selling out does.
title: Mr. Melvin

overview: Tiffany, an ASL teacher with a tragic past, takes on new student Amy and sparks a romance with the teen’s father. But when her life is threatened, she realizes her past has come back to haunt her.
title: What Hides in Silence

overview: When two brothers attempt to honour their father's dying wish, their actions cause widespread chaos.
title: Apoorva Puthranmar

overview: Bad Sister  Min-woo and Su-mi became siblings through their parents’ remarriage. Su-mi is still secretly in love with her older brother Min-woo, while Min-woo can’t set a wedding date with his live-in girlfriend because of his sister.  Daytime Dream  On a hot day, Gye-hyung pulls over his car to take a nap and ends up dreaming about swapping partners with his girlfriend’s junior couple.  Secret Sex  Thanks to his wife’s financial stability, Sang-hoon gets to manage a building. Behind his wife’s back, he has an affair with her older sister.  A Friend’s Favor  So-yeon asks her friend Jung-hee for a favor so she can meet again with a man she had a blind date with.
title: Taste of Younger Sister

overview: Summer holidays. Sardinia, Italy. A family (road) trip. Claudine, soon to be 11 y.o., decides to tell the story of their adventures as they go along. When Raoul, her 3-y.o. brother, doesn't bother her...
title: L'Aventura

original_title: Marius et les Gardiens de la Cité Phocéenne
overview: As a group of kids, whose families have been kicked out of their Marseille neighborhood, are about to leave forever, and just as they're about to pack up their dreams they find a mysterious box containing clues to a hidden treasure. Hoping to save their homes, they seek the help of Marius, the so-called "King of Marseille"?
title: Marius & The Treasure Hunters

overview: Opposites attract when a social-media addicted musician meets a free spirited activist at her gig.
title: Magic

overview: Sarah, a young girl living in the dark shadow of her past, could never forget the tragedy that struck when she was in middle school—her mother died in a motorcycle accident. Since then, guilt had haunted her every step, trapping her in endless regret. Hoping to atone for her perceived sins, Sarah repeatedly tried to find ways to communicate with her mother’s spirit, but all her attempts ended in failure. One day, however, a mysterious man—also a student at the same university—offered her a secret method said to allow her to meet her mother in another realm. Without hesitation, Sarah followed the instructions. But from that moment on, her life turned into a nightmare. Supernatural terrors began to haunt her days, pulling Sarah into a vortex of mystery far darker and more dangerous than anything she had ever imagined.
title: Hotel Sakura

overview: Grace has nowhere to turn when she finds herself lost in the wilderness with a dark presence threatening to consume her in this twisted folk horror.
tagline: Evil roams this land.
title: The Banished

overview: In a peaceful village full of joy, laughter, and vibrant life, everything seems perfect—until one day, the devil arrives. What follows is a hilarious chain of events that flips the entire village upside down!
title: Su from So

overview: An Indian immigrant awakens inside a confined metal box, with the walls slowly closing in... unless he can do the work assigned to him.
tagline: Work is the rent you pay for the room you occupy on Earth.
title: Indian in a Box

overview: Melrick is an unruly young boy who spends his summer in French Guiana at his grandmother's house to escape his turbulent daily life in Stains, France. At the end of his stay, he plays the drum to revive the memory of his late uncle, Lucas Diomar, who died in tragic circumstances. Despite a wave of murders of young men shaking the headlines, Melrick becomes aware of his place in a family destroyed by irreparable grief.
title: Listen to the Voices

overview: Set in a high school in Nishi-Izu slated to close next spring, the story follows members of the school’s broadcasting club as they face their “final summer.” It quietly captures their everyday moments as they try to leave something behind—an imprint of youth, memory, and time.  Originally composed as the main theme for Kikujiro (1999), Joe Hisaishi’s timeless piece “Summer” has long been cherished in Japan as the soundtrack of nostalgic summer memories. Now, this beloved masterpiece is reimagined as a short film.
title: Summer

overview: A Neukölln clan boss becomes a climate activist. A gender doll inventor who fulfills her most secret wishes with a fake gun and a new girlfriend in Grunewald. A balcony beekeeper whose bee colony is on speed. And in the middle of it all, a fisherman who wants to conjure up sustainable snacks from invasive swamp crabs. What unites them all? A hot summer in the capital - and waiting for the rain!
title: #BlackSheep

overview: Apip, a teenage cinephile, is forced to go to school in an Islamic boarding school by his mother for being "too free." In his final year, he discovers a golden opportunity: a national short film competition. But rigid school rules stand in his way, forcing Apip to choose between his passion and institutional demands.
title: Boarding

overview: Start your engines! Because we're racing as part of the Disneyland® Resort 70th Celebration! Take a scenic and high-speed ride through Radiator Springs Racers in this immersive Point of View adventure. Tour Ornament Valley and arrive in Radiator Springs, the cutest little town in Carburetor County! From the roar of the engines to the charming Cadillac Range mountains, this Cars Land attraction has the perfect blend of heart and horsepower. Every twist, turn, and rev of the engine will have you experiencing the joy of seven decades of Disney imagination and innovative storytelling at top speed!
tagline: Prep for the big race with this Point of View adventure though Radiator Springs Racers!
title: Radiator Springs Racers | Disneyland Resort

overview: When Dylan is accused of killing his bully Sawyer, mom Courtenay is devastated, and she starts to wonder - could her son be capable of murder?
title: Taste of His Own Poison

overview: Sam, a new father with undiagnosed neurodivergence, faces a bureaucratic nightmare after a mix-up leads to his arrest, separating him from his family. With humor and heart, BitterSweet tackles toxic masculinity, parenthood, and injustice.
title: BitterSweet

overview: A young Syrian refugee living in the UK without his parents decides to build a boat and sail home to find them.
title: Largo

original_title: スターダム サッポロワールドランデブー 2025
overview: Sapporo Rendezvous 2025 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on July 21, 2025, at Chateraise Gateaux Kingdom Sapporo in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan.
title: Stardom Sapporo Rendezvous 2025

overview: A college documentary project goes awry when a group of film students stumble on a strange, wooded homeless community, and slowly discover they’re the ones being watched.
tagline: Don't Stop Recording
title: Night Shoot

overview: After the death of their birth mother, two young children are placed in the care of prospective adopter parents, however, it's not long before the new family begin to question if something more sinister is at play.
title: I'll Play Mother

overview: A violent gunslinger sees visions of Hell and decides that in order to redeem himself he'll give his ill-gotten loot to save a beautiful nun's orphanage. But when he is ambushed and left for dead, he sets out on a trail of vengeance.
tagline: In this town no one rests in peace.
title: Bury 'Em Deep

original_title: Autism and the Arts: Poetry with Peter Street
overview: Born in 1948, Peter Street struggled at school with epilepsy and illiteracy in Bolton, Lancashire, and, later in life, as a slaughterman, a gravedigger and a war poet. At 66 years old he was then diagnosed with autism, and his world changed forever.
tagline: Slaughterman. Gravedigger. War Poet.
title: Autism and the Arts: Poetry with Peter Street

overview: The FBI is called to a lake in Texas to investigate shark attacks.
title: Lone Star Shark 3

overview: Known for his laid-back Southern charm and razor-sharp wit, Slay is back following his successful 2024 debut Workin’ Man. If you love storytelling with a hilarious twist and a splash of retro flair, this one’s a must-watch.
title: Dusty Slay: Wet Heat

overview: London, 1846: successful barber, Sweeney Todd, has for years been haunted by the loss of his parents at the hands of a cruel Judge. One fateful night, his path crosses with local baker, Mrs. Lovett, a woman who too has suffered a devastating miscarriage of justice by the same judge and his corrupt associates. Scheming to put a deadly end to the cycle of abuse and exploitation, Todd and Lovett make a pact, and it is her that leads the charge in seeking a bloody revenge, in the most macabre of ways.
tagline: Revenge is a cut-throat business.
title: Sweeney Todd: Slice & Dice

overview: A sweet suburban couple is terrorized by a deranged teenager and his friends after they purchase his grandfather's sacred home.
title: Get Off My Lawn

overview: A man and woman, now living apart, reunite after a long time. They sit on a bench in the shade of the trees and talk. The man speaks in a tone like he's talking to himself, about strange dreams he's been having often lately. "In some of them, I'm an animal,  a plant, a tree, and a human." Even though it's a dream, it feels vividly real, as if he's become that thing. “Yeah, that's what it is... a previous life.”
tagline: A previous life.
title: Yorushika LIVE 2024 [ZENSE]

overview: Anat, a single mother and a devoted literature primary school teacher, is impatiently waiting for her son’s discharge from the army. But exactly on the due date of his release, a soldier is kidnapped and a new war breaks out. The condition of her shell-shocked father, Ya'akov, starts to deteriorate as Ido calls to say that all discharges have been put on hold. The angst-ridden Anat tries to get him back home, appealing to the kindness of the commanding officers. Ido returns, but her spirit is broken when she discovers that discharges were not suspended - it was he who volunteered to fight. Their symbiotic relationship goes downhill, Ido returns to the border post and the battle flares up. Before his unit enters Lebanon, Anat, who feels trapped between her father and her son, decides to take matters into her own hands.
title: Oxygen

overview: A famed cartoonist's search for her daughter's killer unravels a sinister trail of poetic murders, leading back to her estranged ex-husband, whose forbidden play threatens to expose Kolkata's darkest secrets.
title: Madam Sengupta

overview: One day, an elderly fisherman living on the coast of South Korea discovers a boy swept ashore by a storm. Upon learning that the boy is from North Korea, having crossed the DMZ, the two face a difficult choice.
title: Across the Ocean

overview: The film intertwines several stories connected by one important football match between Sparta and Slavia.
title: Kouzlo derby

overview: Filmed across Italy, Moldova, and Romania, Tata is a raw portrait of a family locked in a relentless struggle against toxic masculinity and the tale of a daughter’s poignant quest to break the cycle for herself, the next generation, and even for the one who hurt her.
title: Father

overview: After a bombing at the school, the father of terrorist Jung Hae-sung sues teacher. The teacher goes around to get a petition with a lawyer and meets the people around Hae-sung. Through them, the teacher hears a story about Hae-sung that he did not know.
title: Classroom Delusions

overview: During one of his shifts at the Krusty Krab, SpongeBob amuses himself by overusing the restaurant's order up bell, much to the dismay of his grumpy co-worker and neighbor, Squidward.
title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Order Up

original_title: BABYMETAL - Live at The O2 London
overview: BABYMETAL became the first Japanese group to hold a solo concert.  The release of the live video work "BABYMETAL - LIVE AT THE O2 ARENA" from London's O2 Arena has been decided!  Their fourth album, "METAL FORTH," released in August this year, reached number 9 on the US Billboard charts, making them the first Japanese group to enter the top 10. BABYMETAL, who have become a globally acclaimed artist in both name and reality, have announced that they will be releasing the Blu-ray and DVD "BABYMETAL - LIVE AT THE O2 ARENA" on Friday, December 19th.
title: BABYMETAL - Live at The O2 London

overview: After a trauma, a kayaker is stalked by a shark on a Texas lake.
title: Lone Star Shark 2

overview: The Quiet Diplomat centers on former UN Secretary General Ban Ki-moon. The UN saved his life during the Korea War, inspiring him to become a man of peace. During two terms as the 8th Secretary General, Ban discovers the challenges of international diplomacy in an increasingly splintered world.
title: The Quiet Diplomat

overview: A music producer who has a perfect family. However, he has a prankster nature that causes problems in his life.
tagline: Ketika perselingkuhan yang terbungkus rapi, mendadak meledak.
title: Arti Cinta

overview: When a delusional killer in a cowboy costume starts treating a small town like his personal shooting range, two bumbling detectives must track him down and free his captive bride before he kills again.
tagline: You're in for a damn treat!
title: The Cowboy Killer

overview: Ricky and his cancer-stricken mother move to the seemingly innocuous town of Ojai in pursuit of a vague yet promising experimental treatment. As Ricky tries to adjust to his new life, he becomes increasingly skeptical of the town's innocence and concerned for his mom's well-being.
title: Ojai

overview: Lucio, the host of a popular radio show, is confident, charismatic, and holds progressive views. He is married to the beautiful Elena, who is insecure and emotionally dependent on her husband. Together, they form a harmonious blended family (which includes Lucio’s first wife and daughter) and have one child together: Blu, a 9-year-old who loves dressing in girls’ clothes and is allowed to do so—by both mom and dad—but only at home. When the school play comes around, however, Blu is determined to wear a Little Mermaid costume on stage. His parents, caught between their desire to support him and their instinct to protect him, find themselves confronting the limits of their open-mindedness. They embark on a journey of self-awareness and acceptance, joined by a diverse group of “Unicorn Parents” led by a compassionate psychologist.
title: Unicorni

original_title: Life's a Joy! Life Goes On!!
overview: To celebrate Maury Yeston's 80th birthday, a dream collaboration of cast members from past productions of "Grand Hotel," "Phantom," "Titanic," "Nine," and "Death Takes a Holiday"! Alongside our gratitude for the 20th anniversary of the Umeda Arts Theater, they bring you a “truly unforgettable moment.”
title: Life's a Joy! Life Goes On!!

overview: This is the story of an artist who makes an experimental film, knowing that it goes against all the rules of the film industry. His film is about a young girl who wanders around Moscow with a gun in her purse, looking for UFOs, and his style of storytelling is unacceptable to modern society. How can an artist make an avant-garde film for the film market, knowing in advance that the market does not want it?
title: Moscow Shadows

overview: In the working-class outskirts of L.A., Jesús, an openly gay man recently released from prison after serving a nine-year sentence for a nonviolent drug offense, is determined to reclaim his life and reunite with his daughter.
title: Lolita

overview: A woman wakes in the back of a moving camper trailer with a badly infected wound. A voice from the truck towing it tells her they must reach a doctor within the hour or she’ll suffer a horrific fate.
title: Hellcat

overview: Two elite boxers, Katie Taylor and Amanda Serrano, prepare for their epic trilogy finale, a live-streamed match on Netflix July 11. Uma Thurman narrates their rigorous training journey.
title: Countdown: Taylor vs. Serrano

overview: Amid the wintry steppes, Saina, a Mongolian horseman turned cultural performer, tends his ranch during the day and performs horseback tricks for audiences at night. Unlike the majestic cavalryman he portrays in the show, Saina discovers that his herdsman’s life is on the verge of disintegration.
title: To Kill a Mongolian Horse

overview: The main character's second attempt to escape the narrative is thwarted by a mysterious camera.
tagline: Some stories are told whether or not they need to be.
title: Villain

overview: When a serial killer, gangsters, and bottom-feeding private detectives cross paths… things can get really messy and bloody! A serial killer that has been in hiding is finally caught- but the story is far from over. A dirty cop learns that one of the killer's victims had actually stolen a national treasure, a golden Buddha statue that's worth millions; which no one has been able to locate for more than a decade. So begins a treasure hunt- and it's up for grabs for anyone, from a dirty cop to gangs and lowlife private detectives!
tagline: Whole story of unprovoked murder
title: Detective Agency

overview: In the Argentinian countryside, a child's special gift gives her opportunistic guardians the idea of offering consultations with her as an animal medium in order to earn a living.
title: The Message

overview: Davaa and Zaya are a young nomadic couple in the vast Bayanhongor region of Mongolia who are in the throes of animal birthing season when a seismic event suddenly changes their lives. They are forced to migrate afar but are haunted by their past lives.
title: The Wolves Always Come at Night

overview: When 11 year old Juliet stubs her toe on a loose floorboard, she unwittingly sets off a series of mysterious events. A faint noise and an unusual glow seeping through the cracks capture her curiosity. But as she investigates, Juliet finds herself pulled into a chilling, otherworldly encounter.
tagline: Don't be scared.
title: The Littles

original_title: AJ Goes to the Dog Park
overview: When AJ loses his favorite dog park, he must fight, fish, scrap, scrape, and sap to get it back.
tagline: A comedy movie made in Fargo, North Dakota on a nano budget with lots of jokes in it.
title: AJ Goes to the Dog Park

overview: Ronaldo aspires to become a filmmaker and win over the love of his life, so when he hears of a filmmaking contest, he prepares to finally achieve his dreams.
title: Oru Ronaldo Chithram

original_title: Les Mystères des grottes du Régulus
overview: A murder case rocks a small town when Julien Monnier is found dead, stabbed near the cave dwellings known as "Les grottes du Régulus." An old book is found beside him. Grace, a police captain, is put in charge of the investigation and discovers similarities with a ten-year-old case: a 17-year-old girl, Sarah, had been found dead, also stabbed, in the same caves. Grâce calls on Alex, her childhood friend who has become an expert in old books. He had investigated Sarah's death when he was a police officer. Alex reluctantly revisits the past and agrees to help, partly to reconnect with Grâce, his lost love. Their reunion rekindles old feelings and painful memories linked to their separation. As the investigation progresses, the memories of the protagonists and suspects become intertwined. Grace and Alex relive their past, but are confronted with conflicting memories and unspoken words.
title: Les Mystères des grottes du Régulus

original_title: 皮皮鲁和鲁西西之309暗室
title: The Hidden Chamber 309

overview: A coffin shop named Baiyunzhai is rumored to bring misfortune. After eerie deaths—a drowned man and a butcher killing his family—exorcist Ma Sanye investigates.
title: Weird Stories of Baiyun Zhai

overview: When a doctor is diagnosed with early onset Alzheimer's, his estranged son struggles to reconnect by reviving their shared memories, only to find the past harder to recover than expected. As both face personal upheavals, the family must confront pride, pain and lost time to rediscover the bond they thought they had lost forever.
title: Memori

original_title: Pirates of the Caribbean | Disneyland Resort
overview: Set sail on a treacherous voyage to the 17th century! As part of the Disneyland® Resort 70th Celebration we're sending you on a swashbuckling Point of View ride-along adventure! Experience Pirates of the Caribbean, one of Walt Disney's most beloved attractions. See rowdy rogues and ruthless rapscallions ransack Caribbean seaports with all the iconic music, mischievous charm, and Imagineering marvels. Sail past haunted Dead Man's Cove, navigate cannon fire between a fort and a twelve-gun galleon, and more. This is a breathtaking tribute to seven decades of storytelling and the magic of Walt's original park is asking one question: Will it be a Pirate's life for you?
tagline: Set sail through Disneyland Resort's iconic pirate adventure in this new Point of View ride-along.
title: Pirates of the Caribbean | Disneyland Resort

overview: A resilient 75-year-old woman, haunted by a clock counting down in her dreams since childhood, confronts her mortality during a home invasion, sparking an unexpected conversation with a her neighbor that blurs the line between fate and free will as midnight approaches.
tagline: When Time Runs Out, Destinies Collide.
title: The Clock

overview: Seojin lives with her mom, but they only see each other for about 10 minutes after Seojin returns from work in the morning. One seemingly ordinary day, everything changes when the emergency siren goes off. Suddenly, residents in the Seoul area are instructed to take shelter immediately. Though they live together, Seojin and her mom have rarely truly shared their lives — until now, as they begin to make an evacuation plan.
title: 22 Minutes: Warning Alarm

overview: While riding the subway, Yuna gets a text from a blackmailer saying she has until noon to arrive at her destination, otherwise he will release a malicious video online for the whole world to see. She carries an umbrella in the sunlight, because she has a condition in which her body starts to burn when exposed to light. Time is running out and she’ll do whatever it takes to face the man who wants to ruin her life
title: Cinderella At Noon

overview: In the wild West, Elmer McCurdy dies after a failed robbery, but death is only the start of his strange journey. His body is sold, displayed, and passed from one carnival to another, mistaken for a prop for decades. A darkly funny, haunting tale of a man who became more famous dead than alive.
tagline: GET RICH OR TRY DYIN'
title: Dead Outlaw

overview: Two close friends, along with their girlfriends, venture deep into a dense forest for a getaway. They spend the night in an isolated forest bungalow. As the night unfolds, one of the girlfriends dies under mysterious circumstances while alone with her boyfriend. Panic and confusion grip the group no one knows how or why she died. with the body still with them and no one to turn to, fear begins to take over. One by one, they make decisions to cover up the incident choices that spiral into something far more terrifying than they ever imagined.
title: Yaadhum Ariyaan

overview: After a prison transfer goes wrong, a dangerous mercenary and a naive police officer must work together to escape an island full of hostile prisoners.
title: Bloodstorm

overview: Rev. James Logan and his wife Beverly Logan were forced into a vicious spiritual warfare against the work of preternatural evil forces that almost broke the church of Jesus Christ.
title: Broken Church

overview: A HOA turns out to be more troublesome than usual in this wildly amusing, FX-heavy freak-out about newly minted suburbanites unexpectedly forced to take part in a struggle against monstrous forces.
title: Hold the Fort

overview: A waitress, while closing a café on a rainy night in London, is confronted by a mysterious older woman.
title: The Second Time Around

original_title: 嬢王vs夜王　甘美なる夜の遊戯
overview: First crossover between the series Jou-ou and Yaou (Queen of the Night and Night King). Hirona, a former top hostess and now a popular film actress, is involved in a sex scandal. She becomes obsessed with the actual N°1 host, Jin. Jin and his patron, Ichijo Shino, plot to put her back in the "Queen of the Night" position and gain complete control over the neon district.
title: Queen of the Night vs. Night King: Sweet Night Game

overview: "Show Time" is a gripping thriller that explores how an accidental murder shatters the lives of a middle-class family. The story follows a seemingly ordinary family whose world turns upside down when a momentary lapse in judgment leads to an unintended crime. As they struggle to cover up the incident, they are pulled into a web of lies, guilt, and paranoia, testing their bonds and morals.
title: Show Time

overview: This tribute program takes you back into the world of Thierry Ardisson, a particularly creative, provocative, and erudite host and producer. From "Tout le monde en parle" to "Salut les Terriens !", via "Lunettes noires pour nuits blanches", the program retraces his more than 40-year career and his extraordinary journey, featuring cult interviews, testimonials, and archive footage. Numerous guests will pay tribute to him and share their memories and anecdotes on set. Thierry Ardisson, "the man in black," shook up the French audiovisual landscape and left his mark on his era. The program is broadcast on all TV5 Monde channels and on TV5 Québec/Canada.
title: Ardisson, l'Homme en Noir : l'hommage

overview: A young doctor returns to Sri Lanka with a dream to serve his country, only to find himself caught in a web of love, loyalty, and a dangerous fight against a corrupt system. As he confronts the darker truths behind the healthcare industry, his courage and integrity are put to the ultimate test.
title: Hello from the Other Side

overview: Zarna Garg is bringing the heat (and the guilt trips) in her laugh-out-loud Hulu debut, taking aim at husbands, kids, in-laws, and anyone who dares question an Indian mom's wisdom.
title: Zarna Garg: Practical People Win

overview: Muttu seeks his deceitful friend Ramesh in Bengaluru, becoming entangled in the city's dark underworld. His journey through challenges involves action, emotions, love, friendship, and a search for justice.
title: Ekka

overview: Sucha’s harmless wedding prank turns into a wild curse, leading to runaway grooms, bandits, secret crushes, and a bride who loves farms over fashion.
title: Sarbala Ji

overview: Seti loves music and singing, and she yearns for her voice to be heard. But in Iran, women are forbidden by law from performing in public, so the young girl decides to stage her own personal protest. The street becomes her stage, and random passersby become her enthusiastic audience. Her star rises, and Seti becomes an idol for her generation—young people who refuse to live under ruthless political oppression any longer.
title: Bidad

overview: The documentary chronicles Bo Widerberg's journey from 1960s Malmö, where he worked as a writer and film critic, to his successes as a director in Stockholm and international adventures in Cannes and New York. The film also explores the personal costs of his artistic vision and how his pursuit of life and authenticity affected both himself and those around him.
title: Being Bo Widerberg

original_title: 방탄소년단 맵 오브 더 소울 원
overview: Relive the unparalleled grandeur and brilliance of BTS MAP OF THE SOUL ON:E as it is released on the big screen as a part of the limited-time cinema series "HYBE CINE FEST"
title: BTS MAP OF THE SOUL ON:E

overview: Grandma Baek predicted that Mirim would go blind before she turned 26. To prevent this, Mirim’s family adopted a son to take on her misfortune. As a result, Mirim didn’t go blind, but the son, Jinkoo died. Longing for Jinkoo, Mirim tries to reunite with him with the help of a pilgrim who unexpectedly visits her home.
title: Baljjeo

overview: A father drops off his son near his army base. Instead of returning home, he decides to wait for him outside the base.
title: A Burning Man

overview: Through the intimate lens of Silo, a Black queer woman, "Echoes of Us" captures the bittersweet journey of revisiting a past love that once felt like "the one." Now in a joyful relationship, Silo is unexpectedly pulled back into old memories, exploring how heartbreak, growth, and healing shape who we become.
title: Echoes of Us

overview: Miles, a particularly playful spirit, lures his friend Solta on a journey from Berlin to Friuli, Picardy and Venice, through his life, through the minefields of identity politics, and through the black hole of our oblivion as to what the world could be. Ultimately, he returns to Ireland, the land of his childhood, where he played marbles during the raw identity war of the troubles. Solta tries to track him down, to figure him out, to picture him. Miles, however, marbles in his pockets, infinity in his fingers, constantly eludes him.
title: My Friend Miles

original_title: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals: Reprised!
overview: Join Paul, Emma, and the rest of Hatchetfield in a fight for survival as the world around them is transformed into a musical nightmare! Whether you're a fan of the original show, or if you're new to the party... If you're a theater buff, or if you just don't like musicals, this remounted production of StarKid's hit horror-comedy is sure to shock, delight, and have you screaming with laughter!
tagline: Rejoice! Your Apotheosis is upon you...
title: The Guy Who Didn't Like Musicals: Reprised!

overview: A group of young activists breaks into a slaughterhouse, aiming to expose the owners for processing meat unfit for consumption. Armed with cameras, they capture damning evidence until they’re caught by the owner and his security team. What starts as a desperate chase to reclaim the footage quickly escalates into a deadly game.
title: Squealers

overview: When the sole survivor of an attempted North Atlantic crossing washes ashore, she must piece her memories together and face the terror of what happened far out at sea.
tagline: 1,000 miles from shore no one can save you.
title: Row

overview: Sky just wanted to avoid her estranged grandmother with Alzheimer’s—but when she finally visits, she uncovers a haunting mystery. Surrounded by ghostly figures that vanish from memory the moment they’re unseen, Sky and her friends find themselves trapped in a terrifying cycle of forgotten horrors.
tagline: Don't forget the dead.
title: Oblivium

overview: Bullet, an emotionally unstable bull terrier, battles his way through a bizarre digital gaming universe.
title: Bullet Time

overview: Athena was abused by her father during her childhood. Years later, without answers and marked by the absence of justice, she decides to take matters into her own hands in similar cases in the city where she lives. With the help of journalist Carlos, she travels to Montevideo where she finds her father and faces her past head-on, seeking revenge.
title: Atena

original_title: SUGAR SUGAR RUNE　Les deux sorcières
overview: A prequel short film set prior to the events of the manga to commemorate the 20th anniversary of SUGAR SUGAR RUNE.
title: SUGAR SUGAR RUNE　Les deux sorcières

overview: A young couple's hangout at a remote location goes haywire when they are discovered by a group of villagers and an unlikely antagonist. Now, only a miracle can help them escape.
title: Jungle Mangal

overview: Aki and Pia are a devoted couple working hard to build a future together. Pia, driven by love and a desire to lift her family from poverty, is offered a prestigious job in Singapore by her boss Carlo—who harbors feelings for her. As Pia’s career flourishes, Aki’s life unravels, leading to addiction and their painful breakup. Five years later, Pia is successful but unfulfilled in a relationship with the controlling Carlo. She returns to the Philippines, rejects his proposal, and seeks out Aki—only to find a man who no longer seems to know her. Faced with regret, Pia must confront the cost of her choices and the love she may have lost forever.
title: Lasting Moments

original_title: Verdict: The Diddy Trial - ABC News Special
overview: Sean Combs was found guilty of transportation to engage in prostitution but acquitted of racketeering and sex trafficking charges. Insiders take us through the legal saga and Comb's next steps.
title: Verdict: The Diddy Trial - ABC News Special

overview: Medusa is ruminating in her bedroom, recounting the events that occurred at Athena’s party. During the party Poseidon assaults Medusa. When she discloses this to Athena their friendship takes a sorrowful turn. The emotions and betrayal that arise, birth the legend of Medusa.
title: The Myth

overview: Nobody knows what's waiting for us around the corner. On the last day of her 13th birthday, following a rabbit into a St. Petersburg gateway by a strange attraction, Alice suddenly finds herself in a mysterious forest. A place where everything is the other way around. To the wild sounds of a piano, which is driven along country roads on a tractor, Alice meets a wild company that, instead of St. Valentine's Day, celebrates the feast of St. Tryphon the Mouser, unable to leave the festive table from winter to summer because of the curse of the Elder, who punished them for "blasphemy." Helping to solve this problem, Alice receives a motorcycle as a gift - both a dream and a means of transportation - and sets off on a journey. Where will it lead her? What awaits her, a lonely and strong girl? And most importantly, why did she tag along with the white rabbit? Who are her parents? And who is she really...
title: Алиса

overview: When a dark web trafficking attempt impacts her family, blockchain expert Dr. Carol Cleavers joins forces with her best friend to take down a dangerous cyber operation exploiting women.
title: Operation: Aunties

overview: A start-up gets boycotted by unfavorable government laws, causing a ripple effect in the lives of nine individuals, setting them on a collision course. Synopsis: Faced with unfavorable laws and incessant police harassment, three young co-founders struggle to keep their startup alive. A motorcyclist faces dark times with his family after losing his livelihood. A doctor struggles with his conscience on the job while battling outdated government policies. A police pair find themselves on different sides of the law with a difficult choice to make.
title: Freedom Way

overview: Ikhsan (Ahmad Pule) asks permission from his mother, Daeng Rannu (Sri Herawati), to visit the grave of his father, Daeng Rate (Jerry Wong), who died 15 years ago after being accused of being a black magic Doti shaman in Jonjo village. Although traumatized, Daeng Rannu finally allows it on the condition that Ikhsan be careful and hide his identity.
title: Doti - Tumbal Ilmu Hitam

overview: A journey centered around an ad-seller for one of the last alt-weeklies in the country, who, after witnessing a murder, is intimidated into being the killer's reluctant accomplice.
tagline: He knows if he says one word… He's next.
title: Every Heavy Thing

original_title: Chroniques fidèles survenues au siècle dernier à l’hôpital psychiatrique Blida-Joinville, au temps où le Docteur Frantz Fanon était chef de la cinquième division entre 1953 et 1956
overview: 1953, colonized Algeria.  Fanon, a young black psychiatrist is appointed head doctor at the Blida-Joinville Hospital. He was putting his theories of ‘Institutional Psychotherapy’ into practice in opposition to the racist theories of the Algies School of Psychiatry, while a war broke out in his own wards.
title: True Chronicles of the Blida Joinville Psychiatric Hospital in the Last Century, when Dr Frantz Fanon Was Head of the Fifth Ward between 1953 and 1956

overview: Nonbinary Max and their straight, cisgender boyfriend Jake face a major identity crisis after Max reveals they are finally off the waitlist for top surgery.
title: She's Nonbinary

overview: Maya, a dedicated and pregnant doctor, moves into a rural village with her husband Pradeep, a novelist seeking peace and inspiration for his next book. They hope for a fresh start in a calm and isolated environment.
title: Aaradhana

overview: Friends Petr and Michal, who have known each other since high school, live completely different lives: one has already settled down, has a well-paid job and a family, the other is a loner with unfulfilled artistic ambitions. But they are still united by their passion: graffiti.
title: Old Cans

overview: Chintan Parikh, a 28-year-old middle-class man constantly surrounded and troubled by the women in his life. On one fateful trip to Ambaji Temple he prays and asks for a power that could help him understand women and the wish is granted.
title: Unfiltered Naari

overview: Kong Kong accompanies his father Huang Feng on a journey to find his missing mother, Zhou Yi. However, Kong Kong is actually covering up for Zhou Yi's escape, who is suffering from domestic violence.
title: Kong Kong

original_title: The Haunting of Prince Dom Pedro de Alcântara Francisco António João Carlos Xavier de Paula Miguel Rafael Joaquim José Gonzaga Pascoal Cipriano Serafim
overview: A modern-day fairy tale, The Haunting of Prince Dom Pedro is a story of how a group of high school Latin American History class students learn to regret their decision to not fully appreciate the Liberator of Brazil.
tagline: Those who do not learn history are doomed.
title: The Haunting of Prince Dom Pedro de Alcântara Francisco António João Carlos Xavier de Paula Miguel Rafael Joaquim José Gonzaga Pascoal Cipriano Serafim

overview: A ride-hailing driver is hijacked by a criminal on the run from his crime boss, setting in motion a series of events, placing both their lives in peril.
title: Clutch

overview: Michele, Tiziana, Nino, Antonella, Filippo and Linda are the six aspiring content creators selected to participate in Dedalus, a new social game that promises to make the winner rich and famous. Locked up in an isolated arena, the contestants participate in trials that prove increasingly dangerous. What seemed like a simple game slowly turns into something completely different and the contestants, find themselves both executioners and victims of an elaborate revenge.
title: Dedalus

overview: Author Gregor writes successful romance novels under a female pseudonym and makes his readers' hearts beat faster. When a woman suddenly has to appear on stage at an awards ceremony to protect his secret identity, his publisher comes under pressure. Without further ado, she hires the quick-witted cab driver Elke, who has clear ideas about how this literary double role should be played.
title: Ein Taxi für zwei

overview: Rami deals with his Jewish girlfriend’s opposition to abortion. His mother complicates things while seeking compensation for her daughter Fifi accident. Miri plans to terminate her sister’s pregnancy with Rami, who’s Arab. Fifi struggles to hide her non-virginity to save her family’s reputation.
title: Happy Holidays

overview: Greek Detective Helen Moustakas is taken by surprise by a New Zealand farmer called Shirley Rangi, claiming to be her half-sister. Helen is reluctant to believe this revelation, and so agrees to a DNA test. In the meantime, however, Helen is called to investigate the peculiar death of an Archaeologist. A mystery which Shirley proves unexpectedly, although accidentally, helpful in solving.
tagline: Some sisters solve crimes
title: The Moustakas Sisters Mystery

original_title: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
overview: Bertie heads to South Africa for his most audacious mission yet. The wild waters here are a hotspot for one of the ocean’s most famous and feared predators, the great white shark. Diving in the shallows without a cage, Bertie will attempt to film these huge sharks. By entering their domain, he discovers the challenges they face on our rapidly changing planet.
title: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory

overview: Akin is a dedicated Cuban doctor working in Brazil for the Mais Medicos/More Doctors programme in 2018. From his daily routine in an indigenous community to his intimate moments with Érica and Sérgio, his relationship with Brazil gets deeper and stronger. With the election of Jair Bolsonaro, the cooperation between the two countries ends abruptly. He must make a decision: return to Cuba and abandon the relationships he has been cultivating or stay and reinvent himself without being able to practice medicine.
title: Akin's Desert

overview: Fear Forest is a run down haunted attraction with a dark past. Several unexplained deaths occurred in the attraction that were never solved. Years later, it is being torn down, and the project is being overseen by Mr. Malichi Bones, a man with his own secret past. Helping him clean out the property for demolition are a group of people in a work-release program, working off various fines for their past criminal behavior. It isn't long before old haunts return and bloody murders begin. Is it one of the criminals, Mr. Malichi, or could it possibly be the animatronic monsters represented by Frankenstein’s Bride, A vampire, a werewolf or an Egyptian mummy? A night of terror begins as the doors lock and no one can escape.....Alive!
tagline: Animatronics go haywire at a closed Amusement Park!
title: Four Nights in Fear Forest

overview: Yen, a young man with cerebral palsy, longs for both romance and a body like his caregiver Suriya’s, while his overprotective mother harbors complex feelings for Suriya. As tensions rise, Yen starts to believe his body is no longer the same.
title: Damp

overview: A depressed tech worker begins experimenting with AI after his girlfriend leaves him for a politician.
tagline: She's more real than you know...
title: In the Flesh

overview: Iconic director Lloyd Kaufman, creator of “The Toxic Avenger,” and the Troma Team wage a punk-spirited battle championing independent art at Cannes.
title: Occupy Cannes!

overview: Mateo and Ramiro have been close friends since college, until something happens that changes their relationship…
tagline: What a pelotudo I am...
title: VIDEOMINUTO

overview: A group of cosplaying friends trigger a zombie apocalypse and are forced to traverse a zombie-infested Los Angeles to save their loved one.
tagline: Heroes will rise. Undead will fall.
title: ZombieCON Vol. 1

overview: A brave cab driver and a released convict find themselves unlikely allies as they confront a greater evil that threatens to destroy many lives.
tagline: A Trio
title: Akkenam

overview: When four University of Idaho coeds are brutally stabbed to death, brilliant criminology student Bryan Kohberger is accused of their murders.
title: The Idaho Student Murders

overview: Seoul, 1989. Jung-min wants to become a speed-reading prodigy, just like Dong-hyun—the coolest guy in town, who can finish an entire book in just 60 seconds!
title: SPEEDY!

overview: A mother and her son`s strong beliefs in shaman bring them and their family to the doorstep of doom when the son uses black magic to retaliate against his wife`s ex-lover who uses a dark spell to destroy their marriage. However, his vigorous action backfires and threatens the lives of their family.
title: Munajjim: Sekutu Iblis

overview: Set in the near present, captures a nation on the brink of war. Due to the unstable political situation, Dawid loses his job without a warning. As his family prepares to flee the country, Dawid’s younger brother becomes involved with the only organization willing to stand against the encroaching enemy.
title: Kingdom

original_title: De film van Rutger, Thomas & Paco
overview: Rutger and Thomas are at their wits' end when their beloved dog Paco is suddenly kidnapped in a flying doghouse. Everyone thinks they did it themselves, but the mean Tiffy Woefels is behind it: she wants to make Paco a big star. Rutger and Thomas must prove that they are innocent and save Paco! They get help from an unexpected corner and go on an exciting and hilarious adventure full of action, friendship and barking heroes.
title: De film van Rutger, Thomas & Paco

original_title: AEW All In 2025: Texas - Zero Hour
overview: AEW All In: Texas - Zero Hour served as the pre-show to the larger AEW All In: Texas event, showcasing matches ahead of the main card and setting the stage for the highly anticipated night of All Elite Wrestling action.
title: AEW All In 2025: Texas - Zero Hour

overview: When a college student discovers her tongue can read minds through touch, she reluctantly teams up with her best friend to solve a mysterious death at a frat party—but as she licks her way through a parade of suspects, she uncovers a dark secret that could cost her more than just her sanity.
title: Tongue

original_title: The Four Bad Boys and Me
overview: A nerdy, weird, and forever-alone nobody's supposedly 'peaceful' life undergoes a chaotic change when she unexpectedly gets tangled with a group of four notorious bad boys.
title: The Four Bad Boys and Me

overview: In a utopian near future where crying has ceased to exist, an emotional young woman — the only person who can still shed tears — teams up with her protective older sister on a journey into the underground world of weeping.
title: Crybaby

overview: In this incredible story inspired by a true event, you will meet the savior of humanity, Lord Špekáček, who was born under the hand of the legendary Zdena, who herself chose and cut him. Our hero will have to face the awakened tree people who trapped Zdena under a root and conceived a tree mutant with her.
title: A Root Prisoner

overview: Fresh off a breakup, Jane Lee throws herself into a wild girls’ weekend—until an unexpected run-in with an old friend takes the night somewhere she never planned to go.
title: Jane

overview: A chronicle of the life and successful career of American actor Jeff Bridges, who for many years was a star reluctant to shine, until the hardworking and discreet actor crossed paths with a character who became a pop culture icon.
title: Jeff Bridges: A Reluctant Star

overview: When Yaki becomes aware of Bella’s true identity — a curly plumed, extremely valuable dove and his sole inheritance — it’s already too late. Yaki embarks with Bilal, his childhood friend, and their wives on a road trip across Israel and Palestine to bring Bella back. Along the way, they navigate through checkpoints, ruin a wedding, steal the newlyweds’ car, participate in a family reconciliation ceremony, and revive the unconscious dove.... All in order to make it on time to a dove beauty pageant in Jerusalem.
title: Bella

overview: A twisted cinematic supercut of short films, visual essays, found footage, remixes and music videos.
title: An Evening with Rodney Ascher

overview: To break free from a forced marriage, Simsim hunts for her own replacement, but what she finds instead is her true self.
title: Simsim

original_title: Food Delivery: Fresh from the West Philippine Sea
overview: Food Delivery captures the valiant efforts of the Filipino fishermen, Coast Guard and Navy to deliver desperately needed food to communities, all while defending their livelihoods and national sovereignty in the contested West Philippine Sea. Each catch and mission becomes a powerful testament to resilience, unity, and pride.
title: Food Delivery: Fresh from the West Philippine Sea

overview: Four college students at a sorority house in Idaho find a mysterious mask connected to a serial killer named Bryan. However, when they put it on, they find themselves trapped in a nightmarish reality as they awaken a serial killer.
tagline: The Nightmare Man is Back
title: Blood Rush

overview: A retelling of Daniel Chapters 1-3 in a world of sci-fi and fantasy. Thralldom, a tyrannical regime has conquered a magical and music-loving land called Songville. Danny, Mish, and Hanan, now exiles, rise from captives to high-ranking overseers under the Iron Master’s rule. They faithfully serve their master while secretly pledging allegiance to the true High King and the ways of Songville. However, as tensions rise and the cost of resistance grows, they must decide whether to risk their lives for the sake of faith and what they truly love— or remain silent in the face of tyranny. Are they willing to put their lives on the line for it?
tagline: Bow or Die
title: Stories of Songville

overview: A middle-aged man is trapped in a time loop, reliving the Christmas Eve of his murder repeatedly.
tagline: The loop of murder
title: 30 Minutes

original_title: プロジェクトセカイ COLORFUL LIVE 4th -Unison
overview: "Project Sekai COLORFUL LIVE 3rd - Evolve -", a real live performance of the game held from January 24 to 26, 2025.
title: Project Sekai COLORFUL LIVE 4th -Unison-

overview: Mario wakes up with no memory of his past life. His encounter with Lazare marks the beginning of a spatio-corporeal drift, from the eastern suburbs of Mexico City to the surrounding underground cavities, where bodies and landscapes crack in the same motion.
title: Cold Metal

overview: Hosted by Tom Bergeron; featuring five divers partnered with sharks, including hammerheads and tigers; each routine is unique, with signature underwater moves; a winner will be crowned, but can all the competitors make it that far?
title: Dancing With Sharks

overview: Actors workshop an allegorical and fictional new musical for an audience of one, who holds the fate of the play in her hands.
tagline: The election is over. The work has just begun.
title: Lost Cause

overview: In her reach for fame, wannabe influencer Kylie finds herself having to lurk in the shadows after a cheeky hit-and-run threatens to derail her coveted brand partnership.
title: Headcase

overview: 29-year-old Ilona and her boyfriend have just moved into a new apartment in a block of flats. When the building’s renovation begins soon afterwards and she befriends Oleg, one of the Ukrainian construction workers, her idyllic notions of a fulfilling life as she approaches thirty start to crumble, like the old plaster on the walls.
title: Renovation

overview: In a frantic race against time, struggling actress Anne must juggle chaos- and a high-maintenance dog named Macy- as a series of mishaps threaten her chance at a career-changing audition.
tagline: an actress, a dog, and the worst birthday ever.
title: The Actor

overview: A team's treasure hunt leads them to a deserted bungalow, where they soon find themselves in a terrifying battle against paranormal dangers.
title: Jenma Natchathiram

overview: Comedian and podcaster Marc Maron offers up his nuanced perspective on our increasingly uncertain world.
tagline: His best work yet.
title: Marc Maron: Panicked

overview: Everyone has dreams. For high schoolers Kash, Hadley, and Riley, their dream is to travel. To explore the world after they graduate high school. As big as the dream is, there are things in the way of that. Hoping to overcome these obstacles, this trio of teenagers has to navigate their senior year of high school, home lives, relationships, and the good old figuring out what they want to do with their lives. Will that get in the way of their dream?
title: Rivers Edge

original_title: Vale la pena, de Dani Rovira
overview: Actor and comedian Dani Rovira returns to the stage with an honest and hilarious take on finding light even in life's darkest moments.
title: It's Worth It by Dani Rovira

overview: Agoy, Bruno, Cherry, and Darlina are eternal marine science students who can’t seem to graduate because their thesis proposals keep getting rejected. When their proposal is finally accepted, their euphoria quickly turns into a new problem: the research costs have skyrocketed to Rp100 million. In a desperate attempt to raise funds, they recklessly invest in a plot of land sold at a suspiciously low price, rumored to increase in value soon. But it turns out the land is a scam—literally sloped, far from civilization, and muddy all over. The four friends must now figure out a way to turn this useless land into something profitable. Along the way, they learn heartfelt lessons about friendship, cleverness, and the responsibilities that come with growing up.
title: Gak Nyangka..!!

overview: An accidental love story between Stavan and Mugdha. They fall in love with one another in Goa and later decide never to meet each other again. What happened between the two? Will they ever meet again?
title: Anamika

overview: In the future world, environmental degradation has greatly affected everyone. Most people have to upload their consciousness to live in a data-constructed world called the New World, while some people remain outside to maintain the operation of it. A 16-year-old boy Cheng Qi has lived with his father since his parents divorced. After his father entered the New World, he set off on a journey to find his mother. Along the way, after experiencing all kinds of adventures, Cheng Qi becomes even more confused about what kind of life he truly wants for his future.
title: The Journey to No End

The director Kirill Serebrennikov incorporates his own experiences in Russia to present his take on an opera about political turmoil and its consequences. Serebrennikov’s production focuses on the effect on the people of high-stakes political scheming. Conductor Vasily Petrenko makes his Amsterdam debut leading the Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra. A top-flight cast is led bass-baritone Tomasz Konieczny, celebrated for his ability to get into the skin of his characters both vocally and dramatically, singing the title role for the first time.

It was a mad operation with no hope of returning alive, but the nation went wild, and the attacks continued for ten months, literally until the very last day of the war.  Close to 4,000 Japanese airmen died, and nearly 7,000 Allied military personnel were killed, and thousands more were injured by the attacks. How could this happen?  Utilising 15 years' worth of extensive interviews with US and Japanese World War II veterans, Takayuki Oshima’s film delves into the mechanism of how a crazed madness swept through an entire nation.

overview: A huge success when it premiered at the Opéra-Comique in 1900, Gustave Charpentier’s (1860-1956) “musical novel in four acts and five scenes” was panned by the critics, who considered its depiction of female desire and its heroine’s rebellion against her family to be scandalous. In this new reading, Christof Loy (Salomé) – famous for his meticulous productions, precise direction and refined aesthetic – has detected beneath the innovative theme of female emancipation an unspoken aspect of Charpentier’s libretto: the toxic family relationship in which Louise finds herself trapped, and the hold that her possessive – even abusive – father exerts over her with the complicity of her mother. Keen to tell the story without judging the characters, the director draws the audience into Louise’s subconscious, highlighting the darker side of a society that, far from emancipating its daughters, only offers them cheap romance as a deflection from the frustrations of their limited prospects.

overview: In order to fulfill his family's expectations, Lao Cai, an older rural youth, was forced to embark on a blind date journey. All kinds of ridiculous stories happened along the way, full of joy and challenges. Lao Cai finally realized the true meaning of life and found his own happiness.

overview: A film about the end of the world and the end of a roll of toilet paper. In his deftly playful work shot on 16mm, filmmaker (and musician) Ondřej Vavrečka reminisces, says his farewells and also reflects on the limits of progress. Via three fictional characters, each of whom responds differently to the impulses of their surroundings, he simultaneously enhances the sensitivity of the film audience. Will a pain we experience leave a scar or merely a colourless memory? And will someone remember the old Vysočany station a hundred years from now? In its poetic charm this cinematic piece is almost tactile in nature; it awakens all the senses and, in places, bears the hallmark of Jan Švankmajer, if the latter had been born an essential optimist, that is. Film as a whisper emanating from smiling lips. (Viktor Palák, KVIFF)

In Ultimate Frisbee, however, there are no referees; even in heated situations, players must resolve their conflicts themselves. The documentary ULTI*MATE - The Spirit of the Game follows the German Mixed National Team on their journey to the European Championships. These idealistic athletes are determined to show that with goodwill, clear communication, and empathy, a peaceful and fair competition is possible. But at the European Championships, their ideals are tested in ways they never expected. Floating through ideals and crashing hard into reality. ULTI*MATE is not only a sports documentary. It’s a story that explores the definition of success and the pressing questions of our time. overview: A dancer in a static pose on the screen. Is there movement? It seems not. But the film of the movie camera is moving, filming the dancer. Electrons are running, pixels of the digital matrix are changing. Does this mean that movement is happening? The dancer's body comes to life within the frame set by the cameraman. How does this frame and the dancer's choreography interact? Should the frame obey the laws of choreography or exist in counterpoint with it? Or, perhaps, should it freeze, allowing the dancer to create his own pattern within the frame? The dancer makes his body move according to the laws of choreography. But at the same time, his nature determines how the body will exist within this choreography. After all, nature created the plasticity of the body outside of choreographies and directorial tasks. So what is more interesting to watch? What is the real beauty - in an artificial, memorized choreographic movement or in a natural, random gesture?

overview: Loosely based on Franz Kafka’s short story, 'GIVE IT UP!' is a live-action animation odyssey through the confusion of life in the modern world. The narrative follows a lone salesman trapped in a timeless city, increasingly lost in his feverish dreams. Desperate, he races towards a train station as his last hope of escaping the city, encountering divine light, winding roads and the forces of bureaucracy. This deeply personal and referential work preserves Kafka’s absurd humour and pays homage to Weimar cinema of the 1920s, but also elevates the text to an existential meditation on authority, purpose and human helplessness.
tagline: THE STORY OF A MAN LOST IN TIME AND SPACE.

On dry land, his son, Adrián, has just been born. Thirty years later, Adrián embarks for the Gran Sol, guided by those old recordings that his father filmed between networks, storms and dawns. In the solitude of the boat, with the engine vibrating in the chest and the wind hitting the deck, he tries to understand the distance that separated them. Recording his own journey, between memories and movement, he finds a way to approach, as if filming he could tell his father what he never dared to pronounce.

"Chunhee's Wet Dream of Loving a Pig" is a meta-cinematic, carnivalesque experiment born from unfiltered passion, exploring the raw desire for art and the porous boundary between life and cinema.
title: Chunhee's Wet Dream of Loving a Pig

overview: American bull sharks throw down with Ozzie bulls in a wild competition to determine which one is superior. Paul De Gelder provokes his Australia bulls to perform against Craig O'Connell and Florida's fiercest bull sharks.
title: Bullshark Showdown

overview: Director opens a Korean dictionary and chooses two words at random to make a movie. The words she chose are ‘melancholy’ and ‘regret’. And she chooses her grandmother as main character. Following her daily life, the movie takes an unexpected turn, and the director remembers why she picked up a camera in the first place.
title: Melancholy Regrets

overview: FUGAZI is an experimental short film that explores the genesis of space through the presence of sound. Inspired by Leibniz’s relational theory, the film suggests that space only exists when it is inhabited, in this case, by sound. Through a sensory and progressive montage, sound reveals, transforms, and collapses space, guiding the viewer through cycles of creation and dissolution. It is an audiovisual experience about the invisible becoming visible when heard.
title: Fugazi

overview: A 10-hour, 'slow TV' film, documenting 10 days spent travelling the length of England on public buses, exploring the issues faced with service quality and the disabled bus pass.
tagline: From Land's End to the Scottish Border

overview: After serving a juvenile sentence in prison, the delinquent's regained freedom smells mainly of the corridors of the German authorities. David tries to find structure, but frustration and lethargy soon crowd out the stigmatized ex-con's good intentions. Too much time with old friends in the cold, wet winter weather, a letterbox full of annoying post and his permanent lack of money soon cause the adolescent to relapse. The “good life” appears as an abstract idea that doesn't seem to be meant for him and his friends.
title: Rain Fell On the Nothing New

overview: When two old college acquaintances meet up after years apart, it becomes clear that one of them has a beastly secret.
title: Howard

overview: The film begins with two crowds dressed in black, either  walking left or right. Suddenly, a young person dressed in  orange (symbolic of curiosity) enters the frame, with a  question mark visible on the back of their clothes. After  surveying the crowds, the orange figure decides to follow  their path briefly, before turning away – revealing a  lightbulb on the front of their clothes. Proceeding forward,  the orange figure notices a space full of white blocks. They  initially inspect them, before starting to build a small wall.
tagline: Based on the lectures of Bertrand Russell
title: The Analysis of Mind

overview: As a woodcarver comes close to death while gathering materials in the wilderness, he meets a familiar face who may have some insight on what to expect.

overview: Two technicians from a counter-surveillance firm are hired by a woman who believes her husband is secretly monitoring her. One shrugs it off as paranoia, but the other starts to wonder if she might be right.
title: Homecam

original_title: Ugly Kid Joe: Live at Wacken Open Air 2025
overview: Ugly Kid Joe are living proof that humor and heavy rock go together wonderfully. With their mix of hard rock, metal, and funk, the Californians created a sound in the early 90s that turned "Everything About You" and their cover version of "Cats in the Cradle" into international hits. They loved poking fun at convention while simultaneously celebrating the great guitar solo. After a few years off, the band returned in 2010 and has since demonstrated that their blend of groove, melodic vocals, and ironic self-irony is timeless. On stage, Ugly Kid Joe come across as a fun-loving gang, celebrating a loud, sweaty party with their audience, and that's exactly what we expect for Wacken 2025.
title: Ugly Kid Joe: Live at Wacken Open Air 2025

overview: Kev and Manda are trying to shape their future together, while Kev is also starting his own travel business. Everything changes when Lutesha, a new employee, arrives bringing ideas and a new spark into Kev’s world, threatening his long-time relationship.

overview: A game show goes off the rails when the director believes he's in the midst of a serial killer.

overview: Bami, a woman who fled forced marriage and built a new life in Lagos. After a tragic insurgent attack in her hometown, she returns, loses her husband and risks everything to rescue a kidnapped girl, finding healing through courage.

overview: In a thematic retelling of Edgar Allan Poe's "The Tell-Tale Heart," a man is forced to bring his elderly mother home from her nursing home after she is evicted on grounds of non-payment. overview: Having lived in his home for 12 years, Jacob, a painter, faces the threat of eviction like many New Yorkers. At the heart of this portrait lies ‘an exploration of what makes a house and how a house shapes a way of life.

overview: Set in 2004, Iranian immigrant Yasamin aka Yasi is the new girl at a Canadian school. Her high school experience is daunting, as she tries to improve her English by watching her favorite sitcom and befriends a trio of pastel-clad girls who feed Yasi’s need to fit in. Desperate for acceptance, she dyes her hair blonde and, in doing so, also attracts a demonic force.

overview: Ella and her friends take a weekend getaway to rural Australia to disconnect from their devices and reconnect with one another. However, an evil presence has other plans for them.
tagline: Don't trust everything you see...

overview: The earth spins around the sun at 30 km/sec. The habitable atmosphere on this planet extends 6 km into space and is composed of distinct layers. The troposphere extends upward from the earth to a height of about 8 km at the poles, to about 11.3 km in mid-latitudes, and to about 16.1 km at the equator. The air in the troposphere is in constant motion, with both horizontal and vertical air currents. As we exert ever increasing control we inevitably invite ever increasing chaos. The planetary boundaries framework defines a safe operating space for humanity based on the intrinsic biophysical processes that regulate the stability of the Earth system. From global warming to the biosphere and deforestation, from pollutants and plastic to nitrogen cycles and freshwater: Six of nine planetary boundaries are being crossed, while simultaneously pressure in all boundary processes is increasing.
title: Precipice

overview: A trick-or-treater discovers a lost VHS tape revealing the final moments of three students investigating paranormal legends in Amityville, NY. From EVPs to Bloody Mary, their quest for proof spirals into a blur of reality and evil.

However, it is through this experience that they are finally able to genuinely communicate with each other and determine whether or not they should even be a couple at all.

Unable to distinguish what’s real from what his mind creates, he drifts deeper into psychological uncertainty.  The Null Mirror is a minimalist psychological drama about identity, influence, and the fragile line between fiction and self.
