overview: In contemporary Helsinki, former student Raskolnikov is pushed to murder when struggling to pay the rent on his apartment. When the murder is being investigated by the police, Raskolnikov struggles between trying to hide his guilt and the pressure to confess.
title: Crime and Punishment

overview: MY BODY IS A CAGE centers around the relationship of Shawn, a once highly touted boxer, and his dutiful partner, Trish, the day after his brutal KO in the ring. When Shawn falls to a professional record of 0-6, he is faced with the harsh decision on whether or not it’s time to abandon his dream, despite his years of hard work, dedication, and loyalty to the game.
tagline: Where is the line between confidence and delusion?
title: My Body Is A Cage

overview: A young pastor discovers that his congregation's biggest temptation is an online cam model only to find himself drawn into her world, forcing him to question his faith, his future, and the institution he serves.
title: Holy Hustle

overview: A story of the unspoken, unbreakable bond between twin brothers in the face of a deep tragedy.
tagline: A story of the unspoken, unbreakable bond between twin brothers in the face of a deep tragedy
title: Fifteen

original_title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Micah Parsons
overview: Eli Manning recruits Micah Parsons to embrace his inner “unc” as he goes undercover as a waiter at a Dallas Cowboys fan event. Nobody knew it at the time, but this would be one of his final acts as a Cowboy.
title: Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers - Micah Parsons

overview: Twelve-year-old Malika’s entire life revolves around her mom Roza: she is her friend, her world, and her pillar. But when Roza decides to remarry, Malika understands that she will have to go to her father’s house, as the Islamic tradition dictates. Malika now faces the impossible dilemma between disrupting this new marriage and keeping the life she’s used to or sacrificing her own happiness for her mother’s.
title: Malika

original_title: A Grammy Salute to Cyndi Lauper: Live from the Hollywood Bowl
overview: Filmed over two nights at the Hollywood Bowl as Lauper concluded her year-long Girls Just Wanna Have Fun Farewell Tour, this all-star concert celebrates icon's beloved catalog.
title: A Grammy Salute to Cyndi Lauper: Live from the Hollywood Bowl

original_title: Le goût du vin de palme
title: The Taste of Palm Wine

overview: After a nocturnal earthquake in Oaxaca, phone systems across Mexico collapse, forcing people to  turn to public phones to communicate. Personal tensions and crises emerge amid the disconnection,  revealing deep internal struggles and complex social dynamics in a chaotic context.
tagline: After a nocturnal earthquake phone systems across Mexico collapse, forcing people to turn to public phones to communicate.
title: Public Phone

overview: 10-year-old Persephone has a school project due tomorrow — but first, she must find her mother, who’s been missing for days.
title: Prelude to a Supernova

overview: A young man observes a chaotic fight outside a rural California gas station and makes a decision.
title: Mirage

overview: Rajan, a weary factory worker, endures grueling shifts and a volatile home life, drifting through sleepless nights in the city as he tries to reclaim the rest that always seems just out of reach.
title: Shadows of the Moonless Nights

overview: In nighttime Havana, the dim lights that light up its streets rely on an unstable electricity supply- the same one that supplies the sound systems at raves. A group of young people, witnesses to the complete lack of energy, drift through the city, lost in delirious conversations, conspiracies and apathy as the city grows darker.
title: Industrial Havana

overview: With the ghosts of his past back to haunt him in the wake of a mysterious death, Detective Brian Lancaster struggles with his sobriety while searching for the truth surrounding his sister’s fatal drowning as a child.
tagline: Don't let the past steal your future
title: Crow's Rest

overview: For a hundred years, the former fishing village of Campione d'Italia, an Italian enclave in Switzerland, has drawn enormous wealth from a monumental casino. There is hardly a resident who has not benefited economically or socially from it. But the bankruptcy of this colossus destroys all prospects and autonomy. The reopening gives the village one last chance.
title: Architecture of Happiness

overview: Maryam is an involuntary immigrant in the US, who after forty years has not forgotten her escape from Iran’s border wrapped in a sheep’s skin. Maryam is always worried about her elderly parents and in constant visual connection with the home in Iran from thousands of kilometers through surveillance cameras. These cameras take her to the days of the 1979 revolution. Today, Iran is again experiencing turbulent days and now Maryam encounters her revolutionary past and revolutionary girls who are challenging the present system.
title: Past Future Continuous

overview: Set to a vibrant landscape, 'April' follows the emotional up-and-down journey of a full-of-life high school girl, named April (played by Celine Alva), as she navigates change, friendships, and ultimately a decision that could permanently alter her life.
tagline: I’ve always got you.
title: April

original_title: Teño que aprender a chorar de novo
overview: The Eo River flows through the northern regions of Lugo and western Asturias. For centuries, its waters have served to feed and provide energy to its people. Today, it continues to be a crucial part of the environment, functioning as a link between the two provinces and bringing their inhabitants together.
title: Teño que aprender a chorar de novo

original_title: To Close Your Eyes And See Fire
overview: Beirut lies in ruins. After the explosion in the city's port, collective trauma rises to the surface. How can life succeed after such a tragedy? The film carefully observes the following three years and zooms in on the lives of Aya - a Syrian refugee girl, Selim - an activist and painter, the Aladdin family - mourning a tragic loss, Yasmin - picking up calls at a suicide prevention hotline, and Andrea - who still believes in the city's spark for change. Meanwhile, a smoldering fire keeps on lingering in the port’s silos like a cautionary tale. Is it time to leave?
tagline: In the aftermath of the Beirut explosion, the city faces the challenge of healing while new crises inflict further wounds. Who will leave the country and at what cost?
title: To Close Your Eyes And See Fire

overview: The film explores the life and career of the Hamburg-born musician, whose creative work began in the West German post-punk scene of the 1980s.
title: Mona Mur in Conversation

overview: With 200 days left before college entrance exams, In-hye, who cares for the school's animal pen, spends her time lecturing a duck instead of studying. Seo-hee, punished for carrying a knife, joins her, and they discover an abandoned meadow where they lose the duck, Hee-seon. Meanwhile, teacher Kim Ah-tae forms a college interview prep group for four neglected students. On interview day, In-hye and Seo-hee ditch school to find Hee-seon, camping in the meadow and gradually learning to survive in the wild.
tagline: Like gorals, we chase! Like girls, we dream!
title: The Gorals

overview: This is a journey through memory, where the past and present converse, revealing how time shapes identity and relationships. In this intimate exploration, the film goes beyond the story of a wife to reflect on the power of images to preserve, reinterpret, and redefine our lives.
tagline: A journey through memory.
title: y Rosa

overview: Ada, a 14-year-old girl, helplessly watches her father’s slow agony as he battles a serious illness. She is sent to Saint-Michel-Chef-Chef, a seaside resort in western France. On the beach, while stung by a wasp, Ada feels her body change and her desire awaken.
title: I Hear It Still

overview: Scientist Anandi visits Hanuman Island to perform the last rites ritual for her father. She is immediately placed in quarantine in a remote hotel due to a pandemic caused by a machine-dominant world. When a mysterious star starts following her, she escapes and seeks refuge with a mother and her transgender daughter.
title: Spying Stars

overview: The inhabitants of a village surrounded by misty mountains perform magical rituals. When Florek and his cow are separated, the boy does everything to get her back.
title: Everyone Has Killed Someone

overview: A strange young man named Archie shows the world how to listen between the lines and find the music in everyday noise
tagline: Listen Between The Lines
title: The Sound Of Static

overview: Arko and Dina’s love falls apart when Dina’s father predicts she will marry a blind boy. Convinced of her father’s ability to foresee the future, Dina abandons Arko and waits for the prophesied groom. Desperate to win her back, Arko makes a fateful, devastating choice.
title: Ondho Balok

overview: BLUE is a layered romantic dramedy about possibly finding love, maybe losing love, and stumbling across ourselves along the way, in an era ruled by devices and emojis. When a heart-on-her-sleeve woman (Imani Cheadle) has a surprise reunion with an old friend, the ensuing roller-coaster culminates in a chance encounter with the love of her life.
title: BLUE

original_title: Arvo Pärt : oeuvres pour choeur et orchestre à cordes Festival de Lusace
overview: To mark the 90th birthday of Estonian composer Arvo Pärt, a special concert featuring three of his iconic works, recorded in Görlitz, Germany.
title: Arvo Pärt: works for choir and string orchestrav @ Lusatian Festival

original_title: Đồi Hành Xác: Tà Thuyết Đen Trở Lại
overview: When Bao, a young mechanic, dismantles a 90s car in his old garage, he unwittingly unleashes a sinister force. As haunting events spiral out of control, the arrival of a mysterious investigator reveals long-buried secrets of greed and human brutality.
title: The Torture Hill

overview: The cat in a box, is it dead or alive? Schrödinger, a quantum physicist, asked the question. He answered that the cat is simultaneously both dead and alive. It paved a path to paradox. The monk in the house seeks after the truth in quantum physics. The time for the stars to bloom, the sunset when the flowers fall, the moment when light disappears in darkness, how do they exist in the same landscape? His question becomes spiral stairs.
title: The House Beyond the Stairs

overview: In 1975, television star David Carradine came up with a novel way to forge a relationship with his estranged daughter Calista: he would make a movie with her. "Mata Hari" tells the story of David and Calista's relationship through the lens of their unfinished, years-long film project, an epic telling of the life of the Dutch courtesan and spy, Mata Hari.
title: Mata Hari

original_title: Tatyana Jane ARTE Mix ø Trabendo 2025
overview: With her unique musical style, Tatyana Jane blends Cameroonian traditions with global influences. It’s an irresistible mix that we enjoyed to our heart’s content at ARTE Mix ø Trabendo.
title: Tatyana Jane @ ARTE Mix ø Trabendo 2025

overview: A transgender woman's first date spirals into a nightmare when she's confronted by a figure from her past.
title: Mace

overview: A trans man and his partner travel to a remote Iranian village to face his estranged father and obtain documents that would permit them to live authentically, in visionary director Farnoosh Samadi’s bold queer love story.
title: Between Dreams and Hope

overview: Filmmaker Tobias Hermansen, known for Dreamscape and Mentally Unavailable, has battled depression for years, facing moments of darkness that shaped his perspective on life. Through his struggles, he discovered the power of storytelling as both an escape and a means of self-expression. Now, he channels his personal experiences into powerful, deeply emotional films that shed light on mental health and human resilience, inspiring others through storytelling.
tagline: Depression tried to end my story. I chose to keep writing.
title: Hanging by a Thread

overview: The real, passionate, epistolary love affair between two of the most brilliant minds of 19th-century Spain: Emilia Pardo Bazán and Benito Pérez Galdós. A story of love, passion, and sex, ahead of its time.
title: Mi ilustrísimo amigo

overview: A Mexican town is intervened by the military in search of the leader of a guerrilla group. Bernardino, an ally of the group, is on a mission to help his wounded companions, but the militia will get in the way, putting his loved ones at risk.
title: Fuego en el sur

overview: Third Wheel delves into the complexities of breakups, breakdowns, friendship, and the profound struggles of heartbreak. Exploring the universal journey of learning to be 'alone' and finding oneself, Third Wheel challenges the conventions of romantic comedies and dramas, where the boy always gets the girl and they live happily ever after. In Third Wheel, Ray embarks on a different path, one uncommonly told but all too familiar in real life. By veering away from the typical tropes of the genre, this story sheds light on the underrepresented impact of learning to date yourself. It offers a fresh resolution and a universal theme that resonates with audiences from all walks of life: you cannot truly be comfortable with somebody else until you are comfortable with yourself.
title: Third Wheel

overview: Rural Catalonia, 16th century. A quack doctor arrives in a village to cure the mayor's son, but a local healer warns him that a curse is hanging over them.
title: Malet

overview: After a long and obsessive pursuit, Dr. Victor Frankenstein and his creature finally confront each other deep in the forest, where the monster makes new demands of its creator.
tagline: How could I express my feelings about this catastrophe or describe the monstrosity I had created?
title: Frankenstein The Creature

overview: Over ten years ago, their mother passed away after giving birth to the youngest sibling. Not long after, their ailing father also died. Now, with an eviction notice in hand, the four siblings are left with only a letter from their father and a car registration under Chun-ja's name. Chun-ja takes back the car that their uncle had been using. After a family meeting, they agree with Jun-myung, the third sibling, who wishes to take a year off from school to travel. They set off on a camping journey together.
title: Norwegian Mackerel

overview: Kim has had enough: of school, of her girlfriend, and even more so of her mother. Because of her, Kim's father is now gone. Just gone. So Kim decides to leave. She can't go back, only forward. Until she finally arrives at the one place where she can still be.
title: Nettle Bath

overview: The antithesis of the virile heroes of his era, James Dean shook up the representation of adolescence and masculinity in three films shot in 1955, the same year he died in a car accident at the age of 24—exactly seventy years ago: Rebel Without a Cause, East of Eden, and Giant. This meteoric rise made him an instant icon, frozen in eternal, rebellious youth, which still resonates strongly today.
title: James Dean: Rebel Generation

overview: This is a tale of a group of down-on-their-luck young loafers in Beijing. Aifei, a filmmaker with little recognition, has been under a lot of pressure lately. She plans to see a gig in Hangzhou, hoping to unwind. Financially, Aifei is in a tight spot due to the delayed payment from her last project. Relationship-wise, she is dealing with ongoing feud between her and her boyfriend, Bandi. Her health is also a matter of concern, and the ups and downs of her flatmate's love life add another layer of complexity.
title: Happy Girls

overview: Jerry, a quiet and dispirited middle-aged gay actor, works as a standby for the hit off-Broadway show, "The Con Artiste!" Facing financial woes, loneliness, and questioning his art, he spends the day in rehearsal with a flirty young actor, the stage manager, and his bored fellow-understudies. At curtain time, when the lead actor calls in sick, Jerry is thrust into the star's dressing room and a whirlwind of last minute preparations. The curtain rises and, on cue, he walks onstage into the blazing lights to face not only an expectant audience, but also the possibility of a personal and artistic triumph - or failure.
title: Standby

overview: A group of friends come face to face with a creature that can mimic humans.
tagline: "Let me in mate....please just let me in"
title: Mimicry

overview: Follow the sweaty, teary and ultimately triumphant journey of the country's best ballkids as they progress through local and national trials.
title: Ballkids

overview: Living in a group home, 17-year-old Park Seon dreams of becoming an actor. But she must leave and face life alone at 18. Caught between her reality and dream, Seon hears of a ‘wish-granting underpass.’
title: Into the Light

overview: Min-hyeong, a musician working in Mullae-dong, is preparing to move out after failing to renew his lease. One day, he meets Jee-an, a welder, and as they grow closer, he begins to write the final track of his album.
title: The Light of Mullae

overview: Leyla finds a blue hair tie that doesn't belong to her in her boyfriend's car. What seems like a simple case of infidelity takes a completely different turn when Leyla shows the hair tie to her uncle who is a police officer.
tagline: A tangled bond caught in a tie, two souls stand on the cliff so high.
title: Hair Tie

overview: Two young lovers hesitate to take their relationship further. One is blue, and permanently shares her color with anyone who touches her.
title: Amour Bleu

overview: A young woman has a rare medical condition that causes her to gag involuntarily, almost to the point of vomiting. One fateful night, she is forced to confront the past she left behind -a past tied to her condition- and discovers that her "barf," both literal and metaphorical, is a part of herself she must embrace and release.
title: GUÁCARA

overview: After a homeless ex-filmmaker witnesses a kidnapping, he comes to believe that he is trapped in a horror movie filmed by the city's CCTV, where the only way to survive is to stay on camera - no matter what.
title: CCTV Nasty

overview: In a toxic hypermasculine world, a man struggles to keep his secret as he drinks and catches up with his nosy friend group.
tagline: One secret.
title: Una't Huling Inuman

overview: Over the past 20 years, the Schwörer family has sailed around the world while sharing their expedition examples of nature’s true beauty and inspiring people to live in balance with nature. Along the way, their family has grown, with six children being raised on their sailboat.
title: Home Is the Ocean

overview: Joža was wounded in combat during the events of the Croatian War of Independance and now works as a taxi driver in Zagreb, encountering various clients, all of which help him to cope with his past, and reveal to him what it truly means to be human.
tagline: You're the one
title: Taxi Love

overview: Rodnyansky was sentenced in absentia by a Russian court to 8.5 years in prison for his anti-war stance. In his film, Rodnyansky contemplates key events in Ukraine’s history and how they have affected him and his family.
title: Notes of a True Criminal

original_title: I’d Give the Whole World to Be Back Where I Used to Be...
overview: A black-and-white musical portrait of Houston, Texas.
tagline: A black-and-white musical portrait of Houston, Texas.
title: I’d Give the Whole World to Be Back Where I Used to Be...

overview: Going off on an inner quest to Tinos island in the Cyclades, the filmmaker attempts to define herself and her position in the world. She keeps shifting between two gardens and two father figures, while trying to deal with a personal loss, the defeat of a social movement, and a cinematic failure. What remains reads like a letter to the ever-missing father.
title: My Green Garden

overview: Generations of unspoken hurt begin to resurface when Ariel returns home after years of absence to spend All Saints' Day with her mother, Anita.
title: When It Rained Malunggay Leaves

overview: Four researchers record their perceptions as they walk through the patch of the BR-116 that goes through Canoas, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, looking for characters who’ve had their lives connected throughout the highway. The BR-116, the largest road in Brazil, crosses 10 states and connects Fortaleza to the municipality of Jaguarão, at the Uruguayan border, while also going through Canoas, splitting the city in two. The documentary brings testimonies from different people who share their life stories. “A Highway Movie” (2025) is the work that concludes Wender Zanon’s trilogy on Canoas, which starts with “This Is Canoas, Not Poa” (2021), followed by “Essays on a city” (2024).
tagline: A BR é como a vida, tu entende?
title: A highway movie

overview: Maria loves the Earth. She also loves Xenofon, her astrophysics colleague. When their romance turns sour, and in the midst of Earth’s environmental collapse, Maria discovers an extraterrestrial signal giving a solution for the rescue of the blue planet and mankind.
title: Planets

overview: Teenager, Koy, is desperate to rebuild his family’s life after a fire. His friend, Chito, offers him a dangerous job that forces him to set another slum ablaze.
tagline: When the city burns, family remains.
title: Inferno in the South

overview: When a sex tape featuring Hulk Hogan and the wife of his best friend—radio shock jock Bubba the Love Sponge® Clem—was leaked online, it ignited a media firestorm. You’ve read the headlines. Bubba recorded it. Gawker published it. This shocking documentary unpacks the lies, the betrayals, and the lawsuit that rewrote the rules of privacy. But the resulting fallout had much greater consequences than just Hogan crushing Gawker. You think you know the real story. You don’t know anything.
tagline: A radio war caused a sex tape featuring Hulk Hogan and the wife of his best friend, radio shock jock Bubba The Love Sponge Clem, to be leaked online, igniting a media firestorm.
title: Video Killed the Radio Star

overview: A schoolteacher and an artist, two newlyweds, leave their lives in Hong Kong and wrestle with the promise of freedom in Canada.
title: Give and Take

overview: Sunk in chronic lethargy, "I" follow my mother on a walk along Namdaecheon stream and recall an old elementary school assignment: catch a planarian. I never found one back then; I just played on the trampoline ("bang-bang") nearby. An unsolved mystery remained: do planarians really live in Namdaecheon? This film is the story of a middle-aged woman with a new ADHD diagnosis who, in trying to find the answer, tumbles down a rabbit hole of planarian obsession.​
title: BangBang and Planaria

overview: Against the voracious concrete and a ruthless developer, a poet stands tall, the last bulwark against oblivion, like a Gaul defying Caesar. He gathers voices from the past, revives memories, and weaves an ode to Ville Jacques-Cartier's working-class heritage, a haven where hopes and struggles once echoed.
title: Cardboard City

overview: Through the plight of one woman trying to save her daughter from starvation, “Rovina’s Choice” traces the effects of Donald Trump’s executive order banning US foreign aid - made within hours of being sworn into office in January 2025. Rovina Naboi’s devastating story represents the global impact of that decision on the world’s most vulnerable populations, and how it stopped decades of progress combating severe malnutrition.
title: Rovina's Choice

original_title: Robert Redford: The Life & Legacy of an American Icon
overview: Celebrating the life and legacy of the actor and Oscar-winning filmmaker; a look at his legendary career in Hollywood, his activism, the Sundance Film Festival and his support of independent filmmakers.
title: Robert Redford: The Life & Legacy of an American Icon

overview: The experimental film explores the visual representation of the Holocaust through a montage of thousands of excerpts from fictional films and television series produced between 1938 and the present. Drawing from an extensive archive of over 3,000 narrative works the film critically examines how Holocaust imagery has been codified and reproduced in cinema across decades.
title: Holofiction

overview: 2032: Putin is dead. Russia has lost the war against Ukraine. Alex, the son of Russian political refugees, returns to the land of collective amnesia with his German friend because he has inherited his deceased grandmother's apartment. But the neighbors are after the apartment. While the unsuspecting Alex waits for the police, their recent past - our present - erupts in everyday conflicts. Only the neighbor's daughter remembers her childhood friend.
title: Inheritance

overview: When a compassionate helpline counsellor begins to grow concerned for the safety of one of her clients, she's forced to decide whether to trust her instincts or follow protocol. Safe is a tense, quietly powerful drama about the weight of responsibility and the courage it takes to listen.
title: Safe

overview: Afrim and Kenan meet after many years reviving childhood memories. The calamity that Afrim suffers puts Kenan in a very difficult situation. Is Kenan willing to sacrifice everything to stay close to his childhood friends. Now, both are looking for memories, but in different forms!
title: Coma

overview: A ten year old boy, Arjun, has to find a way to navigate his world when his grandmother, who has dementia, unexpectedly has to stay with him and his mother.
title: Dekho

overview: Feeling tired of wanting to get out of the nightlife and live happily, Sari in Banyuwangi plans to win the heart of Rendy, her first love from high school who is now a businessman in Jakarta and married to her best friend Nilam. Through the guidance of her colleague Rini, Sari learns about Lintrik, a type of powerful love spell that can make the affected person attracted even in a very far place. Unfortunately, this Lintrik ritual is different from love spells because it cannot be done alone but can only be done by a female shaman who lives alone in the middle of the forest. Sari's meeting with Mbah the shaman reveals one by one the conflicts, secrets, until an event that Sari never imagined in her life.
title: Lintrik: Ilmu Pemikat

overview: Before the concert rehearsal, while Seong-hyeon is tuning his drums, another drummer, Won-tae, appears in front of him and changes the tuning without his permission, and Seong-hyun begins to feel increasingly anxious.
title: Snare

overview: Hilda grows despondent as she fears her boys’ Caribbean identity is slipping away, anglicised by their new life in the UK.
title: Ackee and Saltfish

original_title: Madeleine McCann: Searching for the Prime Suspect
overview: In this powerful new documentary,  criminologist Dr Graham Hill, a former senior Met detective who was in Portugal during the early stages of the investigation assisting local police, returns to Praia da Luz for the first time. Revisiting the scene of her disappearance, unpicking Brueckner’s criminal history in both Portugal and Germany and meeting those who knew him to build a detailed offender profile, Dr Hill examines the case against the man who remains the prime suspect- and who has consistently denied any involvement in Madeleine McCann’s disappearance.
title: Madeleine McCann: Searching for the Prime Suspect

overview: Bari and Kari are two dwarves who are very much in love. One summer day, Bari wears a hand-knitted scarf that Kari gave her on a date, and an endless comedy ensues.
title: BariKari knitted scarf in midsummer

overview: A funeral home employee must put her own personal struggles aside to help a grieving woman who just lost her daughter.
title: Serenity

overview: Lance Dur, a once-legendary hero but now a grumpy old man riddled with aches and pains, takes up arms once more to free his granddaughter Ozie from a powerful demonic witch. With the help of his former companions-in-arms, all as rheumatic as him, he will have to prove to everyone – himself included – that he is still good for something.
title: Lance Dur

overview: A young woman attends a healer’s book-signing event with her sick mom.
title: Healer

overview: There is a store in Palermo unlike any other called Quir, a place of love defying any convention. The owners are Massimo and Gino, who have been together for forty-two years, perhaps the longest-lasting gay couple in Italy. Their small leather goods store has become an important meeting place of the local LGBTQI+ scene – here people chat about their love stories or seek advice – fighting for acceptance in Sicily, a stronghold of patriarchal culture.
tagline: A Palermo Love Story
title: Quir

overview: She stands on the edge of the rooftop, eyes closed and legs trembling. A sound breaks the silence. A boy enters the rooftop and stands directly across from her, also on the edge...
title: Creation

overview: After an accident, a global pop star is rescued by a nurse, only to discover that she is a mega-fan who will keep him hostage by any means necessary.
title: The Follower

overview: Cheng, Pei, Wei and Ah Doa went to Hualien for a 2-day trip. To 3 of the friends, this trip was meant to keep Cheng’s company due to a recent break-up. To Cheng, it has different meaning: to return something to the sea.
title: Ocean Wood

overview: An inexperienced astral projector seeks his grandmother’s wisdom after meeting an uncanny woman in a place transcending reality.
tagline: Out of the body, into the past.
title: Adrift

overview: A gang of bootleggers play a game of poker after the death of a recently murdered member.
tagline: You Never Know Where Your Enemies Lie
title: Dead Man's Hand

overview: Si-rak participates in rehearsals with the cast to write an audio description for the performance.
title: The Form of Matter

overview: A toy maker rushes to repair a client's cherished puppet, only to find something horrific upon delivery.
title: Unstrung

tagline: Can love survive this?
title: THE FIGHT

overview: A lonely and isolated young man suffering from the after-effects of the pandemic, embarks on a nationwide odyssey to find the love of his life, a beautiful and enchanting woman he met on a paid website of a questionable origin.
title: Pretty Miss Lolly

overview: After the devil is thrown out of Heaven, he goes into the desert to confront his replacement.
tagline: "The Devil can quote Scripture for his purpose." -William Shakespeare, THE MERCHANT OF VENICE
title: Criterion

overview: New York’s Miguel Abreu Gallery is at the center of Bingham Bryant’s short, which follows Adrian Dannatt across his eponymous exhibit while observing works from, among others, Pablo Picasso, Guy Debord, Nan Goldin, Damien Hirst, and Duncan Hannah. Each is captured by cinematographer Sean Price Williams in appropriately textured images while a studious, amusing voice-over jumps between biography and philosophy.
title: Doomed and Famous

overview: The last days of the fall of Sukhumi. People in a state of war. Political confrontations of the 1990s. Stories in which the instinct for survival is accompanied by the desire to preserve one's humanity
tagline: Sokhumi
title: Sokhumi

overview: The atomic-bomb is about to be dropped on a small Texas town
tagline: It's the End of the World, Baby!
title: MEAT MACHINE

overview: Six women. Six rooms. Six confrontations with the past. Shot in East London, Second Skin is a devastating meditation on society’s obsession with a woman’s age.
tagline: Removing our masks will always take with it some of our skin.
title: Second Skin

overview: Lakis, a private investigator, believes his life is metaphysically linked to Andreas Papandreou and PASOK. One night, he locks Kostakis in his office, trying to convince him not to sell the rooftop cinema, owned by his family, to a multinational corporation.
title: 100 Years Ahead

original_title: Jordan Jensen: Take Me with You
overview: In her hilarious debut special, Jordan Jensen delivers unapologetic takes on failing at femininity, the paradox that is “self love” and the horrors of trying to find it.
title: Jordan Jensen: Take Me with You

overview: An at-home tutorial with “The Bunny Groomer” explores the agony and ecstasy of pursuing your passion.
title: How to Groom Your Rabbit

overview: When a young country boy becomes of age, he must face his family's rite of passage.
title: Wild Cherry

overview: The complex power of the hijab, and how a seemingly simple piece of cloth embodies both what the wearer imbues it with and what society project onto to it, through the lens of two different young women.
title: Headbang

overview: Roger is a mortician who, when examining the body of a beautiful young woman named Eve, finds himself faced with an internal crisis that sends him on a dreamlike journey.
title: Kamasutra Cowgirl

overview: An Indigenous ballerina attempts to reignite her passion for dancing following a traumatic incident with her previous coach.
title: Niimi

overview: Elodie makes her San Siro debut with "The Stadium Show." A comprehensive artistic performance combining music, dance, and visual arts, promoting messages of freedom.
title: Elodie - The Stadium Show

overview: "Only a Few Fans" is a documentary that delves into the often-glamorized world of OnlyFans, shedding light on the stark realities faced by many creators. Through a series of intimate interviews with women and men involved in the platform, the film exposes the financial struggles, mental and physical tolls, and the exploitative nature of the industry.
title: Only a Few Fans

overview: After getting married and having a son, a middle-aged man finally comes out as gay and divorces his wife. At his son’s wedding, the son invites his gay friends, but hesitates to invite his father as it may take time to bridge the distance between them.
title: Delay

overview: If twelve-year-old Karl had been able to choose who he fell in love with, it would not have been the much taller Lea from his class. Now he doesn't have much time to fnd out whether Lea can reciprocate his feelings. After the summer holidays, she will change schools​.
title: Tomorrow I'll Be Brave

overview: After learning to 'write what you know,' in film school, Half-Filipino and Half-White aspiring filmmaker Andrew Orticio travels back to his father's village in the Philippines to understand his mixed identity.
tagline: Whatever Happens, Happens
title: Bahala Na

overview: Until recently, there was a village called Alekseyevka in the Khachmaz region of Azerbaijan. Alekseyevka was an international homeland for everyone who lived there. After the collapse of the USSR, local residents began to move to other regions of the world for various personal reasons. The film's heroines Larisa and Nina meet in Alekseyevka (now Chaykenary) and try to feel the warmth of the past again.
title: My Home

overview: During a total solar eclipse, four girls visit a mysterious witch's house looking for a magical ritual. But something goes wrong and they find themselves trapped in a dimensional limbo where the Soulcatcher rules... And only one can get out of there alive.
title: Soulcatcher

overview: The plot follows Rique, a famous writer who begins to experience the characters from his unfinished book. Lígia, a publisher in crisis, tries to help him finish the work, while Bruna, a young woman with schizophrenia, fantasizes about a relationship with the writer.
title: Self

overview: In an ancient family mansion, mother Sydia and daughter Nina spend a tense night of isolation just as a solar storm threatens to collapse the Earth’s gravity. What begins as a fraught domestic moment quickly shifts when a mysterious visitor, Lara, arrives, and the house’s long‑missing employee, Joana, returns with disturbing news from the outside world. As the cosmic and terrestrial crises gather, the four women are forced to face buried secrets, generational trauma and shifting power dynamics. Their physical refuge becomes a battleground of psychological and symbolic upheaval, where the end of the world becomes mirror to the end of the old order — and perhaps the beginning of something new.
title: Gravidade

overview: Romila, Anand and guide Papa Buka journey through Papua New Guinea's remote villages, documenting WWII veterans' vivid memories of fighting against Japan, facing unexpected challenges along their quest.
title: Papa Buka

overview: Humberto Ortiz, a frustrated journalist, becomes obsessed with discovering what happened one early morning in November, when Maribel Angarita allegedly murdered her usual attacker, his partner Rafael. The investigation of what appears to be a simple chronicle becomes an elusive metaphor for the conflict of an entire country.
tagline: Not everything is what it seems
title: Fragmentos

original_title: 刘德华  今天.is the Day  抖音线上演唱会
title: 刘德华  今天.is the Day  抖音线上演唱会

overview: A man in his forties, afflicted with amnesia, crosses paths with a woman who was once his first love. Though no memories of her resurface, he is carried away by a feeling that runs deeper than the boundaries of his memory.
title: Cold?

overview: Ahana is a powerful story of a young author who challenges patriarchal norms and breaks free from societal expectations. As the film boldly addresses male infertility, Ahana's journey becomes one of self-discovery, courage, and reclaiming her identity.
tagline: The Light Within
title: Ahana

overview: "Ice and White Blood" is a suspense film that tells the story of forestry inspector Zhang Jun who is accidentally involved in the attack on actress Zhang Ziqi at the Ice Resort. In his search for the truth, characters such as the resort owner, the owner's wife, a writer, a ski instructor, a deer farm owner, and a racing driver appear one after another. They all have a love-hate relationship with Zhang Ziqi, and each of them seems to have a motive for attacking her. Zhang Jun unravels the truth bit by bit and finds the real culprit who attacked the actress.
title: Blood Icicle

overview: A rebellious student sparks a transformative journey for a traditional Chinese teacher. Confronted by Xiaohua, a defiant pupil in his writing class, Teacher Ma's conventional methods are challenged. On the verge of conflict, they discover unexpected common ground, catalyzing a profound change in their lives and the constrictive educational system. As the academic year draws to a close, a blossoming of creativity and understanding unfolds, heralding the rebirth of a teacher.
title: Hello, Spring

original_title: Si no ardemos, cómo iluminar la noche
overview: 13-year-old Laura feels adrift in her newly stitched-together family. Just as the forests and endless palm plantations begin to feel like home, she uncovers a lurking secret that threatens the women she holds close.
title: If We Don't Burn, How Do We Light Up the Night

overview: The plot follows a couple isolated on a sort of farm. Without internet or television, they prepare a game of seduction, where the main weapon is gastronomy. Cooking for each other, the characters reveal their secrets.
title: Mouth Watering

overview: Diagnosed with Alzheimer’s, Abhi sets out to fulfill his mother’s last wish of visiting the Char Dham before she loses her memory completely.
title: Charidham - A Journey Within

overview: This documentary, set against the backdrop of Busan's daytime party Club Insomnia, explores why we feel the need to party and connect with others. Ultimately, it seeks to convey a simple yet fundamental truth-that every moment of selecting, playing, and listening to music is an act of love and joy.
title: Club insomnia : Vinyl

overview: In this short film, in search of a cinematic grammar more in tune with Creole imaginary and oral tradition, we follow Ondine's quest. She returns to La Réunion after an absence of four years, because her Pépé, a local zarboutan, is dying. Just as she has to say goodbye, Ondine has a strange encounter in a pond.
title: Lo Chan Lo Bassin

overview: A father travels through five stages of grief after discovering that his wife is having an affair. The father is portrayed by five different actors and actresses.
tagline: THE ONLY WAY IS THROUGH
title: Stadier af sorg

overview: Finding shelter in an abandoned mansion, a group faces the challenges of coexistence. Free from traditional power structures, the black women experience power, love, and the possibility of dreaming about the future, while the white women resist learning to help with household chores, take care of themselves, and face their mistakes. When an old threat resurfaces, however, they all must band together to survive.
title: Four Girls

original_title: The Case Against Adnan Syed (Special Episode)
overview: During a year-long investigation led by Adnan's new lawyer Erica J. Suter and Baltimore State's Attorney Marilyn Mosby, new revelations expose flaws in the original prosecution. As other potential suspects, suppressed witness testimony, and untested crime scene DNA come to light, a legal and political tug of war ensues, thrusting Adnan into chaotic uncertainty.
title: The Case Against Adnan Syed (Special Episode)

overview: A devoted immigrant mother sets out to deliver a birthday cake to her son, but as the day unravels, she is forced to confront the reality of her son’s situation.
title: Year of the Dragon

original_title: うみねこのなく頃に～Stage of the golden Witch～ Episode 6
overview: The Sixth Episode of Umineko When They Cry adaptation in stage play, produced by Shingidan.
title: When the Seagulls Cry ～Stage of the golden Witch～ Episode 6

overview: The world knows the image of the good Canadian. But what if there was a dark secret behind a national identity? THE GOOD CANADIAN exposes the truth behind the idea of a True North strong and free. In this unflinching and eye-opening documentary, directors Leena Minifie and David Paperny move us through the corridors of systemic inequity, from the Indian Act to residential schools, to modern-day family separation. Fusing shocking footage with detailed interviews with experts, advocates, whistleblowers and politicians, THE GOOD CANADIAN challenges national myth-making, while offering Canadians the chance to forge a new identity from the truth.
tagline: Behind every myth is the truth; behind every inequity is a system; behind them all is…THE GOOD CANADIAN.
title: The Good Canadian

overview: An overwhelmed man struggles to keep up with all the noise in his world when his hearing begins to fall one second out of sync.
tagline: Don't Fall Behind...
title: One Second

overview: On his own initiative, Hélio da Silva transformed a neglected area in his neighborhood by planting thousands of trees, creating the Tiquatira Linear Park. It is São Paulo's first linear park and stands as one of the largest of its kind in the world.
title: The Planter

overview: A community police officer is assigned as first party secretary to push an old-neighborhood renewal. He wins residents’ trust but collapses from overwork; his family honors his wish to donate organs, turning “small” neighborly issues into a truly big deal.
title: Big Deal

original_title: ミュージカル「黒執事」～緑の魔女と人狼の森～
overview: England, 19th Century — Sebastian Michaelis, the loyal butler of the distinguished Phantomhive family, works alongside his 13-year-old master, Ciel Phantomhive as the “Queen’s Watchdog,” carrying out the dirty work of the underworld on Her Majesty’s behalf. When a string of inexplicable deaths in Germany draws the Queen’s attention, Sebastian and Ciel are dispatched to uncover the truth. Their investigation leads them deep into the ominous “Forest of Werewolves,” a place rumored to kill anyone who dares to set foot within. But as they dig deeper into the mystery, a dreadful curse begins to take hold.
title: Musical 「Kuroshitsuji」 -Emerald Witch and Werewolves’ Forest-

overview: A determined reporter probes the mysterious death of a woman who fell from a building, only to uncover a dangerous coven of witches intent on making her their fourth member. The only one who can stop them is warlock William Spanner.
title: Witchcraft XVII: The Initiation

overview: ‘Zmęczone’ is a comedy drama about three female employees of the administration, promotion and education department of a provincial theatre, who decide to write and stage a play in protest against the mobbing they experience from the incompetent artistic management.
title: Zmęczone

overview: The revolutions that swept Latin America in the second half of the 20th century owe much to the participation of millions of Christians who engaged in political struggles in the name of their faith, paying a heavy toll for undermining the traditional relationship between the Church and power. Driven by Liberation theology, they challenged military regimes and oligarchies, risking their lives. Far from Marx's idea of religion as 'opium of the people', here the people fought for the advent of the Kingdom of God on Earth, rather than in Heaven.
title: The Gospel of Revolution

overview: Elliott's daily journey leads him to face his inner child. As he processes deep emotions, mental affirmations guide him toward healing and self-worth.
title: Black Man, Black Man

overview: In the future human beings are abandoning planet earth. This animated short story captures the final journey of three animals who are left behind.
title: After Us

overview: Wes and Kyra is a story about a vampire couple in New York City who rent a room for three days to drown out their addiction, face the toxicity in their relationship, and grapple with the idea of death as it circles all around them.
tagline: Some addictions run deeper than others.
title: Wes and Kyra

overview: Samantha Moon, A young woman who lives by herself in the city must confront her past and future through her dreams whilst being stalked by a mysterious entity…
tagline: Reliving the past in your dreams… What about your future?
title: Beautiful Dreams

overview: NXT TV SPECIAL
title: WWE NXT Homecoming

overview: K-9INE! follows Roy, a recently retired Police dog handler. His routine takes an unexpected turn when he invites Tea Leaf, a shoplifting door-to-door salesman into his home.
title: K-9INE!

overview: Twenty minutes of excerpts from the film, still in progress, that Franco Maresco dedicates to his dearest mentor, Goffredo Fofi, who passed away last July. Pressed by the director, the intellectual from Gubbio, Umbria, in central Italy — who considered Palermo his university of life and activism — lets out a courageous confession, recalling the crucial moments of his unparalleled human, cultural and political experience.
title: Goffredo felicissimo?

overview: An intimate portrait of fishing as a refuge and companion, where bonds and absences intertwine with the river. Norma Alonso reveals how, despite time, memory endures beyond the last hook.
tagline: MEMORY ENDURES BEYOND THE LAST HOOK
title: El último anzuelo

original_title: Radio 2 in the Park 2025: Bryan Adams
overview: Canadian rock superstar Bryan Adams headlines Saturday night in Chelmsford at Radio 2 in the Park 2025. Featuring all the greatest hits alongside tracks from his studio album Roll with the Punches.  Bryan has cemented his status as a global music icon with over four decades of hits, topping the charts in over 40 countries. He has received multiple music honours, including a Grammy, Juno Awards, a Hollywood Walk of Fame Star, plus Academy and Golden Globe nominations.
title: Radio 2 in the Park 2025: Bryan Adams

original_title: Mord im Revier - Die tote Braut
title: Mord im Revier - Die tote Braut

overview: Late summer. For Iga, a young woman in her late twenties, it is a time of daydreaming and chasing an idealized notion of happiness. She decides to drive to Scotland by car. When she meets Ethan, a 30-year-old Englishman, on the way and joins him on the journey, she begins to understand herself better and questions her goals.
title: Sugarland

overview: Under the influence of tragic circumstances, the young woman is forced separate with her husband. While doing ordinary things and maintaining contact with her lover, she tries to overcome her fear and despair. Will she be able to cope with her feelings if the connection is lost?
title: My Closet

overview: Vivian and Harold's camping trip reveals their tensions, leading to a life-or-death situation as they confront their past.
title: Blueberry Grunt

original_title: Zwei Frauen für alle Felle - Väter und Töchter
title: Zwei Frauen für alle Felle - Väter und Töchter

overview: Tensions rise as a young girl (Polly Gallant-MacLean) creeps through the stillness and shadows of her home. Certain that she has discovered a monster under her bed, she seeks her father's help.
title: Sweetie

overview: Over 40 years ago, filmmaker Min Sook Lee’s mother died by suicide. Using her camera, Lee explores long-held silences, unstable memories and unforgettable truths, attempting to understand what happened.
title: There Are No Words

overview: After regaining control of his mental health, Damien is eager to reconnect with Liana, his girlfriend of three years, minus a two-month break. But just as he's ready to make his triumphant return, something stops him. Something not quite human.
title: Selfless

overview: Pak Ki returns to his village after 35 years to atone for his past sins, but unknowingly falls in love with the son of the man he once killed. Sukma, meanwhile, cares deeply for Pak Ki without knowing the truth. When the secret is revealed, love is tested and vengeance ignites. All Pak Ki longs for is forgiveness before death comes for him.
title: Lembayung Senja

overview: Two rivals betrayed by the same man become feuding friends who compete for a photographer, only to abandon the toxic chase and realize true female solidarity and self-worth.
title: Bestie Rivals

overview: A vocational school student is driven to take revenge on the bully who ruined his best friend's life and ended the terror of school bullying.
title: LIBAS

overview: Journalist Catriona MacPhee goes undercover as a cleaner at Castlehill Care Home in the Scottish Highlands, spending around seven weeks in the role. The documentary reveals deeply troubling conditions: neglect of basic care tasks, inattention to residents, inadequately followed care plans, staff shortages, unsanitary conditions, emotional distress among residents, and instances of intimidation or mistreatment.  The film aims not only to expose failings at Castlehill but to raise broader questions about care home regulation, staffing, dignity, and accountability in the care sector.
title: Care Home Undercover

overview: A bigoted Chinese grandfather having to look after his biracial grandson at the onset of a global pandemic lockdown
tagline: A bigoted Chinese grandfather must look after his biracial gradson at the onset of the global pandemic lockdown
title: The Manggis in Ah Gong's Hands

overview: Documentary filmmaker Rupert Tothington chronicles the troubled production of famed director Maximillian Silverstein's latest feature film.
tagline: DON'T. STOP. FILMING.
title: Hikes Of Darkness

overview: Filmmaker Martijn Blekendaal thinks there should be a superhero for invisible children: kids who need to be invisible because otherwise their lives are in danger. In The Invisible Ones he tells the stories of four children—some of whom are now 85 years old—who learned to master the art of going unnoticed. This is something he learned to do in his own life.
title: The Invisible Ones

original_title: Menjelang Magrib 2: Wanita Yang di Rantai
overview: In 1920s Dutch East Indies, Giandra, a young doctor from STOVIA, reads about Layla—a girl shackled in a remote village as a "cure" for mental illness. Disturbed, he travels to Karuhun, where tradition and mysticism prevail over science. Guided by journalist Rikke, who warns him with three words—Culture. Mysticism. Superstition.—Giandra must confront a clash between modern medicine and ancestral belief.
title: Before Night Falls 2

original_title: Poutine et la guerre des cinq mers
title: Poutine et la guerre des cinq mers

overview: Separated from his wife and unborn child by the outbreak, Matt struggles to escape the military and evade growing throngs of the undead. When he finally manages to escape, he flees to a remote family cottage - one where his wife told him she would be - only to find the cabin deserted.
tagline: DO NOT ATTEMPT TO TRAVEL
title: The Fortunate Ones

original_title: Tiệm Cầm Đồ: Có Chơi Có Chịu
overview: A self-sacrificing mother and a rebellious son—each with their own reasons, rights, and wrongs. Yet no matter what, a mother is always the place to return.
title: Tiệm Cầm Đồ: Có Chơi Có Chịu

overview: Returning home from an undercover mission, top agent Jane Bond believes the ruthless terrorist organisation SPECTRE has infiltrated MI6. Can Bond and Q get to the bottom of this dastardly plot before its too late?
tagline: Nobody does it better
title: Jane Bond

overview: Fearing him suicidal after a breakup, Daniel Boyd rushes to check on his buddy John who's holed up in the sketchiest motel this side of the Raritan River. There they find their understanding of love, friendship, and the world tested by the barrel of a gun.
tagline: Everyone needs one friendship that's locked and loaded.
title: Click Click

overview: Fresh out of jail, a woman fights to rebuild her life and mend a broken relationship. But a deadly mistake ties her to a violent past, forcing her to face guilt, consequences, and the harsh truth that some choices can never be undone.
title: The Fastlane 2: Hittin' Houses

overview: Through their stories, five women construct a collective portrait of desire, giving body and voice to that which we tend to keep silent.
title: The Voice of desire

overview: Hülya and Mustafa try to organize their tent life so that their children can continue with their lives. The youngest child, İbo, is an exuberant boy full of joy. Having suddenly become homeless, he has also tasted the freedom of being able to go out to the streets at any moment, and prefers to spend all his time playing outside instead of going to school. Neither İbo nor his family are fully aware of the traumatic impact of homelessness. They act as if they had always lived in a tent, behaving as though everything were perfectly normal. They believe that their life in the tent is temporary and spend their days making plans to build a new home. From a distance, they appear ordinary, just like any happy family. However, as time passes quickly, their plans gradually give way to despair.
tagline: Without a house, man would be a dispersed being.
title: House

overview: En silencio has no interviews, spotlights or contrived sagas. When an injury rules him out of the European Championships, Isco Alarcón trains away from the noise. Sara Sálamo films from the closest intimacy, while the camera listens to what isn't said. The rhythm of the wounded body also marks the narration: at first slowly, later obstinately. An independent film proposal combining the emotion of sport with the intimacy of the human portrait.
title: Silent Struggle

overview: Set in a speculative future on Turtle Island, where ancestral dreams and visions shape reality, the film follows the poetic journey of the Welcomer, a vessel of First Nations resilience, and the Arrivant, a traveller from the African diaspora. The Welcomer, reflecting on the echoes of a past reshaped by colonization, envisions a future liberated from its violence. The Arrivant, seeking a place to anchor their journey through time and space, is drawn to the Welcomer’s vision.
tagline: In a speculative future, a First Nations Welcomer and an Arrivant from the African Diaspora redefine first contact, weaving a tapestry of solidarity and healing through their poetic exchange.
title: Can You Feel It Now?

overview: In the 1950s, Singapore’s transgender community began to settle in the Bugis street area. Attracted by the street reputation as “the Montmartre of Singapore”, tourists and sailors from all over the world came to enjoy themselves until dawn, sometimes being seduced by trans women dressed like divas. In the early 1980s, an urban renovation project planned to demolish the area.
title: Twilight Ladies

overview: It follows a boy who, during the 2020 lockdown, loses his mother to suicide and learns to survive the pain between solitude, fear and love.
title: Up to Here, Is Everything Good?

overview: For over a decade, Christopher Harkins presented himself as a charming, charismatic, and successful businessman searching for his perfect match. Using dating apps, he targeted attractive, intelligent, and career-driven women, swiftly drawing them into intense relationships
title: Catching the Tinder Predator

overview: While desperately trying to finish his movie, a young filmmaker must face the imminent death of his father.
title: Capharnaüm

overview: Blending stop-motion animation and silent film, a new narrative unfolds. The story follows a stubborn "tooth mouse" who clings to the past, and a restless "shark girl" who only chase the future. Their paths collide in a fierce, ritualistic battle on an altar. Can the mouse accept change while protecting what's dear? Can the shark acknowledge the weight of memory while relentlessly pursuing the future? This confrontation will ultimately lead them toward a "fatal growth", where both must destroy their old selves to be reborn.
title: Miceseek

overview: Two inseparable friends dream of escaping the monotony of their small Patagonian town and exploring the world. To fund their trip, they start selling marijuana, but what first seemed like a fun adventure soon turns into a spiral of danger and betrayal.
title: Verano Trippin

overview: In 2003, actress Marie Trintignant died after being beaten by her partner Bertrand Cantat. The singer was sentenced to eight years in prison. Once released, Cantat attempted to return to the spotlight. It was an almost impossible comeback, especially since his first wife, Kristina Rady, committed suicide under mysterious circumstances. Who is Bertrand Cantat really? And how does he live today?
title: Bertrand Cantat : Noir Destin

overview: In a nuke story that takes place in post-blast Los Angeles, three couples gather for a final candlelit dinner. As time creeps to a halt—literally—they share stories, some regrets, a bunch of humor, and, fittingly, love.
title: Until the Silence

overview: After a brutal battle, two knights wander a field of the dead, searching for the body of a fallen noble. As silence thickens and faith begins to decay, they face not just the weight of death, but the absence of divine order.
tagline: No tears left to wash this sin
title: ...and God was Silent

overview: Google's AI on Screen program's inaugural short film.
title: Sweetwater

overview: On the last night of his grandmother’s funeral, a young boy named Kang falls into a pit dug as a burial site. There, he encounters a giant serpent.
title: The Wishes

original_title: Jean-Pierre Elkabbach, autoportrait de mon père
overview: A witness to the history of the Fifth Republic for more than half a century, Jean-Pierre Elkabbach left his mark on the profession of radio and television journalism. This film tells the story of the man and his career through the voice of his daughter, Emmanuelle Bach, and previously unpublished private interviews recorded shortly before his death in 2023. It offers a portrait of this hyperactive, versatile, demanding, and inventive journalist, and reveals the private man: funny, sensitive, warm, and secretive. Emmanuelle Bach recounts with tenderness and humor her father, absorbed by his consuming passion for journalism, and with whom she struggled to find her place.
title: Jean-Pierre Elkabbach, autoportrait de mon père

overview: After his college entrance examination, an 18-year-old young man decides to follow his 40-year-old uncle to the west to earn some money for his college life. They drive a Jeep across three provinces. Only when they arrive at their destination does he find out that he is taking part in an illegal deal. Over the course of three days, he experiences the cruellest coming of age.
title: On the Road

overview: Carlos is approaching midlife trapped in a personal crisis that has lingered too long. Rosa, his mother, suffers from disabling pain that is only mitigated by the warm waters of hydrotherapy. One night, she offers to make the ultimate sacrifice so that they can both transit to a better place. A short film about love, hope and relief we all long for.
title: Reliefs

overview: Artist Lisa, who lacks color vision, breaks up with her boyfriend. She paints vibrant pictures and works with her dog as a support worker for special needs children at an orphanage. One autumn, on a bridge, Lisa meets Mark—a young, successful, but tired and jaded man who jumps into the cold water every year on this day, hoping to feel something.
title: Крыша

original_title: Bir Arkadaş İçin; Saklı Arzuların  Hikayesi
overview: A shop that everyone knows, but no one dares to step into...  "FOR A FRIEND", an absurd dark comedy about neighborhood culture, hidden desires, and social taboos.  This short film reveals the hidden world behind Enver’s seemingly ordinary life.
tagline: Film
title: For a Friend: A Tale of Hidden Desires

overview: His scars form the starting point of her research trip to track down the young people crushed by the military putsch of September 12th, 1980. The dream of Turkish democracy in pieces, the way to an authoritarian regime and political Islam already paved.
title: Scars of a Putsch

overview: Robin, a boy who lives with his grandparents and his older sister, finds an old book of his late mother about soil science that will change his life. Drugs and inter-family conflicts will cause Robin to start having nightmares in which the soil will order him to commit a terrible act.
tagline: "Edaphology, soil science."
title: Soils

overview: When an introverted chemistry student investigates her brother disappearance in a remote part of Colombia, she encounters mysterious villagers, who will stop at nothing to protect their deadly secret. It seems tonight may be the night for Jane when she and her friends are hunted by a strange, massive,  force known only as The Dux.
tagline: FIVE WOMEN. ONE DUX. NO ESCAPE.
title: Last to Die

overview: The Holocaust began with the indiscriminate mass shootings by the Einsatzgruppen in the bloodlands of Eastern Europe and was perfected in the gas chambers at Auschwitz. “Bullets And Blueberries” explores the motives, methods and madness of the perpetrators, using never-before-seen images captured by the killers themselves — images that fully capture the banality of evil.
tagline: The Hidden Holocaust
title: Bullets And Blueberries

overview: Maya Litvak is a woman at the end of her rope. Just when she thinks she's got it figured out, her ex-girlfriend shows up and turns everything on its head.
title: Rabbit Rabbit

overview: Athens, April of 1967.  During the first days of the military dictatorship, Loukas is suffocating in his family's apartment, which he is not allowed to leave. He then invents a new game that connects him to the outside world: answering the telephone. But the house's phone line gets mixed up with that of the Studio cinema...
title: The First Image

overview: An industrial accident at a robotics lab causes a malfunctioning unit to go rogue and begin to terrorize the city. Two hardened cops, Callahan and Ward, are assigned to the case and must stop the homicidal robot.
title: Robocidal

overview: Desperate to lose weight, a young woman grapples with the ravenous demons eating her up inside.
tagline: She's losing it.
title: Thick Skin

overview: When a budding girl is tasked with identifying the different parts of a flower, she unexpectedly confronts probing questions about her own body.
tagline: Excited ka na bang magka-pollen?
title: Blooming!

original_title: Gold Hearts of Hot Rod County
overview: In a small farm town, a free-spirited teenage girl and a dangerously irresistible bad boy ignite a rebellious spark that shakes up the rural landscape. A coming-of-age story inspired by the magic of 80's and 90's feel-good cinema classics with a "life stuck inside a tractor commercial" twist.
title: Gold Hearts of Hot Rod County

overview: After giving her little brother a stuffed animal that comes with an online counterpart, a teenage girl notices some sinister changes in his behavior.
tagline: There's nothing wrong with a little screen time.
title: Morty

overview: Returning to his hometown to claim an inheritance from his estranged mother, Ben Marsh and his partner, Sam, find themselves entangled in the mad prophecies of the town's Charismatic leader, Pastor Deenan.
title: God Country

overview: After the death of her mother, a woman is tormented by memories of her childhood, and nightmares.
title: Mother's Favorite

overview: Two guys trying to survive in the woods in an apocalyptic world, until they both get attacked by an infected. They only have one cure, so one must die and one must live.
title: The Last Decision

overview: When an elusive society agrees to be interviewed, a journalist must contend with their ideologies or risk falling prey herself. In a tumultuous Fall of 1969, Lydia, a spry young journalist searches for a story and a name for herself. This obsession brings her to the Sonder Society, a private collective on the edge of town with a strange way of presenting themselves. When invited to a private dinner, Lydia learns more of the Society's strange manners and of her own sense of self.
tagline: Have You Lost Your Sense of Self?
title: Sensus Mori

overview: In the retro-futuristic city of New Chicago, brothers Jack and Ollie take on their latest high-stakes heist: stealing from a greedy CEO, Bon Keiser. Their target is the "STAR," a mysterious and powerful energy source housed in Keiser's skyscraper. As the CEO hosts a lavish party to unveil his newest invention, the brothers attempt their break-in. Can they pull it off before the night ends?
title: The Great STAR Caper

overview: An excavational inquiry through photographs, touch, and looking at times and places far from here and now, animating and conjuring a link between past and present.
title: Noli me tangere

Armies formed from eating scraps emerge, ready for battle, with powerful weapons fashioned from air, through the effort of their sheer will, realizing that the foe isn't the force it seemed.  The fourth film in Jonni Pepper-GoLions' "The Blindfold" series, which includes her films "Wasteland", "Secrets and Lies in a Town of Sinners", and "Barber Westchester". title: Merian C. Cooper, le dernier conquérant

In the end, they end up wishing for each other’s lives. The next morning, they wake up to find that their souls have swapped bodies. As they search for a way to return to their own lives, they face the challenges of each other’s circumstances and begin to appreciate their own lives.

overview: Yoshiko loses her beloved cat. Upon discovering it, her neighbour Hotaru joins her in holding a quiet, heartfelt funeral. This small event becomes the catalyst for the family to come together once more. For their own reasons, Yoshiko's three daughters return to the family home one by one, resuming life under the same roof. During their time together, the initial distance and unspoken tensions slowly give way to understanding. Thirty years of misunderstandings begin to dissolve through shared daily moments: quiet conversations in the kitchen, silent gestures at the dining table, and afternoons spent tending the garden. Each ordinary act brings a renewed sense of warmth and connection.

overview: Paris, 1794. overview: My brother passed away in 2013 and my parents hold opposing beliefs about where he went after death. In search of answers, I turn to spiritual professionals, hoping they might offer real clues to the question: Where'd My Brother Go?

tagline: No one is inoccent
title: Villa Benavente

overview: Due to a misunderstanding, Mickaël ends up with a lawnmower he doesn’t need. Little by little, the young man starts getting used to the presence of this slightly bulky machine in his small apartment. Things get complicated when Elodie, the owner of the machine, becomes determined to get it back at all costs.
title: Tondeuz

overview: For decades, Transalpina Square in Gorizia marked the dividing line between two different Nations and cultures. Alongside this segment of the Italy-Slovenia border, tragic events took place, though dreams and hopes persevered. It is thanks to those hopes and dreams that the separating wall was eventually torn down and the border was finally crossed.
title: Confini, canti

overview: In the northeastern corner of Poland, on the edge of a lake, stands a house of women – mothers, daughters, and sisters. From generation to generation, the women pass down their inaccessibility, steadfastness, and family secrets. Twenty-year-old Łucja will be able to begin an independent life only when she confronts the truth about her family.  An old clarinet leads Łucja to a story long erased from the pages of a family album.
title: Clarinet

overview: Harun, a Kurdish freedom fighter, is haunted by the memories of war that have left him with post-traumatic stress, and burdened by a profound guilt. In an effort to seek solace, his friend takes him to see a group of Yarsan musicians (an ancient Kurdish religious group), who believe that their sacred Tanbur music can soothe the soul and cure illness. When the music cannot alleviate the burden of war from Harun’s heart, he is guided to Maryam, a traditional Kurdish tattooist who lives in a remote village located in the Triangle of Borders region, where Iran, Iraq, and Turkey cross. When Harun eventually opens up about his past, his memories intertwine with those of the village, and more is subsequently unveiled.
title: Harsh Land and Distant Sky

overview: Tony and Linda are struggling to grow their family. When Tony is forced to face his fertility issues, he turns to a mysterious oyster dealer, Marvin, whose oysters deliver more than their promise of virility.
title: Pearls

overview: The end of a relationship becomes a search for serenity.

During a weekend dedicated to creating a new album, the pressure to make something commercially viable and the fear of failure bring out insecurities and resentments. Faced with the conflict between ambition and love, they will have to decide if it is still possible to reconcile their careers with their relationship.

title: Murder Me

title: Lights Out

overview: In a small town outside of Manila in 2017, a laundromat owner's son finds his missing classmate's ID in a police uniform's dirty laundry.
title: City's Laundry and Taxes

overview: Asunción and Mari Carmen are two young women who aspire to a position in the Women's Section, but the Beatles' visit to Spain has another destiny in store for them.
title: All You Need Is Love

overview: Following the disappearance of her girlfriend a trans filmmaker discovers EmileCam, a 24-hour livestream which had been devoted to spying on her.
title: Emile is Missing

overview: Ten years have passed since the Sewol ferry disaster. The life of KIM Dong-soo, who came back alive from the disaster, has changed a lot from before. KIM Dong-soo, who used to live as a truck driver, lost his truck in a disaster and now guards the Hallasan trail everyday. He is repeatedly hospitalized and discharged from the psychiatric ward and suffers from pain all over his body. Still, he struggles to restore his daily life by participating in the marathon event. KIM Dong-soo's wife, KIM Hyung-sook, and his two daughters support him in his daily life. The eyes looking at KIM Dong-soo with a desperate expression, asking for help, revive every moment and shake his heart, but he still lives by holding the hands of his family who stand by his side.
title: Relay Race

overview: At dawn on October 7, 2023, thousands of Israelis were awakened by a seemingly routine rocket terror attack from Gaza. Within a few hours, their world would change forever. Using personal accounts of the fates of seven survivors, the documentary reconstructs the darkest day in modern Israeli history, when 3,000 Hamas terrorists and their murderous followers invaded civilian communities in southern Israel, stormed an electronic music festival, and killed 1,195 people. Among the contemporary witnesses who speak is Yuval Raphael, a survivor of the Nova Music Festival massacre, who had to hide among corpses in an air raid shelter and, after overcoming the trauma, will represent Israel at the 2025 Eurovision Song Contest with her magnificent singing voice. But Mazal Tazazo, Millet Ben Haim, Hadar Or Elmakias, Guillermo Rochman, Guido Kohan and Shye Weinstein also describe their sad experiences.
title: Saturday October 7

original_title: คนกราบโลมา

tagline: Dolphins owe no explanation

overview: Madagascar, nowadays. Kwame, 20, struggles to make a living in the clandestine sapphire mines. An unexpected event takes him back to his hometown. As he reunites with his mother and old friends, he finds himself confronted with the rampant corruption plaguing his country. He will have to choose between easy money and loyalty, between individualism and political awakening.
title: Disco Afrika: A Malagasy Story

overview: A mysterious character engages a combination of street artists and mountain alpinists for an unthinkable project located in the Oberland summits of Switzerland. An extraordinary vertical odyssey.

overview: Alex is a dazzling young French EDM artist who’s in Japan to shoot music videos for her new album. During the shooting, she gets close to her pretty Japanese assistant Mia. The burgeoning love story is suddenly stopped when the director decides to shoot Mia instead of her. As jealousy settles stronger and stronger, little by little Alex falls into paranoid madness…
title: Silent Shot

overview: Frank Paine, is a 73-year-old South Bay icon and humble local legend whose life orbits around a two-block stretch of beach. His unforgettable mustache and magnetic spirit are what most first notice, but Frank’s layers expose a depth that might answer some questions that surfers continually ask themselves. Surfing, which, for some, becomes lost in isolation, is made whole again with Frank.
title: To Be Frank

overview: Chris, an overworked cleaner, is one work-time nap away from losing his job. Desperate to stay employed, he goes to extreme measures to secure the one thing that can save him from the sack: more sleep.
title: Sleep

overview: “SABU” is an intimate documentary that follows the enigmatic career of professional wrestler Sabu as he seeks closure in his storied life—a final match. From his tumultuous upbringing under the influence of The Sheik to the electrifying days of ECW, Sabu reflects on his evolution as a performer and the extreme style that defined his legacy. The film captures the highs and lows of his journey, including personal challenges, injuries, and the emotional turmoil that shaped him both inside and outside the ring.
title: Sabu

overview: Mino is an average white Dutch boy. But when a kid mocks him with slanted eyes, and he gets called a fucking Chinese at the restaurant where he works, disbelief and doubt begin to creep in. His parents insist that he’s ‘just Dutch’, like them. After a heated confrontation, Mino undergoes a transformation, and in this graduation film, for the first time he sees what he really looks like. A comic thriller, based on the filmmaker’s own experiences, about racism and the alienating moment of realising your appearance doesn’t match the culture you’ve grown up in your whole life.
tagline: A naïve employee at a Chinese restaurant is mistaken for being Asian, even though he considers himself just a white Dutch guy. A comic thriller about a disorienting search for one’s true identity.
title: The Takeaway

overview: Elena is 19 years old, heartbroken, and full of uncertainty. She is struck by a profile she finds online, beautiful, seductive, and able to understand her.

overview: Set against suburban South Africa, twin brothers Peter and Paul grapple with identity, belonging, and silent expectations at an elite boys’ school — until one’s reckless bid for acceptance triggers a rupture with devastating, irreversible consequences for them both.

overview: Seeking refuge from their anxieties and menial problems that haunt them at home, two girls from Miami take a last minute surfing trip to Nicaragua.

overview: When an old friend takes his own life, Alan Zweig seeks out others grappling with the suicide of a loved one. As hard as it can be to speak of such an unfathomable loss, more than 20 friends and acquaintances feel compelled to tell their stories. Zweig engages with them as only he can-reflecting with disarming candour on the grief and resilience of those left standing. Love, Harold is a profound gesture of cinematic empathy from one of Canada's most distinctive filmmakers.
tagline: Shocked by a friend's suicide, renowned documentary filmmaker Alan Zweig seeks understanding from more than 20 individuals grieving a similar loss.
title: Love, Harold

overview: Sampaguita, a fabulous drag queen, moonlights as a hired killer to earn extra money and provide a good life for her talented daughter and sickly mother. Just when she thought she could handle any contract killing mission, her new target tests how far she can go to support her loved ones.

A woman from the Baden provinces who held her own in the male-dominated world of US hip-hop and became a key figure in a global cultural phenomenon. The documentary tells the story of an unusual career between metal, grunge, and rap, of family dynamics, chaos on tour, and cultural misunderstandings – but also of loyalty, empowerment, and the question of how a woman can claim her place in a world full of alpha males.
title: Evil-E – Eva Ries and the Wu-Tang Clan

overview: A man has second-thoughts about his relationship on a bikeride home.

overview: For 25 years, world-famous Estonian clowns Haide and Toomas, better known as Piip and Tuut, have brought joy and laughter to children and families across the globe. But behind the face paint and curtain lies a different story. While entertaining thousands, their own children – Emma, Siim, and Anni – have been growing up at home without them. Eldest daughter Emma dreams of following in her parents' footsteps, but balancing her passion for theatre with caring for her autistic brother and younger sister has forced her to grow up fast. Meanwhile, Haide and Toomas grapple with guilt, exhaustion, and the toll of trying to give their all both on stage and at home.
title: My Family and Other Clowns

overview: Jimmy Jaguar, aka Jagu, is a demon who drifts from soul to soul, awakening something dark within. His hosts become vessels of revenge. But whose revenge?
