overview: Every night, Jérôme runs until he is exhausted on an athletics track, while his mother, who is in hospital, struggles to maintain her dignity in the face of her illness, hoping to die in peace. Torn between love and fear of loneliness, he faces an inner struggle that is as physical as it is emotional.
title: Hélianthe

overview: Two brothers navigate their past and repair their relationship after the death of their father.
title: Brothers

overview: Marco grieves over the death of his friend
title: Ghost

overview: A Civil Rights icon shares his remarkable path from pastor to MLK's ally, congressman, UN Ambassador, and Atlanta mayor, revealing the gritty realities of fighting for social change across decades of American history.
tagline: The man behind the movement.
title: Andrew Young: The Dirty Work

overview: A boy with hearing loss, made an outcast by others, makes a friend on a bicycle-taxi they go to school with. But the friend also has problems of his own.
title: Can You Hear Me?

overview: Two boys mysteriously disappear from a dormitory, during christmas. We see the same series of events twice, first as it happened, then how they experienced it.
title: Kairos

overview: After cheating on his girlfriend, a teenage boy finds himself caught up in a web of lies - told entirely over phone calls.
tagline: 3.5 minutes of phone calls with something else at the end
title: The Phone

overview: March. A sudden temperature drop brings the so-called black blizzard to Norilsk – violent, bone-chilling winds that knock people off their feet. With the storm comes an unease that settles among the residents.
title: The Black Blizzard

overview: A documentary about the relationship between international postal workers and their clients.
title: Send and Receive

overview: An overprotective dad has three daughters who all happen to have a date on the same night.
tagline: First impressions matter most
title: Three Dates

overview: Odiyangam traces the origin of the very first Odiyan—a figure woven into Kerala’s folklore—interweaving romance and vengeance with an immersive audiovisual experience .
title: Odiyangam

overview: In this series of shorts, the phrase "Gay Agenda" is reclaimed from the religious right and transformed into a celebration of gay culture. Sit back and enjoy "Boundaries," "Before You Go," and "I Am Not Afraid."
title: The Gay Agenda 35

overview: An indie filmmaker is asked to be a professor's test subject after his main subject goes missing while documenting.
title: Experiment

original_title: J'ai pas les mots, 8 semaines pour sortir de l'illettrisme
overview: In France, 3.7 million people are illiterate. "J'ai pas les mots, 8 semaines pour sortir de l'illettrisme" (I don't have the words, 8 weeks to overcome illiteracy) gives them a face, a voice, and above all, a chance. For eight weeks, seven participants from different backgrounds, all facing illiteracy, will follow an intensive learning program, supervised by trainers and coaches, and accompanied by singer Kendji Girac. Through practical, fun, and realistic workshops, they will tackle everyday challenges. Week after week, these learners will attempt to regain their independence and, above all, their self-confidence. Until the final challenge: writing and reading a personal speech in front of their loved ones.
title: J'ai pas les mots, 8 semaines pour sortir de l'illettrisme

overview: This work tells the story of the daily lives of two ticketing cinema staff during two incidents that sparked the birth of democracy in Jakarta in 1998 and Gwangju in 1980. They never experienced it directly or went onto the streets to face the soldiers, yet the stories they heard and the voices that reached them felt like an endless war film replaying in their minds.
title: Last May in Theaters

overview: A Halloween movie marathon turns deadly when a grieving college student casts a spell that brings the horror films to life, forcing her and her friends to face the trauma head-on or die trying.
title: Horror Spell

overview: Emiliano, a policeman hardened by violence, has raised his children with only one rule: a man does not cry. While he sleeps, his children steal his gun to play, but an accident changes everything.
title: Of Men and Armors

overview: A short film about self-grief and the destructive impact it can have.
title: Nepenthe

overview: On the run in a post-apocalyptic Pacific Northwest, a young woman must choose between a chance with the girl she loves and saving another group member as a deadly threat closes in.
title: The One That Got Away

overview: Can we trust our own memories? An American psychologist with expertise in the brain's ability to make up its own truths takes us into her fascinating field of research.
title: Memory Wars

overview: Gugusse is a gruff lonely man stuck in traffic. A strange bird will male the wait all the more hellish.
title: Gugusse

overview: A story about a girl who wanted to escape her own fear, but accidentally traps herself together with it in a small cabin in the woods. Locked inside four walls, with no way out, she has to deal with hunger, cold and the fear of something that once wanted to hurt her... but now lies dead beside her.
title: Four Walls of Memory

overview: Two friends meet again after a long time apart. Diego sets out to find the truth behind Léo's sudden and long-ago disappearance.
tagline: What is the price of the truth?
title: Remnants

overview: GoodnighTomer is the best stage late night performer in the world!
title: Layla Tomer

overview: Mitch, a 13-year-old tomboy, is confronted with a local custom when she gets her first period. “So you’ll have the strength to bear pain now that you’re a woman,” her grandmother says. Mitch might have taken it the wrong way.
title: Mitch

overview: A twenty-five-year-old man is getting ready to meet a friend, but when an unexpected change disrupts his plans, he falls victim to a convoluted web of rituals and obsessions.
title: Inclosed

overview: Pingpa, a night-shift designer in Bangkok, and Moon-sung, a late-night driver in Seoul. The two are accidentally connected by a misdirected message—and slowly begin to give meaning to each other through an entirely online relationship. But one night, after a minor argument, one of them chooses to vanish from the digital world.
title: five,days

original_title: Disease X: Hunting the Next Pandemic
overview: Virologist Dr Chris van Tulleken embarks on a global investigation into the hunt for the pathogen that could trigger the next pandemic and the cutting-edge science developed to tackle it. Known only as ‘Disease X’, it is shrouded in uncertainty. Its origin is unknown, how it could spread is unclear, but its impact could be much more severe than Covid-19. To uncover what Disease X might be, where it could emerge and what traits it needs to spread, Chris follows the paths of past deadly viruses. He visits the ground zero of the Nipah virus in Malaysia, which inspired the film Contagion. He also heads to the front line of the ongoing bird flu outbreak in US dairy cattle in California.
title: Disease X: Hunting the Next Pandemic

overview: From coaching football in the Pros to living on the streets. Stan must choose to face his demons and beat his addiction if he is to turn his life around and take a small Christian High School to its first ever state football championship.
tagline: Stan the man is facing the toughest opposition he has ever faced in his life...himself
title: Stan the Man

overview: Transgender Sambor tries to curry favor with a group of skaters.
title: Dickflip

overview: Kelly accidentally discovered from the dashcam that her husband, Jim, was cheating on her. She took her daughter and car away, but she was still hesitant about getting a divorce. To make a living, Kelly became a ridesharing driver. However, she received several complaints from passengers about her poor driving skills, and she fell into financial difficulties due to mounting tickets. Just when she was about to give up, a few encounters with various passengers made her reconsider her decision. While Jim pursued reconciliation, Kelly faced the choice: to give Jim another chance or continue to raise her daughter alone.
title: MAMACAR

overview: An aquatic malady threatens a forgotten coastal village. Confronted with this rising marine crisis, three young fishermen resort to illegal dynamite fishing.
title: Last Tropics

overview: The Finger Wife is a domestic horror story with a delicious sense of humor - part 2D hand-drawn animation, part stop-motion, and all bizarro feminist propaganda! It’s 1975. A smart, ambitious woman (The Wife) is stuck in the kitchen. When feisty, martini-drinking Betty steps out of a 1950s cookbook, The Wife is confronted with what she really wants out of life (it's not to make another meatloaf). Faced with Betty’s tough love and in a desperate effort to find one goddamn minute for herself, The Wife takes matters into her own hands, with gleefully horrific results.
tagline: She just needs a minute.
title: The Finger Wife

overview: At an alternative fashion school in the toughest suburb of Paris, the young fashion designers of the future give free rein to their wild creative dreams.
title: Casa

original_title: Go Figure: More Than A Toy Story
overview: ‘Go Figure: More Than A Toy Story’ is a 50-minute documentary produced by Connor Allen, exploring the impact of the Character Options toy range on a generation of fans who grew up watching Doctor Who after the 2005 revival.  While fans of the classic years had DAPOL & Denys Fisher to keep them happy, Millennial and Gen-Z viewers see the CO range as the gateway to their own nostalgia. Available only on a VAM alongside the hardback edition of 'Go Figure!', a visual archive of the CO figures, this documentary features reminiscences from numerous fans & Doctor Who contributors. Including, Katy Manning (Jo Grant), Simon Fisher-Becker (Dorium Maldovar), Gary Russell (Script Editor), Joseph Lidster (Writer), and Kieran Highman (Colourisation Artist).
tagline: Unbox a story of great Character!
title: Go Figure: More Than A Toy Story

overview: Trapped in a terrifying death-loop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.  —Wales Interactive
tagline: "Every death brings you closer to the truth."
title: Dead Reset

overview: Miki and his delivery partner are on their way to deliver a package, but when Marko opens the door everything changes for Miki.
title: You see, I see

overview: A thrilling short film follows the story of the delivery man forced to deliver a package under timed conditions as people watch him go on. Constant reminders, the need to rush through the crowd and as the time ticks down, his life is in danger.
tagline: The Delivery Man
title: The Delivery Man

original_title: THE ANTHOLOGY Lost Tapes: FROM A DUMPSTER
overview: Seven chapters of horror, terror, and hellfire.
tagline: NEVER MEANT TO BE FOUND..
title: THE ANTHOLOGY Lost Tapes: FROM A DUMPSTER

overview: It’s a warm, bright summer day, and Sarah and her boyfriend is busy preparing to host a summer party. But within just one day, her entire sense of reality is turned upside down.
title: Fata Morgana

overview: Five dancers explore shadeism/colourism in the Black community through a series of personal interviews, performance pieces, and dance vignettes leading up to a final performance.
title: Shades

overview: A woman who cannot sleep, a sinkhole in the road, and a hospital that floods intertwine as the city's 'body' collides with a 'wave'.
title: The Water Is Dead

overview: On a limbo train between life and death, Emelina and Ismael begin to understand their past earthly purpose in order to spiritually  transmute helped by the train guard, who will lead them once again to life.
title: La ventana indiscreta

overview: Two Ugandan women, Monic Karungi and Kayla Birungi, died in Dubai in 2022 after falling from high-rise buildings, bringing renewed and devastating attention to the exploitative "Dubai Porta Potty" trend. The BBC's Africa Eye investigated the cases, revealing that the rumors surrounding Karungi's death hid an even darker reality of sexual exploitation and human trafficking.
title: Death in Dubai #DubaiPortaPotty

overview: After having a hard time finding a job in New York, Jiaqi decides to go back to China during the pandemic while her boyfriend Pingu insists to stay for his ambitious thesis film production. However, a sudden announcement interrupts Jiaqi’s plan. During their separation, both of them have a chance to experience a special period of their lives.
title: Jet Lag in Summer

overview: Four friends perform a ritual in the woods to find The Saint. As they make their way through the paths, they reminisce about the adventures they shared, in an attempt to forget that this is probably the last time they will walk through the forest together.
title: Girls

overview: One of the light creatures comes close. It blinks right here, beside my arm. I can see the body. It is small, with wings.
title: Fireflies Along the Fence

overview: A surprise selection of the wildest images from the Gaumont library. This year, Sylvain Perret is back with a second coming of exclusive unseen nuggets, dug out from GP Archives for a new insane journey: mad collectors, odd animal experiments, disco and many other surprises, all under the auspices of Alejandro Jodorowsky.
tagline: Last Anthology Before the End of the World
title: L'Étrange Anthologie bis

original_title: Zza szyby podglądam jak umiera sarna, młoda
overview: The dawn light is cut by the sounds of an axe. The breath of Helka, yesterday's bride, mingles for the last time with the breaths of her family. Helka bids farewell to her patrimony and walks through the village to her husband's house.
title: Dying of the Young Deer

overview: Two women find two limousines on a beach in the middle of the ocean. Immediately fascinated by the vehicles, they decide to restore them.
title: Metamorphosia

overview: Spain 1969. After the death of her brother, a young, dyslexic organist begins a forbidden love affair with an idealistic woman who pushes her to write a song and rebel against the highly censorious and conservative society ruled by the dictator Franco.
title: Censurada

overview: One morning, a group of citizens discovers a big whale corpse in the middle of the city. They can't get around it, so they'll have to face the animal body. This meeting is about to transform them in an unexpected way.
title: Whale's Song

overview: A young college artist tries to sketch his next piece, vainly. Frustrated, decides to get out from his house and get some fresh air. But then, a shadow springs forth from one of his rejected ideas, determined to reach him. Short silent film inspired by Nosferatu (1922) and The Gabinet of Dr. Caligari (1920).
tagline: It's impossible to run from your own shadow
title: SHEUT

overview: In a world where the highest status symbol is an udder installed on your wall, the ultimate question is: would you f*** the Wall Udder?
title: Wall Udder

overview: Lali, the queen of pop, made Vélez vibrate with an unforgettable show. Relieve a unique night and don’t answer when the demon calls… click play on the show instead.
tagline: The party of pop is back.
title: Lali: Live in Vélez 2025

overview: Nico lives on a shore isolated from the world. Her house is by the sea, covered by a pile of leaves that make it look like a large mound. Nico seeks independence in solitude, but by distancing from the world, she has also distanced from herself. She spends her days carving stones, collecting leaves, and avoiding the other inhabitants. Nico sees herself reflected in the surface of the sea and realizes she has no face in the water's reflection. A large wave overwhelms her, and she loses her house key. To retrieve it, she dives into the sea and swims into the darkness, surrounded by flashes of light. After her underwater experience, Nico chooses a new way of relating to the world.
title: Los rostros del rostro

overview: Many people assume obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) revolves around excessive hand-washing, perfectionism, and flipping light switches. This simplified description barely skims the surface of this disorder. An Unquiet Mind sheds light on a sinister side of OCD that many sufferers are too afraid to speak about.
title: An Unquiet Mind

overview: Life is comprised of goodbyes.
title: Adiós, GDL

overview: Intimate interviews between the director's parents and his girlfriend, Cailynn, documenting their relationships. What is life without love, the fire burning within us.
tagline: LOVE SPANNING GENERATIONS.
title: A Short Documentary About Love

overview: Arachne, the masterful weaver, spun tales of the gods’ misdeeds. But for weaving the truth, she was met with divine wrath, cruel and unrelenting.
title: The Weaver

original_title: Inside the Dream: La Première Air France
overview: Immerse yourself in the world's most exclusive in-flight experience. For three years, Air France has been working in total secrecy on its new La Première service, to take elegance to new heights. Let's take off into a world of French excellence and refinement, where every detail counts, to offer the highest expression of travel.
title: Inside the Dream: La Première Air France

original_title: Celebrity Big Brother: The Winner's Story
overview: A look back on the winner of Celebrity Big Brother 8 in the House.
title: Celebrity Big Brother: The Winner's Story

original_title: Once upon a time in Trivandrum
overview: At first, it looks like just another ordinary day in Trivandrum. But as the day goes on, five very different stories start to unfold — each with its own unique characters and funny situations.What makes it more interesting is that all these stories, though separate, are secretly connected by one strange and mysterious painting.
title: Once upon a time in Trivandrum

original_title: Hey, I Made This for You
overview: Sean and Jessica followed different paths in high school but connected over a mixtape in theater class. A chance encounter at their twenty year reunion sends them on a night of self-discovery in this adult coming-of-age drama.
title: Hey, I Made This for You

overview: Aeon, the tireless leader of a startup, discovers he has been sleepwalking and decides to exploit his unconscious self to push productivity beyond human limits. Extreme efficiency comes at the cost of his well-being. Aeon ends up in a deep sleep, from which he is unable to wake up on his own.
title: 5:28 AM

overview: A troubled teen’s reunion with his childhood friend twists into a chilling bond with an unsettling and mysterious presence that lingers in the shadows.
tagline: Monsters take many forms.
title: The Creature

original_title: Connection At The End Of The World
overview: Jay and Sam are a perfect match. They meet for some food and drinks at the local bar when news breaks of a possible apocalyptic-level event. Nuclear annihilation is nigh, but this wouldn't be the first time the world was coaxed into panic by false pretenses. Jay and Sam wonder whether it is another false alarm or approaching oblivion.
tagline: Can two people find a connection when the world is on the brink?
title: Connection At The End Of The World

overview: Winter 1996, Harbin. Sha Guo, a boy with a uniquely feminine singing voice, loves to sing but faces bullying and isolation at school, along with strict control and pressure from his obsessive mother. By chance, he meets Sitiao, a nightclub host and stage director. To defend his dignity, pursue his dreams, and find his true self, Sha Guo leaves home and, with Sitiao's support, steps onto the nightclub stage as a cross-dressing singer.
title: A Falsetto Boy

overview: In retro-future Los Angeles, a lonely woman creates a sentient robot and, in the process, is forced to confront her neglected life and fractured relationship with her father-learning what it truly means to be alive.
title: Reprogrammed

overview: After a traumatic event, two brothers cope in their own ways, one of them by eating ice cream.
title: Ice Cream

overview: After a turbulent first meeting, Menios, a young journalist, convinces Rafaella, a trans sex worker, to share her life story. As Rafaella recounts her first night out on Syngrou Avenue, Menios realises he is no longer interested in the interview.
title: Rafaella

overview: In a mountain village, Daniel C. repairs clocks. Surrounded by the constant ticking, he lives alone, dedicated to his craft and to selling on Wallapop.
title: Estar aquí cuando puedo

overview: It's his birthday. He will sing tonight. The pieces of his fragmented self struggle to compose the song; the fragments of the song expand to rebuild him.
tagline: Colour, I long to be submerged!
title: Or How to Disappear

overview: A documentary elegy about the last days of summer turning into autumn, and about people in a state of transition. They are still enjoying the last day of summer, but they know that autumn has already arrived. Childhood is about to end, the prime of life will fade, old age will turn into decrepitude. But there is this endless day of pure happiness.
title: Endless Days

overview: Can two fake surgeons mend a real broken heart?
title: Surgeons

overview: In Lahore, 26-year-old Fatin and her mother Yasmeen prepare for a neighborhood wedding when Yasmeen’s 70-year-old brother-in-law, Shabeer, unexpectedly arrives for the wedding and medical tests. Fatin, uncomfortable due to past abuse, faces pressure to care for him, including driving him to his appointments, forcing her to confront unresolved trauma while balancing family obligations.
title: Permanent Guest

overview: Echoes of the West End explores the transformation of a forgotten mining region in Southwest Colorado, where the scars of an industrial past are being reimagined as trails for the future. Led by the West End Trail Alliance, this documentary captures a community’s fight to stay rooted while forging a new path through outdoor recreation and resilience. It’s a story of grit, vision, and the quiet power of place.
tagline: Where trails remember, and the future is forged in dust.
title: Echoes of the West End

overview: In one of the farmsteads, the garden begins to bloom. Sonya hurries to her date—she is about to be initiated into adulthood through her first sexual experience. But frost is coming, and it could destroy the blossoms.
title: Sonia's Blossom

overview: A thriller featuring fan favorites, Rupert the horse, and Richard Nixon in a heated battle to the death. Many deaths and casualties along the way lead to a thrilling end with exciting characters and incredible cinematic moments.
tagline: Rupert Vs. Nixon
title: Rupert V Nixon

overview: Graffiti documentary covering the history of graffiti, the opinions on the topic from a wide range of people and a close insight into a graffiti crew based in the West Midlands.
tagline: to stick out like a sore thumb.
title: Sore Thumb

overview: Disillusioned government worker, Ryan, is stuck in a soulless job at the local town council. While tracking down a missing recycling bin, he encounters a homeless man, Peng, who claims to be an extraterrestrial. As Ryan begrudgingly teams up with Peng to hunt for the latter's doomsday device, they embark on a madcap adventure through Singapore: running into a rabid doomsday cult hot on their heels, dodging top-secret government agents, yet finding surprising allies who join their cause.  Sometimes by simply helping the person next to you — even if they are a crazy-looking homeless man who's really an alien — you can Save The World!!!
title: We Can Save The World!!!

original_title: All These Faces Are Starting to Look Bizarrely Familiar
overview: Amidst the dusty bellowing of a decrepit cinema complex, a young Theo engages with a strangely familiar elderly man who presents upon him visions of disgust and euphoria.
title: All These Faces Are Starting to Look Bizarrely Familiar

overview: Another day unfolds in a woman's life, as she cooks and cleans for her uncommunicative husband and sullen grown-up children. Late in the afternoon, she has an unusual visitor.
title: Getting On

overview: Two brothers become stranded during a road trip have to navigate their way home, and their differences in mindset
tagline: Who in their right mind puts a cigarette in a gas tank?
title: A Long Walk Home

overview: At the peak of his career, Jalen King believes he can have it all, including a wife content with being his trophy. But when she's desperate to start a family and turns to a childhood friend, Jalen's jealousy spirals into a deadly plot.
title: Ballin'

overview: Hollie and Ophelia are in Osric's hands, and things are threatening to end badly. Hanna and Claudia, however, seem to be growing closer. But, is this real, or just an act..? Guido and Ronald are also playing a double role, Lilly is becoming more and more dangerous, and Han must now make a long-delayed choice: take action or not?
tagline: Is this real or just an act?
title: The Family: The Fall

overview: Summer is ending and so are the holidays. Around Balthazar, 13, the adults are getting the barbecue ready. His cousins are getting dressed to go out and party, and his big brother is ignoring him. Balthazar, meanwhile, is texting with Tom — the only one who doesn’t treat him like a little kid.
title: As Night Falls

overview: Andréia, trapped in abusive relationship with deceitful Pedro, discovers motorcycling. She transforms her life, finding support from free-spirited Michael. Together, they journey through challenges, pursuing an authentic, passionate life.
title: A Matter of Choice

overview: After immersing himself in the street life, Racci finds redemption through his passion for sports, which he shares with his community to forge a better future, breaking the metaphorical bars that surround his world.
title: Pull Up

overview: At 85, Icelandic design icon Gunnar Magnússon begins a final project with help from his daughter Tinna. As his health suddenly fails, she is left to complete the work herself, turning her father’s last creation into a daughter’s final gesture of love.
title: Gunnar's Last Project

overview: Irmgard and Hermann’s quiet life in their small Saxon garden is brightened by a lantana plant—until the arrival of restless teenagers next door sparks tension. Soon, prejudices, delusions, and misunderstandings threaten to tear the garden community apart.
tagline: feel the heat
title: Lantana

overview: An explorer is meeting the life of a woman through her eyes.
title: In Your Eyes

original_title: I nomi da dire quando si tappano le orecchie
title: I nomi da dire quando si tappano le orecchie

overview: With the release of thousands of classified documents in 2025, this gripping exploration reexamines the JFK assassination, probing key questions about who was truly responsible for the tragic events of November 22, 1963, in Dallas.
title: JFK Assassination: Declassified Theories

original_title: 135 Χρόνια Σύλλογος Αιώνιος | Το ντοκιμαντέρ του Gazzetta powered by Novibet για τον Πανιώνιο
overview: Panionios has turned 135 years old and Gazzetta powered by Novibet presents a documentary full of emotion and memories. From Smirni (now called Ismir) to the Panathinaikos Stadium and to Nea Smirni. A club that became a symbol of resilience. A club often referred to as eternal.
tagline: The Eternal Club
title: Panionios - 135 Years of the Eternal Club

overview: [thóo-kong-á] is a stop-motion short film centered on the Taiwanese tradition of “bone collecting.” The story follows a boy who was raised by his grandfather, a professional bone collector. Since childhood, he was often asked to help with the ritual, though he never understood its meaning — only finding it exhausting and unpleasant. But through repeated experiences, he gradually comes to see that bone collecting isn’t something taboo — it is a gentle, meaningful practice. It’s a way for the living to say a proper farewell to the dead. In the end, with newfound understanding and respect, he personally performs the final bone collecting for his grandfather.
title: thóo-kong-á

overview: A "clock" was one of the imagery materials for the video. The rotating hour and minute hands, ticking away time. I wondered what it would be like to freeze the moving hands and rotate the dial... While creating this piece, I wondered how much time I had left. How many more pieces I could create. How would the scenery change if I stopped something moving? Perhaps this could be a guideline for my next piece. The work's subtitle, "漕続-SOUZOKU-" is a word coined by the artist, meaning "slowly but steadily moving forward".
title: Continuation

overview: Vancouver Island, supernatural by construct and memory, is experienced though landscapes represented by colonial icons, mysterious brilliant fountains, and a curious peacock. A tableaux of sorts, each encounter is singular yet united by stunning and devastated beauty.
title: Super, Natural

overview: Ever wanted to know what your high school teacher actually thought of you? Or whether she believed your excuses? Or what she wanted to say to the Year 8 boy who refused to leave the class? Well, you’re going to want to see this show. Before Bron Lewis was one of Australia’s most promising new comedians, she was a high school teacher for almost a decade. It was an era where she both nurtured young hearts and encouraged kids to be brilliant, but also made some lifelong enemies. You’ll hear more about them this show than the nerds.  Bron became a teacher because she hates learning – she would rather saw off her own legs then learn a new card game, and in her opinion whoever coined the term ‘board game’ was bang on. Bron raises the question: what happens when someone tries to avoid learning at all costs? They teach. Sit down and get ready to learn.
tagline: Get ready to be glad you're not a teacher
title: Bron Lewis - Who's Talking?

overview: Marcus is about to watch the National Rugby League grand final game with his son Max. However he is surprised when Max brings his girlfriend Chloe and brother Jack, and an AA mediator named Yuki. It turns out it was a trap set up by Max to get Marcus into an intervention for his weight.
title: Fat Mouth

overview: A burnt out office worker makes an unexpected connection. But her self doubts threaten to ruin things before they can begin.  2025 VRChat Film Jam Winner
title: Can I See You Again?

overview: This film takes you across Canada to learn about policies, programs and projects that are already happening and already having a positive impact on addressing the housing crisis. From using public land to build non-market housing in Kitchener and Whistler, and inspiring Indigenous-led projects in Vancouver, to strong tenant protections and rent control in British Columbia and Prince Edward Island, the examples featured in this film demonstrate how many important solutions are making a difference in communities big and small!
tagline: It's not just a question of how much housing
title: Thinking Beyond the Market

overview: Stephen Fry and Gemma Whelan star in 'Recall Me Maybe' a new FT drama written by David Baddiel, exploring AI, memory and truth. Fry plays a grandfather with dementia who uses AI to fill in gaps in his memory. While reviewing the archive of his life his family makes a shocking discovery. Which memories are really true? And how AI is defining who we are?
title: Recall Me Maybe

overview: During what seems like an ordinary day at work, a young woman’s life takes an unexpected turn when she receives a mysterious phone call from someone she once loved, reaching out from beyond the grave. What begins as a shocking intrusion soon becomes a deeply emotional encounter, forcing her to confront unfinished feelings, buried memories, and the fragile line between love and loss.
title: A Phone Call From Paradise

original_title: I Was Stalked By My Work Colleague
overview: Grace and Daryl are living happily in Watford when a dangerous stalker starts to rip everything apart. No one can help them. They need evidence. So they start to film everything.
title: I Was Stalked By My Work Colleague

overview: A man spends the day frolicking. What is there not to be happy about?
title: The Hope of Tomorrow

overview: How does an insect feel inside your house? Did you leave your vodka bottle open from last night? Did you take your cough syrup?
tagline: Which one is it?
title: Drunk Bug or Feverish Slug

overview: The documentary INFARCT tells the poignant and heartfelt story of two friends whose lives are suddenly turned upside down. A story about unconditional friendship, vulnerability, disarray, acceptance, determination, and working toward a new future. Because a stroke never happens to just one person, and its consequences are carried together.  A story of two friends who reincarnate within their lifetime.  With INFARCT, Viggo and Peter pay tribute to what remains after the blow, and give a face to what so often stays invisible: the impact on relationships, the struggle, and the hopeful perspective. They invite reflection and conversation about what connects us when everything changes.
tagline: the impact of a stroke
title: Infarct

overview: For fifty years, every ten minutes, a small transport vessel has crossed the Valsequillo lagoon, Puebla's largest body of water. Today, in the midst of unprecedented drought, the ship Mónica II, 'La Panga,' floats in lilies and mud.
title: Un vals sobre Mónica

overview: Nuno is a one-year-old who is starting to talk. His parents speak Galician to each other and Spanish to him, so he doesn't know which one to use.
title: Nuno

overview: Professional wake surfer Evan Feierabend takes us through different aspects of the sport, exploring the craft and what it's like to compete.
title: The Endless Wave

overview: Samuel decides to travel to the coast of Veracruz to find out if his brother, Tomás, is okay. During the trip, Samuel reflects on love and relationships, which will lead him to make a decision upon returning to Mexico City.
title: Días de Junio

overview: Trapped in a marriage, a woman struggles to reclaim her freedom from an unfaithful husband whose gambling addiction and need for control have slowly eroded her sense of self. But when her husband becomes a suspect in the disappearance of another woman, secrets unravel, and she must decide what to do about the man who once promised her everything.
title: Prodótis

overview: Naples, early 1900s. During a nightmarish night a woman and her children must face the ghost of her husband who recently died. The trauma of their loss haunts them in the form of horrifying beasts. They manage to destroy them together, finding strength in each other.
title: Scuritate

overview: In 1973, charismatic thieves Ana and Ryan are riding high off a string of luxury heists. But when they break into the home of a powerful political figure, they stumble onto something far more dangerous than they expected.
title: Outlaws

overview: After bidding farewell to her career following an injury, National paragliding champion GU Ying journeys to the uninhabited areas of Hoh Xil on the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau to film wildlife. Over ten years of working deep on the plateau, she documents both the beauty and harshness of the land, capturing the conflict and coexistence between humans and wildlife. She also becomes a part of this land.
title: A Woman in Their Eyes

overview: In 2001, Francisca finds herself torn between two worlds: the one she left behind, with her father fighting in the streets of Argentina, amidst the chaos of the corralito, and the new one in which she experiences profound emotional distress as she adapts to her new life in Spain.
title: Our Part of Buenos Aires

overview: Em, a non-binary person out for four years, begins Testosterone therapy, sparking conflict with their fiancé Spencer, who struggles to accept being seen with a partner who isn’t a woman. Em leaves him and finds support in Rose, a trans friend reclaiming her music career. They begin dating Ana, a non-binary performance artist who awakens Em’s sexuality, but Ana’s bipolar struggles strain the relationship, leading Em back to Spencer. Through shifting love, friendships, and family ties, Em learns to embrace their identity and prepares to share their truth with their single mother.
title: T

original_title: Ako Ro Buroe Nga Gaeangoy Sa Humbak
overview: As the tides pull away time and memory, a daughter transforms into a jellyfish to reach the mother who no longer remembers her, drifting between loss and love along Aklan’s vanishing shores.
title: I Am The Jellyfish That Swims In The Waves

overview: For decades, the countries of the African Sahel region have been targets of colonialism and exploitation by France and other Western powers. This documentary addresses the popular resistance and new paths of development forged by Burkina Faso, Niger, and Mali after experiencing civil and military uprisings in recent years. The film explores the popular resistance that sustains the revolution in the three Sahel countries and was made after extensive coverage of the ongoing social dynamics and geopolitical disputes.
title: Sahel: Pátria ou Morte

overview: Xalil and Yamis, married for several years, are experiencing a tragedy that has turned their lives upside down. The tragic loss of their only daughter in an accident has plunged their lives into a spiral of pain and silence.
title: XY

original_title: The Missing Groove (The Legend Of Benny Kravitz)
title: The Missing Groove (The Legend Of Benny Kravitz)

original_title: J'ai pas les codes : Les aventures inattendues du boulanger de Besançon
overview: This is the story of an ordinary man transformed by history. A simple baker from Besançon who became a political symbol of resistance. That of a France that knows how much it needs others to grow. Of working classes rejecting the siren calls of populism. He says: "I was nothing and I became a monster" to express the vertigo of his transformation. And so the baker entered politics, visited the United States in the footsteps of Martin Luther King, brought aid to the Ukrainians, and ran for legislative elections. Fearless. Fighting with all his heart. It is this inspiring, touching, and funny human epic that Pedro da Fonseca's camera followed closely, capturing his doubts, his hesitations, and his emotions.
title: I Don’t Have the Codes

overview: Another year ends and another begins. Between the obvious and the unusual, New Year's Eve celebrations inspire dreams and break rules.
title: Fogos de Artifício

overview: A contemporary dancer receives a package from a female courier. Although she returns it, the same courier keeps bringing it back, gradually unsettling her daily routine in strange and unexpected ways.
title: Performer

overview: CONTAINS NO AI ART -- so don't blame me when humanity is wiped out by robots!
title: ANIMATION IS NOT A CRIME

overview: Aired on Fuori Orario on September 8th, 2025. Fulvio Baglivi and Franco Maresco talk about Maresco's latest movie, Bravo Bene!
title: Conversazione con Franco Maresco

overview: In his monotonous daily routine, Anka, an ordinary office employee, is crushed by a series of problems. His days started the same way: waking up, brushing his teeth, sipping bitter coffee, then being scolded by his boss at the office. His personal life is no less bleak—his relationship has failed and his father is in critical condition. The feeling of disappointment continued to pile up, making him feel like the world was hostile to him. In the midst of the destruction, Anka was haunted by pain that never subsided. When everything felt hopeless, he sank into the darkest despair.
title: Pudar

overview: Winner of multiple Oscars for Gravity and Roma, also known for Children of Men and Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban, Mexican director Alfonso Cuarón prefers to talk about other people's films rather than his own. However, he reveals some secrets about the making of Children of Men (2006) and Gravity (2013). Eclectic, he can discuss the great American filmmakers as well as the films of Swiss director Alain Tanner and Japanese masters.
title: Conversation avec Alfonso Cuarón

original_title: Personnalités multiples - Vivre avec un trouble dissociatif de l’identité (TDI)
overview: Formerly known as ‘multiple personality disorder’, dissociative identity disorder, the most common cause of which is severe childhood trauma, is a condition recognised by psychiatry but still poorly understood, to the extent that it is sometimes called into question. Alongside patients and researchers, we delve into the mechanisms and daily implications of this pervasive condition.
title: Personnalités multiples - Vivre avec un trouble dissociatif de l’identité (TDI)

overview: ACA 191: Tumenov vs. Cruz was a mixed martial arts event that took place on Friday, September 5, 2025 at the Basket Hall in Krasnodar, Russia.

overview: Kira, faced with the mourning of her mother and the tensions with her former best friend, Tessa, sees her day at high school change. title: Au-delà des notes

original_title: Gregorio Ordóñez, el asesinato que despertó la rebelión contra ETA
overview: The documentary Gregorio Ordóñez, el asesinato que despertó la rebelión contra ETA is an exercise of memory recalling the figure of the People's Party councillor and Deputy Mayor of San Sebastián on the 30th year of his assassination. The production looks back at the circumstances of his attack, the context of the Basque Country and San Sebastián in particular in 1995 and the events that followed his murder.
title: Gregorio Ordóñez, el asesinato que despertó la rebelión contra ETA

overview: An agama lizard finds the perfect excuse to exchange the boring and slow-paced life of the Hinterland for the fast-paced and success-paved streets of Lagos. With his band of music-loving friends, they set out on an arduous but event-filled adventure to make it big and conquer Lagos. Will they find success or redemption?
title: Gammy & The Living Things

overview: Everyone in life undergoes a personality test, "am I a trembling creature" or "do I have the right"? The case with the old woman falls to the Murmansk judge Yulia Andreyevna Grin. The pensioner may end up on the street after being manipulated by telephone scammers. Due to the loans taken out under their pressure, her apartment is already up for sale. Yulia will have to decide whether to make a standard decision or, at her own risk, defend the victim. If the defense ends in favor of the victim, this will happen for the first time in the history of the practice of the Russian arbitration court.
title: Дело №

original_title: EXPO'70 前衛の記憶 ～アコを探して
overview: A documentary made in collaboration with students at Konan University, retracing the history of EXPO '70 and attempting to track down the actress who performed in Toshio Matsumoto's installation in the Textiles Pavilion, "Space Projection Ako." Featuring interviews with historians, scholars and artists including Yokoo Tadanori, Norio Imai, and more.
title: EXPO '70 Avant-Garde Memories - Searching for Ako

overview: Five businessmen do a business.
tagline: That is a business.

Torn between the silence of the adults around him and a vivid imagination that’s starting to run wild, the boy struggles to make sense of his brother’s mysterious departure while confronting the shadows it casts in his life.

overview: Camilo is a young man burdened with the grief of loss and absence. Hand in hand with Sol, whom he feels attracted to, he finds an apparent relief for his pain inside a religious cult to which she’ part of . tagline: When everyone leaves, self-destruction will become his way.

title: Perdonalos porque no saben lo que hacen

tagline: What is Love?

overview: Proof of 2,170,000 crore BDT in stolen wealth is hidden on a pen drive smuggled from Bangladesh to Europe by Ramisa Rahman, entrusted by journalist Arif Khan. The evidence targets Zahir Chowdhury, a powerful corruption kingpin. After Ramisa is captured, Zahir’s lieutenant Madhab Roy turns rogue, frees her, and helps expose his master—leaving one question: will the truth be revealed, or will greed win again?
tagline: When the price of truth is billions, loyalty becomes the deadliest lie.
title: Dabaghor

overview: Gay Guardian Angels, Joey McGee and his ex-boyfriend TJ Wright III, are sent to a church, by God, to complete their next mission. There, they meet Ben and his apathetic Guardian Angel Virginia.
title: (Un)Free Will: The Confession

overview: After becoming a widow, a 76-year-old Jewish woman, rediscovers her body, desire, and the freedom to live without guilt. Between close friends and new connections, she explores her sexuality while dealing with a son who struggles to understand her vitality. An intimate and luminous story about pleasure in old age, friendship as refuge, and the right to inhabit desire at any age.
title: The skin under my girdle

overview: On the day of his wedding rehearsal ceremony, Jack battles pre-wedding jitters and visions of a past romance.
title: I Don't

overview: Ruva, a bold entrepreneur tries to save her struggling family restaurant while maintaining a picture-perfect online persona. Behind the scenes, she juggles a crumbling marriage, a spicy business partnership with her mother Gloria, and the pressure of a million-dollar online competition that could change everything.
tagline: It burns. It's irresistible.
title: Loved Out

overview: Jon returns to his grandmother's farmhouse and comes across an old recipe book. Determined to recover the flavours of his childhood, he travels to markets and ports in search of local ingredients to make a marmitako tuna stew combining past, present and roots.
title: Amona

overview: I Am Worthy is an uplifting, fantastical adventure that follows a boy, his sister, and her husband after a tragic car accident, coping with guilt and loss from a Christian perspective. While this film is exceptionally clean, it does contain depictions of blood, death, and a car accident which may be considered "scary" for younger children. I Am Worthy was directed by its creator and writer, Sarah McDaniel, and produced by she, Johnny Angel Villegas, and Obed Elias Perez. This piece was developed by the entire crew with a deep passion and drive for bringing viewers comfort and an understanding of God's grace.
title: I Am Worthy

overview: Neera is a heartfelt tale of love, rediscovery, and the unseen threads that bind us. it explores passion, fate, and regret - inviting us to reflect on our choices and the love we may overlook until it's out of reach.
title: Neera

overview: Lost in a world of hashtags, likes, and lies, Libby finds herself and her sister Tola in a sticky situation.
title: Ugly Instagram

overview: Trapped in a bathroom overgrown with water and vegetation, a young woman tries to adapt to the unexpected visits of a strange boy who keeps observing her.
tagline: SOMEBODY'S WATCHING

overview: A writer's creations step out of his stories, haunting his reality and demanding justice. As fiction and truth collide, he becomes a prisoner in a terrifying narrative beyond his control.

overview: After months of heartbreak, KeKe—a witty, romantic Black trans woman—spends her nights hiding in old romcoms. Dragged out by her cousin Lily, she lands at a party that reopens old wounds. Armed with liquid courage, she braces herself—until she meets Eli, a sweet stranger who disarms her defenses. Their spark is undeniable, but KeKe isn’t sure she’s ready to love again while still mending from her past. Blending humor, messy encounters, and romcom nostalgia, Salty is about love, loss, and learning to be your own happy ending.
title: Salty

original_title: ក្មេងក្រៅវត្ត
overview: Pagoda Boy tells the story of an orphan who survives by stealing shoes at the temple, only to discover that what he truly longs for is not wealth, but the love of his grandmother, who passed away. Between monks’ chants, ghostly voices, and memories of hunger and abandonment, his mischief turns into a journey of grief, memory, and hope — a quiet conversation between the living and the departed.
tagline: During Pchum Ben, Cambodian families gather at the pagoda to offer food to their ancestors. But what happens to a boy who has no family left?
title: Pagoda Boy

overview: After a long absence, Stasya returns to her hometown. She missed her father's funeral and has a hard time meeting her elder sister. While sorting out family issues, Stasya meets different local strangers on the way, who take her on a strange night trip.
title: Like a Fairy Tale

overview: Experience history through a special documentary short film, Pulse of the Continent: Final Spike Steam Tour, telling the story of an incredible journey through North America spanning nearly 10,000 miles over 76 days. Come aboard with us as we revisit the magic and excitement of the Empress 2816 steam locomotive’s epic trip from Calgary to Mexico City and back.
title: Pulse of the Continent

overview: Teenage Bunny confronts grief and looming danger as ze reckons with the loss of zir other half in a post-apocalyptic world where gender no longer exists and nothing is as it seems.
title: Gummy Worms

overview: Arya, a junior high school student, is having trouble communicating with his father. Feeling the need to vent his frustration, Arya reveals all his feelings to AI.
title: Mulai Bicara

overview: With intimate attention to transformation in body and culture endured across oceans and time, “Angelita” poses a question from granddaughter to Grandmother: what lives and dies at the other end of sacrifice?
title: Angelita

overview: A movie with Jimmie Falls, Sean San Jose, and Emmy Newman.
title: You'll Lose a Good Thing

overview: When a small town is terrorized by mysterious creature in a shabby bear suit, all hell breaks loose. But it's not just any bear - It's a zombie with a taste for blood.
title: FUR

overview: The film is about Agu, a bear sanctuary guardian who sees his world overturned the night he visits his girlfriend. Lost and without a way out, he finds a resurgence of life when Tina, a young charming woman with many dreams, magically appears in the neighboring apartment.
title: Bear Hug

overview: A portrait of Javier Urondo and his discomforting, sharp and provocative take on the act of serving food. Paco Urondo, his father, was a distinguished poet and political activist, murdered by the military dictatorship in 1976. This is the story of Javier, of how he maintains the Urondo Bar, a restaurant in a Buenos Aires suburb, from where he lends new meaning to a legacy and a belonging and turns them into an act of resistance. A film about food as a source of culture and family.
title: Jota Urondo, An Impertinent Chef

overview: A trans short film that centers trans stories—by and for trans people, both in front of and behind the camera. Elizabeth arrives in the city with fierce eyes, wild hair, sharp nails, and a suitcase full of fragments of past tenderness. She drifts through encounters with men who, like cigarette smoke, warm the body, fade away, and slowly kill. Each takes and leaves something behind. Elizabeth accepts this cycle, knowing that on full-moon nights she must keep away from beaches, forests, and trousered men. The moon awakens the beast within her—sharp-clawed, born to survive, feeding on her pain. She hides it, distancing herself from flesh when it claws at her skin. But one man comes too close, witnessing her under the full moon, seeing her beast, her besta fubana, in her most fragile state.
title: Besta Fubana

overview: Why tens of thousands of Jewish schoolchildren graduate from ultra-Orthodox high schools without the legally mandated education they need to become independent adults.
title: Unorthodox Education

overview: A meditative series of twelve individual shots, each offering a quiet reflection on nature’s varied forms — capturing fleeting moments of stillness, texture, and light across shifting landscapes.
tagline: NATURE OBSERVED IN SILENCE

overview: Samuel, a young football prodigy who has everything in his life under control—until he meets Luca, a new teammate. Samuel must confront unexpected feelings while trying to achieve his goal of being signed by a First Division team.

overview: Three neighbors, all with OCD, each navigate a day of rituals and ruminations—until a tense encounter with a suspected car thief outside their apartment building brings their inner worlds together.

overview: Germany, November 1992. In a racist attack, three of İbrahim Arslan’s family members perish in a fire. Thirty years later, İbrahim discovers thousands of letters of solidarity, forgotten in the city archive. We accompany the family as they navigate their profound trauma.

overview: Amare, an afro-descendant woman, is forced to emigrate to the United States to support her family, but especially her younger sister, Cielo. Fourteen years later, she returns to her hometown for her father's wake. Faced with the weight of time and silence, Amare tries to reconcile with her sister, her mother, and the roots she left behind.
title: Amare

overview: A group of friends decides to escape their daily grind with a weekend retreat to a remote, secluded cabin. What begins as a relaxing getaway quickly turns into a chilling ordeal when they realize that something sinister is lurking in the shadows.

overview: A coyote walks through a distorted reality without color.

overview: Mahsa, a transgender Iranian woman, agrees to meet her partner's family, hoping for their blessing and acceptance against all odds.

overview: An audio-visual experience through the perspective of an iPhone depicting a harmonious city during the day quickly descend into technological madness as night falls.

overview: Is there a certain age to fall in love? Nanito offers a captivating answer: the heart never gives up. The film tells the story of Nanito, an 80-year-old man who decides to win back Antonia, an old flame. Her innocence and her antics invite the audience to laugh, be moved, and reconsider preconceived ideas about love in old age.
tagline: Is there an age for falling in love?
title: Nanito

overview: Niko lives with his father, who treats frogs better than he treats his own son. These slimy green creatures are the reason Niko can no longer tell the difference between reality and dreams.
title: The Croak

overview: A newlywed couple welcomes the husband's long time friend from abroad for an intimate dinner. As laughter and tension mingle, the husband begins to sense an unsettling closeness between his wife and their guest. Fueled by suspicion, jealousy, and pride, he considers crossing a line of his own—one that blurs guilt, desire, and the quiet undoing of trust.
tagline: Two's a party, Three's a crowd
title: Tea For Three

original_title: En duda, siempre a la izquierda
overview: After his first sexual encounter with his best friend, Maco finds his dead grandmother on the couch in his home. Moral guilt and masculine complexity erupt when, accompanied by his friends on the way to the funeral, one of the car's tires bursts in the middle of nowhere.
tagline: Moral guilt and masculine complexity erupt in Maco when, accompanied by his friends on the way to his grandmother's funeral, one of the car's tires bursts in the middle of nowhere.
title: When in doubt, go left

overview: A young man argues with someone we cannot see, reproaching him for his constant and overwhelming presence in his life. The argument is interrupted by a message from his mother, who is about to come up to visit him. In the end, we will discover who he was talking to and the terrible decision they have both made.
title: Donde mueren los pasos

overview: Pin de Fartie unfolds as a playful spin on theatrical adaptation and an experiment in character dynamics. The film charts three relationships defined by Samuel Beckett’s 1957 play Fin de Partie (Endgame): one between a blind man and his daughter; another concerning two actors rehearsing that same text; the third following a man who reads his blind mother Beckett’s play and discovers that it reflects their lives.
title: Pin de Fartie

overview: In post World War 2 France, an alcoholic writer tries to shave his moustache. What follows is an unraveling that explores his relationship to masculinity, narcissism and religion.
tagline: The most pretentious shave since Scorsese.

overview: A guy who tries to reconcile his relationship with a girl  at a library by giving her a flower. But with no luck finding the right moment, he scrambles to catch the right moment before she leaves, hoping to make amends and rekindle their relationship.
tagline: In the quiet corners of a library at the dead of night, their shared glances between the pages told a story no book could capture—two souls discovering each other in the silence of a thousand unread words.
title: Il Fiore Senza Vita

Clean hands uses traditional Noir film techniques inspired by films like Double Indemnity and much more. Clean hands was produced with a budget of $20 and borrowed equipment, being of of the first produced by this duo.
tagline: The Shadow of a Man
title: Clean Hands

title: Hypermarches : dans les coulisses d'un geant de la grande distribution

original_title: Cellules souches, le business de l'espoir
overview: “A gift so precious, you can only offer it once” was the promise Cryosave, a Swiss multinational and global leader in stem cell banking, made to hundreds of thousands of new parents. For a few thousand francs, the company offered to store their newborn’s umbilical cord blood, an insurance policy against more than 80 illnesses, a safeguard for the future. But behind the brochures lay marketing schemes, hidden commissions, and a lack of oversight. In 2019, Cryosave abruptly went bankrupt. Without notifying its clients, the company quietly transferred over 300,000 stem cell samples to a lab in Poland. Since then, many parents have been fighting to recover what they believed was safely stored.
title: Lost Cells

overview: After getting lost in the wilderness, a man befriends a group of tourists travelling to a temple.
title: Chalo Bulaava Aaya Hai

overview: Two clueless best friends pose as priests to cash in on a desperate family's plea for an exorcism, only to find themselves in way over their heads when the possessed girl might actually be the real deal.tT
title: Hail Mary

overview: A daughter returns to her childhood home for a meal, which her mother will only endure if she gets her daughter's severed eyeball in return.
tagline: An eye for an...

overview: For almost 40 years, The Jackson Theatre provided entertainment in the way of movies and traveling shows during the early to mid 20th century for the town of Jonesborough, TN. By the early 1960’s The Jackson dropped its curtains for good. Few photographs or other historical documents existed to help preserve and tell the story of the Jackson during its heyday.  At the heel of a decade long project to restore and reopen the Jackson, a group of life long residents, nearly all octogenarians, share their most memorable time visiting the Jackson when they were young. Nearly 60+ years later, on the heal of the grand reopening, the history of this small town theatre comes to life - told by those who where there.
title: The Jackson

overview: The horrors of Isla Muerta will come to light, and Jonathan knows it. This incident was what InGen tried to hide at all costs. All that remains is a recording that reveals the hell experienced by a scientist, an apprentice, and a security guard. Their struggle to survive turned into a nightmare as they faced creatures from millions of years ago. Negligence and silence led to a grotesque outcome. That night, the dinosaurs reclaimed the Earth, and all that remained were the echoes of a terror impossible to forget.
tagline: If you see a giant animal behind you, run.

overview: Nerea, a young woman who loses her hearing after an accident and struggles to reconnect with a world that no longer feels familiar. Her love for music, her disconnection from her family, and the discovery of a new friendship through sign language are all central to her emotional journey.

title: The Night of the Living Pumpkin

'Hated By Default' explores Islah's deep history with racism and Islamophobic behaviour in Britain, and how he uses his creative sword to fight against injustice, even when it seems like a losing battle.

Ever since then, Claudio has been felling trees and carving them, convinced that his son must hide in there somewhere. Between truth and fantasy, Claudio’s story is intertwined with the tale of Pinocchio, here turned upside down.

overview: The film follows an abandoned son's search for the mother who left him. Like the final scene of Im Kwon-taek’s Gilsotteum (1986), which evokes the primal power of Korean kinship, this journey is filled with lingering images and sounds. Chronicling his travels through Japan, Portugal, and Spain, the film traces the unbreakable—if unseen—thread of blood that connects a mother and son, and extends through a scattered people.
title: Letter to an Unknown Mother

title: O Silencio Herdado

overview: The Witteveen family did not often talk about the war, not even their grandmother, who had lived through it. That changes when one of her grandsons, through his aunt, comes across an old liberation skirt belonging to his grandmother, a garment she had kept for 73 years. Curious about the story behind it, he delves into archives and talks to family members in search of answers. What begins as a simple discovery becomes a personal journey through her war experiences and a reflection on his own freedom, identity, and how the traces of the past are still palpable.
title: My Grandmother's Skirt

Everything is 100% natural, environmentally friendly, and free of methane emissions. As Nicole proudly shares her vision for increased employment opportunities for women and innovation in farming, it slowly becomes clear that her drive to push boundaries goes further than expected. She's conducting a highly innovative experiment; after all, with enough encouragement, Nicole believes a great deal is possible.
title: Mannenmelk

Days pass in silence, but a jar Adem finds in the cellar, a memento from his mother, becomes the first step in reuniting these long-estranged men at the same table.

'Imagined Landscapes' explores cultural memory through landscape and examines our shifting ideas of homeland from the perspective of diaspora.

Your guides through decades of slaughter are third-dimensional enthusiasts David (D.S.) Cohen, George Hickman, and Maxim & Nick Pozderac, who have sifted through countless hours of stereoscopic cinema to bring you the most eye-popping kills and the finest depth-of-field demises. overview: "A Mixtape for Stom" is an intimate documentary portrait of Japanese experimental filmmaker Stom Sogo (1975–2012), whose frenetic Super-8mm works became emblematic of New York’s underground cinema at the turn of the millennium. A close friend, filmmaker Adrian Goycoolea reflects on Sogo’s life and legacy, framing the film as a reply to the final email he received from him.  Drawing from personal archives, interviews, and memory, the film assembles a collage of Sogo’s art and presence: radiant, restless, and unresolved. Contributors include Jonas Mekas, Bruce McClure, Raha Raissnia, Julius Ziz, Ed Halter, Andy Lampert, and members of Sogo’s family, offering perspectives on his talent, struggles, and influence.  Scored by Joe Watson of Stereolab, "A Mixtape for Stom" is at once an elegy and an act of remembrance; a meditation on friendship and grief, and a testament to an underground legacy that continues to reverberate.

Over time, he collects more clues about his past, but will it be enough to discover the truth about his family and secure a meaningful future - with or without them?

overview: What begins as an ordinary day on his grandfather’s farm turns into a journey through memory, absence, and loss. With each chore, a grandson edges closer to a devastating revelation and a last duty of love he never expected to face.

overview: Inspired by the powerful true story of the Igbo Landing of 1803, where a group of enslaved Africans chose the ocean over slavery. This poetic film follows African freediver Tatiana Mendes as she confronts her own inner turmoil beneath the surface. Through the discipline of freediving, she dives into more than just water. She descends into inherited trauma, ancestral memory, and the quiet violence of modern life.

overview: Exiled after Haiti’s political struggles of the 90s, Mikerlande—a former activist and now entrepreneur—rekindles memories of resilience and commitment. Through griot, she shares a story of struggle, legacy, and strength, bridging past and present to preserve her heritage.

overview: Necla and Cemal, trying to go from their village to the city center, find themselves in a stranger’s car. overview: The Hawthorne Society and Eternity Box Films welcome you inside the mind of Nathaniel Hawthorne.  "The Blithedale Romance" is his most personal and revealing novel.  Based on his experiences at Brook Farm and his personal relationships with Herman Melville and Margaret Fuller, the novel reveals Hawthorne's secret desires.
tagline: A Film Made for Hawthorne Lovers by Hawthorne Experts

overview: Feridun, a reclusive man crippled by a fear of the outside world, lives a quiet, isolated life—until one day, he discovers a mysterious note inside his washing machine.
title: Feridun

overview: A woman works out the best way to kill an unconscious enemy general who has sought refuge in her tent, while her two best friends dissuade her using a combination of wit, distraction, and utter disbelief in her ability to pull it off.

overview: Set in Butuan City in 2004, five football-obsessed kids use heart and hustle to help Mimi—the only girl among them—defy the odds and chase a dream that reaches far beyond the streets they call home.

overview: Two people tune into each other across the noise of the world. When the signal fades, what remains? A story of connection built not on certainty, but on echoes, pauses, and the quiet rhythm of shared moments. A relationship told through the subtle shifts of presence and absence, of intimacy and distance, and the traces we learn to hear when someone is gone.

overview: In the final hours before the end of the world, a family—parents, a grandfather, an older sibling, and the youngest child—faces the impending catastrophe in their own ways. overview: Prost takes you inside Bavaria’s Upper Franconia—home to more breweries per capita than anywhere else in the world. From ancient cellars to bustling beer gardens, this two-part film explores how beer shapes culture, tradition, and community in the region proudly known as “BierLand.”

overview: A man becomes a fugitive after escaping from prison. That same night, he returns home with a single goal: to reunite with his son and take him to the sea. Hunted by the law and held by a promise, father and son share a journey as urgent as it is fleeting.

overview: ON A QUIET BEACH, a detective is pulled into a case that blurs the line between duty and blood. Mouth of Salt is a story about loyalty, art, and the unshakable bonds that tie family together even when the truth threatens to break them apart.

overview: The Three Courses of Montgomery County takes a look at how three Maryland immigrant-owned restaurants’ food traditions help shape the state’s historically diverse identity. Through stories of heritage, resilience, and community connection through cuisine, this film offers an intimate look at the dishes and dining spaces that reflect Montgomery County’s cultural richness and evolving history, despite facing day-to-day obstacles and the effects of immigration policies under the Trump Administration.  Blending personal narratives with vivid visuals of preparation, perseverance, and celebration, these three eateries are offering more than just an appetite.

title: Entwicklungsland — Revisited

overview: Nearing the end of his life, Adolph Gasser looks back on a seventy-year career as a world-class camera repairman, WWII veteran, inventor, and best friend of nature photographer Ansel Adams, contributing developer of the first Nikon camera and a sales/rental/camera repair store owner who empowered other prominent Bay Area visual artists and inventors to succeed. As eminent domain, the internet and changing technologies threaten everything he has built, he struggles to find a way to keep moving forward. Inspired by his unique stories and abilities, filmmaker and professor John C. Aliano follows him over the course of several years and reflects on his own career trajectory.
title: Being Adolph Gasser

overview: An engrossing documentary about community and the climate crisis. The people of Stratford, California come together to survive a brutal drought.

overview: A young woman sees her deceased friend in the faces of strangers, remembering moments of their shared past through fragmented vignettes. Haunted by these memories, she faces the lonely reality of an unresolved grief that continues to shape her world.

overview: Fleeing his father’s violence, a boy drifts along the river and summer heat into the unknown, seeking his own becoming.

overview: "Err is Human" is a family drama set in the Netherlands, where an au pair returns after many years to reveal what really happened on a life-altering day decades ago. The film weaves themes of cultural nuances, human values, and how choices made in a fleeting moment can quietly shape the course of their lives.
tagline: Forgiveness is divine
title: Err is Human

original_title: The Disappearance of Dr. Abu Safiya
overview: For more than two decades, Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya served as a pediatrician in northern Gaza, rising to lead Kamal Adwan Hospital. Though he had many chances to leave, he chose to stay with his patients even as Israeli attacks escalated. With each passing month, the toll deepened. His son was killed, his hospital repeatedly struck, and his life threatened. Still, he remained at Kamal Adwan. His resilience was captured in a 10-second video: a lone pediatrician in a white coat walking through rubble toward Israeli forces. To the world, it symbolized defiance. To his family and colleagues, it reflected who he always was. Through firsthand testimony, archival footage, and on-the-ground reporting, Fault Lines investigates the assault on Kamal Adwan Hospital, the raid that led to Dr. Abu Safiya’s unlawful detention, and the broader targeting of Gaza’s healthcare system.
title: The Disappearance of Dr. Abu Safiya

overview: Palco cama is an intimate and unprecedented dive into the creative universe of José Celso Martinez Corrêa. Filmed in his bedroom, in his bed—a space of rest, sex, love, dreams, and creation—the playwright transforms everyday life into a scene, making the bed his stage. In an interview that exposes all the raw material, Zé Celso revisits the genesis of his works, narrating with passion and detail the artistic journey that has shaped Brazilian theater. The film captures the raw material of this performative conversation, where the artist performs, reflects, and surrenders himself before the camera, revealing the body and the word as central forces of his art.
title: Palco Cama

overview: A film about the joint work of Russian scientists and Buddhist monks, studying the phenomenon of "tukdam" - a special meditative state that, according to Tibetan tradition, can persist even after the body's normal life activity has ceased. The film crew observes research in monasteries in India and Nepal, recording both scientific methods and the deep spiritual side of the practice. The film tries to understand whether a true dialogue between science and ancient wisdom is possible, and to come closer to understanding what we call the nature of consciousness.

The artistic vision of the proposal is part of the tradition of "urban symphonies": documentary films that record the spaces and people of a city.

This film delves into the lives within these walls, from the battles of disrepair and crime to the inspiring solidarity in the face of adversity. Built in 1964, follows the journey of West Lodge's transformation from a symbol of struggle to a beacon of hope, as residents and new investments reshape their shared future.
title: West Lodge Redemption

overview: Crime Without Witness is a classic film noir-style short film that follows detective Fred. The story begins when Fred, after following clues that point to a murderer named Alan, receives a mysterious call upon arriving at a house and realizes that a woman has been murdered. Driven by tragedy, Fred tracks down Alan and confronts him. However, the attempt at justice ends in tragedy: The calculating criminal kills Fred. It all ends with Alan walking away down the street unpunished.

overview: Digital Smoke is an experimental meditation on light, memory, and distortion. Shot at twilight in Minneapolis’s Loring Park, the film captures the moment just after sunset, when street lamps flicker on and reflect across the lake. As Devereaux moves the camera backward and forward, fading light introduces digital noise. Rather than correct it, he amplifies the imperfection, layering light trails until the noise becomes ethereal white clouds—“digital smoke”—that dissolve the boundary between image and abstraction. Frames evoke the hazy textures of J.M.W. Turner and the pixelated aesthetic of early video games, blending painterly romanticism with digital fragmentation.
title: Digital Smoke

overview: Is it possible to make a peaceful revolt in the 21st century?  Students in Serbia, with the support of the population, have been trying for more than ten months. As predicted by Filip Balunovic, professor of the Institute for Philosophy and Social Theory at the University of Belgrade, "the president has used all the tactics unimaginable, but he will have no problem resorting to violence." overview: The King-Seer of the Non-Existent and His God's Fool Son is a performative film unfolding between theatre, ritual, and dream — a vision of power, sacrifice, and fate. From the queen’s betrayal with an idol-deity is born a fool-son — a child of alien will, a mockery of his father. The King, consumed by jealousy and dread, devours his queen and weds the very one who should have been his heir. Yet their union is doomed: fate is relentless, and the son kills the father not for the throne, but as the fulfillment of an ancient decree. Thus the kingdom dissolves, vanishing into the void, where power and sacrifice are eternal.
title: The King-Seer of the Non-Existent and His God's Fool Son

overview: A documentary about animal-assisted psychotherapy and the process of gender transition. overview: An illuminating examination of Sofonisba Anguissola's iconic masterpiece as a window into the artist's full oeuvre while painting a detailed picture of Sofonisba's journey and the world she lived in to become one of the most accomplished female artists of her time.  At a time when women were typically regarded as objects or madonnas to be represented in art, Sofonisba Anguissola (1532/5-1625) was something very different indeed: a highly respected painter and teacher who interacted with the likes of Michelangelo and Anthony van Dyck, and whose remarkable portraits were enthusiastically sought by many of the most powerful figures of the age.  The Chess Game by Sofonisba is a remarkable group portrait of three of her sisters and a maid. It is widely considered to be one of her most compelling and innovative artworks: a painting whose many subtle levels of meaning offer a fascinating window on Sofonisba, her family, and contemporary 16th-century values.
title: Sofonisba's Chess Game

overview: You Are Fire is a collaborative project envisioned by Elvin Brandhi and Daniel Bird.  This live film-performance reworks newly scanned 35mm outtakes and screen tests from the shooting of Sergei Parajanov’s The Colour of Pomegranates or Sayat Nova (1969) into 15 film miniatures. Originally conceived as a film-poem about the life of the poet-ashugh, Arutin Sayadyan, each miniature grows out of textures – Armenian, Georgian and Azeri architecture, landscapes and objects – enabling the authenticity of an era to emerge. Using Tigran Mansurian and Yuri Sayadian’s original soundtrack as raw material, the musical heritage of Sayat Nova is brought to the fore, reimagining a performance by an ashugh, or singer-poet bard, at the early 21st-century crossroads of analogue and digital media.

overview: This is one of the most beautiful rewilding stories of our time, that of Douglas and Kristine Tompkins, a couple of successful entrepreneurs – The North Face and Esprit – who decided to dedicate themselves to protecting vast territories in Patagonia. By transforming these spaces and reconstructing natural ecosystems, the development of these parks has also enabled the creation of social bonds, developed a new form of economic activity, brought forth a political space, and contributed to strengthening the population’s sense of belonging to their territories.

Each chapter centres a different voice or material: a meeting with an exhausted and lonely political organiser; silent footage of a funeral filmed by an undercover policing unit in 1979; an interview with a photographer who discovered he was the target of police surveillance; and a filmmaker grappling with the dreams and failures of collective filmmaking. Commissioned by Peer, London.

overview: Through a Mirror, Darkly examines the turbulent 1970s, a decade of hopeful rebellions and catastrophic disappointments, via flashpoint moments when American students protesting domestic racism and overseas wars were met by state violence in May 1970. In the decades that followed, a memorial community has formed around the “four dead in Ohio.” Yet while the deaths of students Allison Krause, Jeffrey Miller, Sandra Scheuer, and William Schroeder at Kent State, Ohio, are remembered, not many recall Phillip Lafayette Gibbs and James Earl Green, two students killed ten days later by police officers at Jackson State College, Mississippi, a Historically Black College.

overview: The film's hero is Sergey Kolchin, a zoologist and specialist in large predatory mammals of the Far East, who has been involved in the rehabilitation of orphaned bear cubs in various years. He returned cubs that had lost their mothers due to human error to the wild. Long months of living in the forest in the company of bear cubs allowed Sergey to learn many previously unknown facts about the Himalayan bear. The unique video material he collected formed the basis for the film "My Bears. Himalayans". This unusual animal lives in the mountain forests of South, Southeast and East Asia. The northernmost and largest of its seven subspecies, the Ussuri bear, lives in the south of the Russian Far East. Its build and ability to lead a semi-arboreal lifestyle help it survive in the same territory as the tiger and brown bear. The Himalayan bear is a poorly studied and vulnerable species, whose fate personifies the difficult fate of cedar-broadleaf forests.
