One day, his agent tells him he's about to get the opportunity of a lifetime: the lead audition for Clochard, a biopic about the life of Gustavo Noradin, a 1950s tap dance champion who fell from grace due to his addictions. When he discovers that his roommate is also preparing for the same role, a rivalry is born that begins to obsess him. Between exhausting rehearsals, a mother who keeps trying to reach him, and a fearsome casting director, Giancarlo's identification with the character becomes total, to the point of jeopardizing his true identity.
title: The Protagonist

overview: Gaspard, a teenager from the suburbs of Lisbon, falls into the hands of the Ogre, a man who has made a pact with the Devil. The Ogre uses the boy to attract tourists, whom he transforms into animals and then kills. Gaspard escapes with a donkey and a dog that he has grown fond of, and in an enchanted manor, he meets the spirit of Queen D. Maria I.
title: The Tree of Knowledge

overview: The Edinburgh Comedy Award-winning, total sell-out, global cult sensation is coming to the Eventim Apollo for its biggest and most spectacular show yet. Lucia and Cristina, accompanied by their husbands, spend the summer in a small beach village whose charm has faded over time. Shaira embarks on a journey to go in search of a special seed that will make the heavens rain again to bring her horse back.

He then surprised fans with The Aura, a thriller that established him as a versatile director, before his sudden death. Actors and crew will return to the original locations, while his family and previously unseen footage reveal the man behind the artist.
title: Nine Auras

The truth came crashing down, cruelly, after decades of lies: it was at the request of Farid's mother that his father had left them, and it wasn't for another woman, but because he himself aspired to be one... As he wrestles with his identity, he discovers that true freedom lies not in fitting in, but in embracing who he truly is.

What follows is a story of hope, help, and inspiration as Mahler helps all of the students and (against all odds) will try to clear them for release, which will help Stevenson be able to take care of his debt. Starring Johnny Mask, Bryan Brewer, Chris Spinelli, Sofia Studenikina, Sofia Papuashvili, Jamie Grefe, and Hazel Gonzalez, BAD GIRLS GO HOME is a vertical feature film unlike anything you've ever seen before. Filled with drama, heartfelt emotion, human conflict, and heartwarming inspiration, BAD GIRLS GO HOME will inspire you to do better and to be better.

overview: Tiong, a young man from the village who possesses the ability to summon the spirit of the White Wuchang God, stopped using his gift after the tragic death of his parents. Thirteen years later, he returns to a village afflicted by the curse of a vengeful pregnant spirit. When his brother`s wife is about to give birth and her life becomes endangered, Tiong finally accepts his destiny.
title: White

overview: Shruti Kothari, a stroke survivor and once in-demand theatre performer, finds her way back on stage for the first time in four years.
title: That Which Is Heard

overview: When Sarah films a holiday movie in Ottawa, a chance encounter with a local baker sparks a festive romance. Trying to embrace the holiday spirit for her role, David takes Sarah on a day of festive adventure. Along the way, she discovers the magic of Ottawa, and the charm of her guide.
title: Magic on Set

overview: This documentary explores the enduring resilience of Navajo Nation families who refuse to abandon their land. In 1974, the U.S. government enacted the Navajo-Hopi Land Settlement Act, leading to widespread displacement. The film highlights the people of Black Mesa, where a few Navajo families continue to stand their ground, preserving their heritage and fighting for their ancestral right to remain on their sacred land.
tagline: Our Land
title: Nihikéyah

overview: Go deep behind the scenes with visionary filmmaker Guillermo del Toro and the "Frankenstein" cast and crew as they give new life to the classic tale.
title: Frankenstein: The Anatomy Lesson

overview: Being an adult is hard. It's especially hard when you’re only fifteen. Danutė is the only "adult" in her family. Clearly, that’s far too complex a role for a teenager. Every day, she faces external limitations that restrict her potential. A child like that measures everything through the lens of survival and takes on responsibility as her only form of protection.
title: They Call Me Danka

original_title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers Part II
overview: Four friends' lives become intertwined when romance blooms between a doctor and a comedian, while his best friend falls for her free-spirited bestie. After a tragic event, their relationships evolve into something deeper than friendship.
title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers Part II

overview: The inspiring journey of the Jamaican women's soccer team, on and off the pitch, on their way to the FIFA Women's World Cup 2023.
title: Reggae Girlz

overview: A laidback Mediterranean man discovers a mute mermaid while fishing and, enchanted by her otherworldliness, brings her to his backyard pool, unaware that she sacrificed her voice to be with him. As he puts her on display, seeing her as little more than a peculiar catch, she reluctantly has to accept the enormous price of her naivëte and blind desire
title: Sirena

overview: After being steeped in Chinese traditional culture for 30 years, CHEN went to Paris in 1984. The different cultural environments of China and France enabled him to grow into a unique figure in the field of classical music. CHEN neither seeks approval from the West, not even his advisor Olivier Messiaen, nor caters to China. Instead, he uses his personal musical language to tell Eastern stories.
title: Hidden Landscapes

overview: When city broker Daisy inherits a ranch before Christmas, she’s torn between selling it or keeping it. Reconnecting with an old crush, she falls in love with the property and must choose between her career and her heart before the season ends.
title: Christmas at Fields Ranch

overview: After many years working for a multinational company, Hugo Vaca is laid off and must face the harsh reality of the job market. On the verge of despair, he connects through a friend with a group of investors who offer to buy his house, valued at one million dollars, at 50 percent of its value, but with usufruct rights until his death. Cornered by reality, he accepts the deal, but things end up becoming much more complicated than he expected.
title: La casa

overview: Two inept criminals, Cammy and Coops, are tasked with burying their first body in the woods but find themselves at loggerheads when they realise that they’ve only brought one spade.
title: Deli Meat

original_title: The New Yorker Theater: A Talbot Legacy
overview: A documentary on Dan and Toby Talbot's running their first movie theater.
title: The New Yorker Theater: A Talbot Legacy

original_title: Secret Life of a Good Wife
overview: Inspired by the real life “trad wife” movement, this story follows an influencer with a traumatic past who finds peace, love, and internet fame as a “traditional housewife” with her new husband. But when her mother goes missing after questioning her lifestyle, she’ll realize the kind and loving community she’s come to rely on harbors dark secrets. Teaming with her estranged sister, she’ll set out to uncover the truth, but breaking her “good wife” role could have deadly consequences.
title: Secret Life of a Good Wife

overview: A relationship between two young people geographically distant from each other: Camilla and Matteo, Milan and Naples. A story of love and sex, told by the merciless eye of those who do not believe in fairy tales.  The two will be able to heal from their own pathologies in a happy ending that, however, is not consumed.
title: V.A.S.

overview: Franck is a soldier. He watches the streets of Paris. But one day, Franck decides to leave.
title: Franck

overview: Maria Vitória lives in a remote village in the Portuguese mountains and plays football on the local boys youth team. Determined to become a professional, she devotes all her free time to intense training with her father. Their routine is shaken by the unexpected return of her older brother, who left many years earlier after a tragic fire that took their mother’s life. As she prepares for the most important match of her life, Maria begins to question her father’s authority and gradually seeks a way to break free and take control of her own future.
title: Maria Vitória

overview: Free Fish is a short documentary filmed over the course of a year in Gaza, following two brothers — Abu Nagham and Ahmad — separated by war yet connected by the sea. Displaced from their home, Abu Nagham now lives in a tent in the south, fishing with his young nephew Rami, who lost his twin brother. Ahmad remains in the north, fishing amid ruins and occupation.  Once a source of livelihood and freedom, the sea has become a battleground — heavily restricted, constantly watched, and always dangerous. Through intimate footage and poetic observation, the film captures the everyday courage required to cast a net, mend a line, or share a meal. Fishing becomes an act of survival, resistance, and hope.  Co-directed by Bisan Owda (Peabody Award 2024) and Carolina Pereira, Free Fish offers a deeply personal and universal story of resilience in the face of erasure — a quiet tribute to a people who refuse to be forgotten.
tagline: Displaced and divided, two brothers in Gaza return to the sea — where fishing becomes their last act of survival, resistance, and hope.
title: Free Fish

overview: A young woman, trapped in the throes of a binge eating disorder, becomes a ravenous creature threatening to devour the town.
title: GRAIN

overview: While her family is still at church, 27-year-old Monika sets the table for Christmas dinner at home. She's finally ready to do it: come out.
title: How to Kill Your Family

overview: A chronicle of a woman’s courageous fight for survival, whose 1975 acquittal challenged injustice and inspired a nation to confront sexual violence and racism.
title: Free Joan Little

overview: In this intimate film, three Deaf couples share their remarkable love stories through Irish Sign Language: a decades-long forbidden romance across a religious divide, an LGBTQI+ couple navigating parenthood with Deaf and hearing children, and a Deaf boxer and his hearing partner facing a life-altering choice.
title: A Quiet Love

overview: Kathiravan raises three orphans—Sathya, Surya, and Shiva—as his own, grooming them to unknowingly support his illegal mushroom drug empire. Despite being used as pawns, the trio remains loyal out of love. After killing his former boss and seizing control of the business, Kathiravan earns the wrath of Radha, the boss’s widow, who plots revenge. Meanwhile, Varsha, a local woman and love interest of Sathya, plans to transfer her estate to its workers. Threatened by this, Kathiravan manipulates the employees, turning them against her. As Varsha’s life hangs in the balance, Sathya and Radha must confront Kathiravan—leading to a climactic reckoning.
title: Vattakhanal

overview: A well-meaning but unlucky cop accidentally gets dosed with LSD before his ex-wife's Christmas party, forcing him to navigate surreal hallucinations, awkward family drama, and holiday chaos to prove he's a responsible father and husband.
title: Tripping Through the Holidays

original_title: Ours Was A Timeless Night Burning
overview: Two unacquainted daughters are forced to kill time together through demystifying pregnancy and watching an adult sitcom as they await their fathers’ return from a night of endless gambling.
title: Ours Was A Timeless Night Burning

overview: The untold backstory of one of gaming's greatest villains, Doctor Eggman
tagline: Fear the Moustache
title: Project Eggman

overview: One day in the life of Angelos and Ioanna, each dealing with last night's fight.
title: Sleeppers

overview: A film about events in Latvian history during the heyday of the women's basketball team TTT. Five people with different worldviews and life experiences suddenly find themselves locked in a room by artificial intelligence. Like a dispassionate moderator, it offers a harsh game: in order to return to reality, each person must prove their ability to distinguish truth from lies about Latvian history from the mid-1940s to the 1960s.
title: Laika tīklā

original_title: the house was there before me
overview: A queer couple moves into an abandoned family house during the first year of the pandemic. Something in the house, neither dead nor alive, helps them transition to a new era of self-awareness.
title: the house was there before me

overview: A survivor recounts his memories of the tragedy of the Iolaire disaster which took place on New Year's Day 1919 off the coast of the Isle of Lewis.
title: Survivor

overview: A stubborn VCR technician quits his job at an evolving tech-solutions conglomerate to start his own small business in hopes of making a final stand to stay relevant through the changing times.
tagline: "To play is human. To rewind is divine!"
title: Attenuation

overview: We look in on two men, Jim and his insurance agent Pete, as Jim's stolen car is revealed to be part of an eccentric and fraudulent plan that he seems to have no say in.
title: Craggy Confidant

original_title: Le chagrin des animaux : mythe ou réalité ?
title: Le chagrin des animaux : mythe ou réalité ?

original_title: We are Greenland: Football Is Freedom
title: We are Greenland: Football Is Freedom

overview: A crew of criminals execute the perfect heist, stealing a priceless liquor bottle from a notorious gang leader. But what begins as a clean getaway spirals into a storm of betrayal, bloodshed, and long-buried secrets. As the truth unravels, they discover the real battle isn't for the loot - it's for survival.
title: The Academy of Fine Arts

overview: A discarded narrative from a music video is reborn as a standalone short film. A day in the life of a man who shows both sides of his coin.
title: Madhouse

overview: Oscar works at a company that designs mental simulations, technologies that expose the crumbling inner worlds of patients. What begins as observation soon draws him deeper into these fragile realities, until the line between watching and living dissolves.
title: The Distortion of a World

overview: A story inspired by a fairy tale written by a sister to her imprisoned brother in Belarus — a country where he remains behind bars on political charges. Political prisoners in Belarusian prisons are often deprived of phone calls and visits. A care package is sometimes the only link to the outside world. In this story, the package comes to life and sets out on its own journey to the prison to reach the inmate.
title: The Care Package

overview: A hybrid short documentary exploring the fracture between a queer daughter and her mother, featuring the filmmaker’s own personal archive. The film blends documentary and narrative elements to depict the filmmaker’s mother’s rigid vision for her daughter’s life, set against the reality unfolding through archival footage dating back to 1995. Through directing an actor to play her mother and fill in the widening gaps over time, O’Connor now attempts to sculpt her mother.
title: The Fault Line

overview: Lokkhikantopur Local movie deals with the life ordeals of house helps Kalyani, Maloti and Saraswati, visiting three different families in Kolkata.
title: Lokkhikantopur Local

overview: “Being Jérôme Boateng” tells the story of a soccer world champion between triumph and downfall. From the soccer field to the 2014 World Cup title, from celebrated symbol of integration to convicted perpetrator of intentional bodily harm against his ex-partner.  The documentary series looks behind the façade of professional soccer—a system that produces heroes but neglects people. It also addresses the question of how a soccer player is stylized into a role model by the media and society and burdened with excessive expectations.  Boateng's story is thus also one of false projections that encourages us to reflect on our treatment of and longing for sports idols: What do we want to see in them? Do soccer players have to be heroes?
title: Being Jérôme Boateng

overview: Following his feature film Animal Macula, Sylvain L’Espérance explores with renewed originality the archives of world cinema, often far removed from the obvious landmarks of canon cinephilia. This time, his focus is on the presence of human beings on the move in films. With meticulousness, poetry, and symbolism, this work arranges this similar yet heterogeneous material to form a kind of relay race through eras, countries, and environments. In this way, these individual movements follow one another, respond to one another, or merge, tracing the complex trajectory of an imagined community travelling through a dreamlike, timeless memory. A solitary means of transport and a leisurely stroll, walking is also a vehicle for a common affirmation, collective action, solidarity, and even popular uprising.
title: Marche commune

overview: In a dystopian future plagued by toxic red air, a couple's confinement becomes a battle between hope and despair—as one withers, the other blooms.
title: Earth

overview: A relaxing bath turns into a nightmare as a clinically depressed Tristan is tormented by his cruelest critic, himself.
title: Murmur

overview: After losing her big-city job, Jules returns home to save her family’s Christmas carnival, rediscovering love, community, and holiday spirit.
title: Christmas North of Nashville

overview: A young woman is locked in a toilet cubicle, drink spiked and at the mercy of the women around her.
tagline: Can you hear her over the music?
title: Honey

overview: A nostalgic, immersive journey through the Jewish Catskills—once known as the Borscht Belt—told through the rise and fall of its most beloved resort: Grossinger’s Resort and Hotel, the real-life inspiration for Dirty Dancing.
title: We Met at Grossinger’s

overview: Sato Tadao is a giant of film criticism with over 150 published works to his name. He adored Asian cinema and referred to one Indian film, Kummatty, as his treasure. The director sets out on a journey in search of that treasure.
title: Journey into Sato Tadao

overview: This documentary offers a rare look at domestic abuse through the concept of coercive control. With exceptional access to hearings in Poitiers, Colmar, and Paris, Karine Dusfour captures the first French trials to address this form of psychological violence. The film shows how coercive control traps partners through constant monitoring, a hidden terror affecting hundreds of thousands of women and children in France.
title: Je vais te tuer

overview: The Marbles started filming on the 25th of March 2021 the day Greece celebrated its 200th year of freedom, and outlines the case for the Parthenon Marbles to be returned to Athens. Documenting the ups and downs that have occurred since.
tagline: A documentary feature film that will TELL THE TRUTH.
title: The Marbles

overview: It tells the story of Sofia and Alessio, two souls struggling with themselves who, between the Sannio vineyards and the Felix bar, find love and the courage to truly be themselves.
title: Qui staremo benissimo

overview: Sabyr finds a way to connect with his past. A touching comedy from the Nazar Audar team.
title: Allo

overview: Two women - a young doctor and the wife of a former prime minister, are trying to escape the grip of the American government and European diplomats, who are playing their game of power and torture in a small country in Eastern Europe.
tagline: The untold story about the rape of Europa
title: Tomorrow Morning

overview: Three Chinese Canadian sisters all defied their mother’s wishes and became accomplished dancers. Each Chinese New Year they reunite to lead Vancouver’s Chinatown Parade. As they come together, they must confront their own fractured identities and decide if their mother's legacy means continuing the parade.
title: Spring After Spring

overview: Abhanga Tukaram based on the Abhanga saga of Saint Tukaram Maharaj A rich collection of saintly literature on the silver screen. Maharashtra has been enriched by the thought of saints. The Abhangagatha of Jagadguru Sant Shrestha Tukaram Maharaj is a very valuable treasure in Marathi literature.
title: Abhanga Tukaram

overview: After a breakup, Lola casts a spell for the perfect boyfriend. When a man appears at the door her mother quickly falls for him.
tagline: Be careful what you wish for... especially when mom is around
title: Wishful Thinking

overview: A grieving young woman must confront her darkest fears and a deadly aquatic creature as she struggles to prove the horrors beneath the lake are real.
tagline: Beneath the surface a terror lies in waiting
title: Goon of the Lagoon

original_title: Die Anden - Im Bann der Urkräfte
title: Die Anden - Im Bann der Urkräfte

overview: What happens when the thing we consume ends up consuming us?
title: Mr TV Man

overview: When a group of kids accidentally destroy part of a school garden, they uncover the caretaker's complicated past-and learn through the act of replanting how empathy and forgiveness are important to growth.
title: The Garden

overview: 8-year-old Jérémy is ready for a typical evening with his parents and little brother. But his mother’s behavior grows more and more unsettling.
title: Beyond

overview: Chou, a sensitive teen craving independence, struggles as the 1996 Taiwan Strait crisis hits his family's finances and worsens tensions at home. He secretly works at a billiard hall, forming a bond with gang leader Button, but faces setbacks like Button's enlistment and peer conflicts. Caught by his father, their relationship worsens. At school, his crush Min leaves due to war fears, and pressure from a teacher deepens his uncertainty.
title: Before the Bright Day

overview: A top secret Alaskan lab goes dark due to an unexplained incident, prompting the military to send a black ops team to recover sensitive data and destroy the lab, only to find their ranks infected with a deadly alien virus.
tagline: THE DANGER IS WITHIN
title: Contamination

overview: An experimental short film set in London, 1967. Scott Walker leaves pop-sensation The Walker Brother's and stumbles on the inspiration for his solo career.
title: Scott

overview: “My family was shocked when they found out that I'm driving,” says Eva, a Kenyan woman, as she sits behind the wheel of a truck, heavily pregnant. She botched up her school years and was the only one in her family not to graduate. Pretty foolish, she admits in hindsight, but now she is glad to have chosen a profession she can be proud of. She sees more of the world than her brothers and sisters do.
title: Truck Mama

overview: "My mother was sure she was going to have twins, but then she just gave birth to me. Of course, everyone except herself knew we weren't going to be twins, but my mother always believed what she wanted, not what was... and I ended up being an only twin, or a twin with an only son, or something along those lines."
title: Half Unseen

overview: Documentary on '90s British vampire culture.
title: Vampires Forever

overview: In this thriller story, devout detective Angelo Matteo and his partner Rufus engage in a raid, uncovering a gruesome scene of a serial killer's victims. As they investigate, Angelo's inner demons and questions about the nature of good and evil haunt him, leading to struggles with alcohol and strained relationships, including with his wife Ashley. Meanwhile, a disturbed individual named Ed Erdella picks up young men at bus stops and subjects them to horrifying torture. Angelo's pursuit of justice intensifies as he battles personal demons, seeks therapy, and uncovers a larger conspiracy involving missing persons. The story follows Angelo's journey to unravel the truth and bring the killer to justice while confronting his own inner turmoil.
tagline: The real demons live inside us.
title: Hate Thyself

overview: ‘Pinjar’ is an evocative meditation on captivity—of bodies, of spirits, of choices—unfolding through the entangled lives of five individuals and a wild bird.
title: Pinjar

overview: Final girl seeks shelter from infamous masked killer.
tagline: "He's here!"
title: The Black River Smasher

overview: Explores the battle around the teaching of African-American studies from inside the classroom, focusing on the transformative journeys of the Arkansas students, teachers and families who are part of the very first, inaugural classes of students taking AP African-American Studies nationwide.
title: Teaching America

overview: When Congress announces they will be closing a very popular fast food chain because it may be addictive, everyone rushes to get a taste, including our heroes who discover a terrifying secret. Now getting some EEs might be their last meal.
tagline: EdiblEats, so good you'll be dying to eat some!
title: EdiblEats

overview: Maria is a woman living with her son Marinel in a Moldovan village while waiting for her husband, who works abroad. The arrival of Felicia — her childhood friend and a soprano now living in Vienna — and Felicia’s husband Mario, disrupts the fragile balance of their quiet world.
title: Mario, Maria, Marinel - MMM

overview: This silent, short film from Spooky Ventures is a pseudo-vintage adaptation of the Ambrose Bierce short story "Moxon's Master." It's a cautionary tale about AI.
title: Moxon's Master

overview: *Haati Haati Paa Paa* follows a young woman and her elderly father as they navigate love, duty, and loneliness in a changing world. It portrays the daughter’s struggle to care for her aging father, highlighting modern family conflicts and the deep, unspoken bond that transcends generations.
title: Haati Haati Paa Paa

overview: The king of Amaragiri calls upon the detective Ramakrishna to find the cause behind the villager's sudden memory loss. His search leads Rama to a web of political schemes and historical conspiracies.
title: Vikkatakavi - The Movie

overview: Youth counselor Romy desperately wants to have a child. When she's assigned to support a pregnant sixteen-year-old, Romy sees this as an opportunity to make her wish come true. As their bond grows, Romy projects her own desires onto the girl. But is the way she's pursuing her desire to have a child still responsible?
title: Mama Romy

overview: A Jewish Millennial woman has a breakdown at her great-aunt’s shiva when she learns that there’s no room left for her in the family mausoleum.
title: Being Dead Should Be Easy

overview: A shy eighth-grader comes across an older girl who is posing naked in an abandoned building. A new friendship offers her a glimpse of the intriguing world of adulthood.
title: Girls Don't Breathe

overview: A dedicated boat captain and his dog patrol the Hudson River, monitoring environmental concerns after decades of industrial damage. Despite improvements, their mission reveals ongoing challenges to this historic waterway's ecosystem.
title: The Keeper

overview: A high school is preparing to conduct a simulated terrorist-attack drill, and a self-conscious student is assigned to play the role of the hostage-taker.
title: Not to Die Alone

overview: When a woman travels home to her mother's funeral and has to deliver a eulogy, she must decide whether or not to mention something that has been kept secret from the rest of the family.
title: The Last Word

overview: As a young woman meditates blindfolded in her apartment, a robber taunts her by torturing her boyfriend.
title: Mediator

overview: Justine is in her room, in her bed. Her alarm goes off and it takes a long time for her to turn the sound off. She goes back to sleep. The film takes place in Justine’s bedroom. The camera almost never leaves these four walls. And neither does she.
title: My Sister’s Room

overview: An old Hawaii myth of a plank-board cursed to protect the queen and her heirs is awakened. Will Police Captain Merry Miller be able to protect her step-daughter Lili, descendant of the throne, and stop the devil board from absorbing the soul of every last surfer in Kailua town?
title: Plankenstein: A Killer Surf Movie

overview: A slice of life set over a 24-hour period that follows the personal odysseys of five very different people, whose lives intertwine when America’s favorite televised antiques appraisal show comes to Cleveland, "the best location in the nation".
tagline: This holiday season, it's what's inside that counts.
title: Lost & Found in Cleveland

original_title: Legacy of Screams: The Evolution of Horror Movies
overview: Dive into 60 minutes of blood, bravado and brilliant scares as we trace the evolution of horror cinema from Dracula (1931) to today.
tagline: Horror Movies Themselves Refuse to Die!
title: Legacy of Screams: The Evolution of Horror Movies

original_title: El día de la muerte de Kurt Cobain
overview: April 1994. Hector and Daría, two opposite teenagers, escape from high school and discover an unexpected friendship on the same day that a youth icon dies.
title: The Day Kurt Cobain Died

overview: The story of an ordinary park bench where the lives of different young people intersect.
title: Pink ehk Elude Ristmik

overview: Are jellyfish about to take over the oceans? This captivating documentary reveals the superpowers of these seemingly fragile creatures, which are taking advantage of over-fishing, pollution, and global warming to proliferate.
title: Méduses les souveraines des océans

overview: Lost on an alien planet, a lone astronaut searching for his mother encounters a world that seems to be searching for him in return.
title: Oneiros

overview: When a private investigator is hired to find a missing girl whose identity has been stolen by a con artist, he must race against time to locate her before it's too late. As he delves deeper into the case, he uncovers a web of secrets.
title: Fatal Fraud

overview: A short fil that follows a body subjected to institutional and diffuse forms of power: medicalization, psychiatric labeling, regimes of sexuality, and everyday violence. Moving between a white clinical space, a cemetery in Toulouse, and ordinary interiors, the film unfolds through gestures, textures, and encounters with other bodies. Inspired by Michel Foucault, Deleuze and Guattari, Artaud, Rancière, and critical thought from Latin America, this short film traces a sensitive cartography of emancipation and asks a simple yet difficult question: what can a body do when it attempts to reclaim its own history?
title: Deux corps

overview: May 1977. Undercover British army Captain Robert Nairac is abducted and killed by the IRA - his body secretly buried. Decades on, a former enemy searches for his remains.
title: The Disappearance of Captain Nairac

overview: The blood of a serial abuser is spilled in the woods on a nearby fir tree. One year later on Christmas it's chopped down and a married couple buys the tree, soon the tree reawakens to continue it's sexual and murderous rampage.
title: Christmas Rape Tree

original_title: A Free Daughter of Free Kyrgyzstan
overview: A fearless young singer challenges her oppressive culture through bold music videos, risking everything to amplify women's voices despite dangerous opposition.
title: A Free Daughter of Free Kyrgyzstan

overview: Judith, a 15-year-old girl, shares the story of her first sexual experience via a live stream on social media. The next day, she is harassed and humiliated by her classmates. The response from those around her will make her question whether or not she is guilty of what happened and what she can do to rejoin the group.
title: Play

original_title: わたしが恋人になれるわけないじゃん、ムリムリ!（※ムリじゃなかった!?）～ネクストシャイン！～
overview: Renako Amaori, a former gloomy and socially awkward girl, reinvented herself for high school and successfully made her debut. She even managed to join the top- tier popular group... only to be suddenly confessed to by two of its brightest stars?! While still struggling to give them an answer, Renako agrees to help her friend Kaho by joining a cosplay event. It's the perfect excuse to delay her reply... or so she thought. But as she witnesses Kaho's passion firsthand, something begins to stir inside her.
title: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless… ~Next Shine~

original_title: Y Vân: The Lost Sounds of Saigon
overview: While exploring her grandfather's musical legacy, a filmmaker reveals a forgotten chapter of Vietnam's past.
title: Y Vân: The Lost Sounds of Saigon

overview: 2015, a remote village in a remote region of Uzbekistan. Gulchehra earns her living by combing cotton wool. It is hard work, but she has little choice: she needs to support herself and her elderly mother-in-law. Her husband is working in another country and Gulchehra does not realise that he is not coming back. After the death of her mother-in-law, Gulchehra is left alone in a hostile world, where morals and hypocritical morality reign supreme.
title: Cotton

overview: A lavish dinner party turns uncomfortable for Jacob when he learns of the hosts unusual and archaic approach for settling debates.
title: Technophobic

overview: A middle aged Indian man works a monotonous nine to five. During a smoke break, he retreats into magical memories that he doesn’t quite remember experiencing. His thoughts are repeatedly interrupted by visions of tablas being sharply played. During his recollection, he is transported to an impressionistic dimension of colors and patterns where he pursues a mysterious yet familiar figure.
title: Jahaan

overview: Martynas' peaceful morning is disrupted by the return of his roommate with a girlfriend. His curiosity soon becomes part of the couple's game.
title: Morning Mosh

overview: A neighborhood soccer field. Rana and his team feel humiliated by the Brazilians from the neighborhood next door, who have been beating them for a long time. But today they are not going to allow themselves to lose, especially in front of Alba, Rana's ex, who comes out to play against them in a five-on-five game where everyone has something against everyone else. This is the perfect opportunity for the boys from the Polígono X neighborhood to do something they have been waiting for a long time: expel the Brazilians from their neighborhood.
title: Polígono X

overview: After a great first date, a man and a woman spend the night at his house on an island in Istanbul. The next morning, he expects her to leave, but she lingers, her presence becoming increasingly unsettling.
title: Whites and Colors

overview: A woman seeks to bury her past but soon finds herself barraged by the relentless inner turmoils of her mind.
title: Anastasis

overview: It was eleven years ago when Trine, then 34-year-old, set fire to her house, an act that would land her in long-term psychiatric confinement. Despite countless suicide attempts, and without having fully quelled her (self-)destructive impulses, this woman now appears resolved to make an extremely ambitious fresh start: to portray her inner world in theatrical form. As she prepares the project with the help of filmmaker Alexander Lind, he is shooting what one might call the epitome of a meta-documentary. At the periphery of this recording, and in the front row opposite the theater stage, Trine's parents are waiting, with whom she yearns to reconcile.
title: Trine on Fire

overview: A wife and mother who feels trapped in a life of service to her family, accidentally discovers the power to walk through walls.
title: I Walked Through the Wall

overview: When confronted by her most private desire at her grandmother's funeral, a young Polish-American woman struggles to navigate her truth and her familial pressure to conform.
title: The Last Goodbye

overview: This special offers a rare glimpse into the Kapoors, Hindi cinema's first family, over an afternoon of conversation, nostalgia and homemade delicacies.
title: Dining with the Kapoors

overview: After Yana finds out that her best friend is trapped in the war in Ukraine, she is forced to examine the moral compasses within her family. She visits her grandparents, who seem to trust Russian TV and radio more than her own account of events. This intimate drama is based on the reality of families divided by the war in Ukraine, including the author’s own. The film explores the inevitable choices between love and politics, friends and family, silence and resistance.
title: Materials Mechanics

overview: For fear of rejection, Betty lives in isolation at home, in a reality constructed with miniature figurines—one of whom she has developed a relationship with. After meeting a woman she can’t forget, Betty faces a difficult decision: continue her private life at home with her miniature boyfriend, or venture into the outside world and risk rejection in pursuit of a genuine, vulnerable connection with a stranger.
title: Itty Bitty Betty

overview: At his birthday party, a young introvert must confront his family's conservative ideals when his boyfriend unexpectedly shows up.
title: Feliz Cumpleaños, Eric

overview: Zaz, a man leading a simple life, has his life turned upside down by a video that goes viral on social media. His newfound fame leads him to be involved in advertisements and unexpected situations, creating tension with his family and drawing him into complex legal issues.
title: Zaz

overview: Herve Rossini is a renowned artist who expresses himself through his surrealist garden. Tonight is the opening of his last exhibition. As he unveils his final artwork to the public, his daughter Rosalie announces that she is leaving the garden forever.
title: Le Jardin Rossini

overview: MEAT-THING is a absurdist comedy about Jo, a quiet butcher whose routine unravels when a slab of meat begins to speak to her.  As the meat—strangely alive and deeply self-aware—forces Jo to confront questions of existence, shame, and meaning, she spirals through a city that continues without noticing.  Haunted but unwilling to accept what’s happening, Jo carries the talking flesh to a friend’s ramen shop, where, under the weight of his own denial, he gives it up.  The meat is chopped and served without protest. A deadpan exploration of guilt, disconnection, and the absurd comfort of pretending nothing’s wrong.
title: MEAT THING

overview: Elira, Chiara, and Diego, three young people already intertwined in the past, embark on a three-way love affair. Despite their differing perspectives on commitment, intimacy, and relationships, the love between them is undeniable. During a night together in Madrid, their disagreements surface, turning their encounter into a struggle between harmony and fear.
title: Metta

overview: Shelly, a brash, no-nonsense carpenter, is on a mission to empower Black women to reclaim their futures, one home at a time. Through her innovative program, participants learn construction skills and financial literacy to renovate and purchase abandoned row houses in Baltimore. As dilapidated quarters become dream homes, the women’s personal journeys and stories of determination and community offer a powerful blueprint for breaking cycles of poverty and revitalizing neighborhoods from within.
title: Saving Etting Street

overview: Two hours after the apocalypse started in the Philippines, a silly Filipino stray rescue dog is dead set on finding her student owner through a long dangerous journey to defeat her worst enemy: an empty food bowl.
title: Runo!

overview: Lis, a 10-year-old boy, whose father is a missing person from the Kosovo war, lives cramped in a small apartment with his family during early 2000. Trying to forget a secret only he knows, Lis joins a French trio of clowns who are in Kosovo to entertain the children of the land. Soon enough Lis will learn that reality will catch up with everyone, and he will have to face his suppressed emotions.
title: The Odyssey of Joy

overview: Rakat, a child of Batak descent, is overwhelmed with guilt after being forced to kill a dog in order to be served as food for his father’s restaurant.
title: Caged Dogs Bark Silently

overview: When Piper and Dawson are invited home for the holidays, they find themselves unraveling a series of festive clues and heartfelt challenges.
title: Christmas at Mistletoe Hall

overview: A timid young man's promising date is ruined when his lingering ex-girlfriend still living in his apartment unexpectedly intervenes, forcing him to confront their unresolved feelings.
tagline: You can't date your HR
title: Self-possessed women make you nervous

overview: Lost soul Dermot is newly widowed and turns to an unusual pastime to process his pain. But his gatecrashing of every wake he can across rural county Antrim doesn’t go unnoticed. The new funeral director and her young son catch him in the act but then make him an offer he surely can’t refuse.
title: Mourning Glory

overview: Parrisu is a tamil movie starring Jaanvekaa Subramaniam and Kiran Pradeep  in prominent roles. It is directed by Kala Alluri.
title: Parrisu

overview: Following the acclaimed Laurel & Hardy: Year One and Laurel & Hardy: Year Two collections, Flicker Alley and Blackhawk Films® are proud to announce the culmination of the duo's silent years. Laurel & Hardy: Year Three brings to Blu-ray disc nine of L&H's most beloved classic shorts, newly restored and joined by a host of rare archival material that also includes several of their earliest sound films.
title: Laurel & Hardy: Year Three

overview: Callous and crippled, former pirate Ed meets Regina, an escaped enslaved woman who offers him justice for his crew, a chance to walk again, and a shot at redemption – in exchange for a favour. After initially refusing, Ed sacrifices himself by securing justice for his crew, freeing Regina, and inspiring her to become a pirate.
title: A Man Fate Forgot

overview: An agent bound to an alien relic fights to save the world.
title: The Archivists

original_title: How Tanita Tikaram Became A LIAR
overview: The documentary directed by Natacha Horn explores the creative and emotional journey of British singer songwriter Tanita Tikaram, blending music, intimacy and reflection into something both cinematic and deeply human.
title: How Tanita Tikaram Became A LIAR

overview: Competitive swimmer Bulet finds herself drowning on the day of a small town wedding.
title: Surface Tension

overview: Sixteen-year-old Sara, on a blue voyage with her family, suddenly notices the presence of a stranger on the deck of the boat.
title: Bimba

overview: Behind the closed doors of this hotel lie very different secrets: the guests try to escape the world for an hour, while the housekeeper goes about her work as usual.
title: Room Number

overview: Drifting through his post-industrial town scavenging for scrap, isolated teenager Sandy finds unexpected purpose after meeting conspiracy theorist Don, who tasks him with destroying a local wind farm
title: Giants

original_title: Lobito Bound: A Journey to Africa's New Frontier
overview: As the world races for critical minerals, a new trade route is transforming Central Africa. Lobito-Bound: A journey to Africa’s new frontier follows explorer Dwayne Fields - in partnership with pan-African mobile provider Africell - from the Indian Ocean to the Atlantic along the Lobito Corridor, tracing the impact of global power struggles on local lives. Through voices on the ground, the film explores whether the Lobito Corridor will bring real progress or simply shift the balance of control.
title: Lobito Bound: A Journey to Africa's New Frontier

overview: When a rising chef’s career implodes after a harsh review, she returns to her Amish roots in rural Pennsylvania only to find healing through slow-cooking techniques and the comforts of home, including rekindling a friendship with the sweet Amish farmer she left behind.
title: Christmas in Amish Country

overview: When the ridiculous rules of a tyrant target a young woman, she decides to fight back. It only takes one domino to make them all fall.
title: Signs

overview: On a young waitress’s birthday, the perplexing appearance of one of her deceased mother’s homemade cakes deeply troubles her. Over her shift that evening, surrounded by happy families in the little restaurant where she works, memories of her mother crowd in, and her attempts to repress her emotions grow ever more difficult.
title: Eggshells

original_title: Queens of the Stone Age - Baloise Session
overview: In the silence of the Paris catacombs, Queens of the Stone Age reinvented themselves during a stripped-down yet intensely powerful acoustic set. The film "Alive in the Catacombs" captured the essence of the performance—resonating water droplets, natural echoes, ghostly plays of light—transforming it into a live experience where desert rock reaches unprecedented depths. In 2025, this ultra-exclusive project is reborn on the Baloise Session stage: one of only seven European dates in 2025.
tagline: IT'D TAKE ALL THE FUN OUT OF IT IF YOU KNEW EVERYTHING.
title: Queens of the Stone Age - Baloise Session

overview: When Sue begins to lose her words and sense of self to Young-onset dementia, her daughter Jess struggles to connect with the mother she once knew. In a moment of quiet desperation, a song from their past rekindles a spark between them, offering a fleeting yet powerful glimpse of the love that remains.
tagline: A mother’s fading memories threaten her close bond with her daughter - until a familiar melody lights the way back.
title: While It Lasts

original_title: Simply Red - Home: Live in Sicily
overview: With a jazzy band featuring brass instruments, Mick Hucknall, the lead singer of Simply Red, performs his hits in the magical setting of the ancient amphitheater in Taormina. Recorded on July 23, 2003, at the ancient theater in Taormina, Sicily.
title: Simply Red - Home: Live in Sicily

overview: An explosion in the subway takes Rasul's life, leaving his family grieving for his son for 15 long years. However, on Memorial Day, Rasul returns home. The family is shocked - the joy of reunion is mixed with the bitterness of the question “Where have you been all this time?”.  Rasul is evading the question, and each member of his family has their own assumptions about this.

Assigned to a missing person case, reporter Trish Bostwick follows the trail to a secluded asylum hidden in the New England woods, but everything changes when a knife-wielding stranger hijacks her car, plunging her into a descent of paranoia and madness.
title: Where Darkness Dwells

overview: In a small Wisconsin lake town, a poverty-stricken felon contracts Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease after ingesting diseased venison. As his descent into madness intensifies, he targets a Chicago musician and a mysterious singer, whose dream of recording an album together is threatened by the felon's violent unraveling.
tagline: He's starving.
title: Creature Fear

overview: In 2010, two rival Chinese mafia groups wage a hidden war within a silent, fearful immigrant community. As merchants are extorted and women are trafficked, a small family restaurant becomes the unlikely epicentre of the conflict. With the help of Officer Li and wiretaps in Cantonese, prosecutor Diana Belenguer launches a groundbreaking investigation. But when Xu, a mafia soldier, defies his clan to save a young victim, he becomes a target – hunted by his own brother. What begins as a wiretap case spirals into a high-stakes chase through Argentina’s criminal underworld.
title: Street Wanderers

overview: The story follows a family, including three children who are driving their parents out of their minds. One morning, they all wake up inside each other's bodies.
title: A Family Upside Down

overview: At Martina's New Year's Eve party, a young influencer from the Argentine scene, her lifelong but strained friendship with Joaco takes a dramatic turn followed by an unexpected and tragic accident.
tagline: The moment everything breaks.
title: ek • stasis

overview: In a world where art comes to life, a young artist struggles between his grandfather's expectations and his own artistic instincts.
title: Behind The Door

overview: What happens when one man starts seeing everyone’s future? A hilarious socio-fantasy ride filled with chaos, charm, and twists of fate!
title: Chiranjeeva

overview: A noir like no other...
title: The Dirty Nut

original_title: O Retorno da Macabra Biblioteca do Dr. Lucchetti
overview: Vonetta, Helen, and Clayton are back! Inspired by the work of Rubens Francisco Lucchetti, master of Brazilian comics and pulp fiction, these shadowy anti-heroes will have to face new challenges and even the devil himself.
title: O Retorno da Macabra Biblioteca do Dr. Lucchetti

overview: Ruth Wilson is an elderly woman who spent the past forty years alone, crippled with regret. Motivated to end her loneliness, she chooses to make one more effort to reconcile with her estranged daughter, and find a companion to spend the rest of her life with.
tagline: Would you say that you’re alone?
title: Lonely

overview: On the night of a high-profile gallery fundraiser, Noah—a 50-year-old queer painter—prepares to deliver a long-anticipated speech. In the hours before he takes the stage, he confides in Kai, his loyal companion, revisiting the stories behind his most haunting works. Together, they trace the arc of Noah’s life: a childhood scarred by trauma, a volatile relationship with his abusive mother, struggles with addiction, and the ache of a love lost. As the evening deepens, the boundaries between memory and reality begin to dissolve. When Noah finally steps into the spotlight, the weight of his past surges to the surface. Overwhelmed, he slips into a dreamlike trance, a final, surreal descent into the emotional landscape we’ve traversed with him.
title: For Them

overview: Two SFPD detectives unveil a dark secret while investigating a car theft operation.
tagline: The past is ever present.
title: Die by Law

overview: When tap water turns toxic in Cornwall, a public health disaster leads to accusations of a cover-up and the search for the truth. The story of Britain’s biggest mass poisoning.
title: Poison Water

overview: In the 1980s, a boy named Hajduk moves with his family from a small village to the capitol of Yugoslavia, where he's going to start spreading his way of honor and true values.
title: Hajduk in Belgrade

overview: In the moment of her murder, a woman travels through the infinite deaths inside her soul. Shot in stunning black and white with a beautifully haunting original score.
title: The Soul Dies After Midnight

overview: Arthur is a narcissistic young director obsessed with his ambitious science fiction film, in which Platane, an evolved human, faces a conspiracy in a future where everything seems perfect. Miriam, an energetic producer and his best friend, tries to make the project happen, but Arthur sabotages everything and abandons the production. Years later, Miriam becomes a successful director, while Arthur never made his film. Too late, he realizes that what he really lost was her friendship.
title: O Socorro Não Virá

overview: Plagued by anxiety, Gaby retreats to Ema's secluded home for an alternative therapy. What begins as a path to healing soon turns into a disturbing ritual of obedience - leading her into a world where humans behave like domesticated pets.
title: El llanto del perro

overview: After his divorce, Yiğit takes his teenage son Onur on a trip to the lake where he spent his childhood.
title: Eudaimonia

overview: Three brilliant minds unite to crack a code that could revolutionize medicine: Parker Rose, the ambitious mastermind; Avery Lions, the talented newcomer; and Jesse Wilkins, the loyal friend caught in the middle. Their breakthrough promises to save countless lives, but as fame and fortune beckon, so do the shadows of greed and betrayal. Three young lives are forever changed, each forced to grapple with the true cost of ambition, loyalty, and the blurred lines between right and wrong in a world where a single line of code can alter the course of history.
tagline: Stick to the plan, play the game.
title: Left Down Raven Street

overview: Based on stories from Writer/Director Austin Abbott's own book 'I Tried Calling', this film follows three different men in distress across three different times making three different phone calls. The first: A janitor stuck in a church. The second: A sports gambler who made a mistake. The third: A businessman having a bad Christmas Eve.
title: No Need To Worry

overview: Ousmane, a young Senegalese albino, and his mother Aïchata flee their homeland to escape the marginalization and death threats from local sorcerers. They embark on a perilous journey to Europe. Their desert crossing exposes them to constant dangers and the cruel indifference of unscrupulous individuals. At the heart of this odyssey, they discover the depth of the human soul, between compassion and cruelty, forging a path toward light despite the surrounding darkness.
title: Africa Blanca

overview: The film explores a woman's journey to rediscover her ability to scream after a news report about a woman's abduction triggers a disturbing realization about her own lost primal scream.
tagline: Can Holly still scream as loudly as she did when she was a kid?
title: A Loud Piece of Armour

original_title: A Few Good Men From The North
overview: In 1897, Finnish brothers Pietari and Verner Korpi head to the harsh frontier of Minnesota in search of their missing father.
title: A Few Good Men From The North

original_title: How to Find a Career That Loves You Back
overview: Khloe and Joyce, two trans women who work for a defense-technology corporation, fall in love when they're sent to a college career fair together. Their fragile bond forces Khloe to choose between safety and the uncertain path of freedom.
title: How to Find a Career That Loves You Back

overview: The Woman in White wanders through an empty police building where The Guard steals thoughts.
title: Policed Mind

overview: Student filmmaker Sophie accompanies her parents to document her grandfather’s last day in his home before being relocated due to dementia. As she films, she becomes confronted by the ethics of creating work that is too close to home.
title: Tulips

overview: A female humming bird named Papyrus, wanted to explore the world , but her dad doesn't want her to do it. So Papyrus went out on a journey when she came across a male hummingbird named Pico.
tagline: An Adventure, A Musical, A Love Story
title: Papyrus

overview: A strange bug-like creature spins a human’s negative thoughts into a golden thread–until its spinning wheel breaks.
title: The Spinning Wheel

overview: A clever American team competes for first place at France's Mondial du Fromage cheese competition.
title: The Big Cheese

original_title: It's Hard Not to be Romantic About Time Travel
overview: Armed with weed and a half-baked theory that love can bend time, two friends land five years in the past - totally unprepared for what comes next.
tagline: When you can't move on, move backward.
title: It's Hard Not to be Romantic About Time Travel

overview: In 2025, America's wilder and crazier than ever. It will take an epic leader to get society back on track - enter Donald J. Trump (Timothy Banfield). Facing threats from the Deep State, alien invaders, the Megalodon, and the vengeful ghost of Adolf Hitler himself - reincarnated in the guise of a revolution-stoking porcelain doll - the POTUS has really got his hands full. Along with his right-hand robot, the Xterminator (Edson Camacho), Trump meets all the troublemakers head-on, in this follow-up to the wildly polarizing Trump vs. the Illuminati. With the unique brand of pomp and panache everyone's come to expect, things are gonna be tremendous.
title: Mega Trump

overview: Art & Science Collide weaves together compelling stories of artists participating in the Getty’s 2024-2025 Southern California art event, PST ART. Exploring the deep, often overlooked connections between two fields commonly seen as opposites — art and science — the film highlights collaborations between artists and scientists in Southern California to address some of humanity’s most urgent challenges, from climate change and space exploration to biodiversity and environmental justice.
title: Art and Science Collide

overview: 9-year-old Marla is having her first sleepover with her best friend Lola. And even better – despite her Nans reservations, she is having it at her fun-loving Dad’s house. But amidst the freedom and play, she finds something that changes the course of this innocent sleepover and the dynamics of her relationship with her beloved but complicated Dad forever.
title: Sleepover

overview: An encounter between a feared forest creature and an ambitious and curious nature enthusiast takes an unexpected turn.
tagline: What's lurking in the woods?
title: Sighting

overview: Guided by professional hunter Marc Warnke and survival expert Callie Russell, struggling tech entrepreneur Mansal Denton sets out on an eight-day remote wilderness expedition in search of elk, along with answers to some of life’s biggest questions.
title: The Voyage Out

overview: A young entrepreneur navigates a career of increasing success, but the path has not been easy as he constantly faces setbacks by his reckless father along the way.
title: Birthday Cake

overview: A woman loses her arm and is trapped in a surreal game of hide-and-seek to find it. A dark fairytale about reclaiming your power in a world intent on taking it apart.
tagline: HAVE YOU SEEN HER ARM?
title: Sovereign

overview: Cesare Dell'Anna is an Italian trumpeter as talented as he is whimsical. Heir to a family of brass band musicians, he and his group Hotel Albania have launched a musical genre steeped in the rhythms brought by Balkan migrants. During summertime, everything is a pretext for playing music on big stages as well as village squares.
title: The Touring Band

original_title: Something Was in the Tunnels Vol. 2
overview: Takes place 3 minutes before the death of FBI Agent Andy. After his death, Danny Feather, and detective Cotton make it their mission to catch, The Tunnel Killer.
tagline: Let it all burn down
title: Something Was in the Tunnels Vol. 2

overview: Rights advocate Alice Robinson descends into the depths of an aging prison, seeking to interview a mysterious inmate who has seemingly been locked away and forgotten.
title: An Interview with the Devil

overview: Three people come in touch through an application that provides tenderness-on-demand. As the boundaries between the virtual and the real begin to blur, an unexpected connection emerges between them — one that helps them confront their unresolved emotional needs and the mistakes of their past.
title: Tender

overview: A humanistic documentary about the “soul” of the Directors' Fortnight at Cannes, a formidable facilitator, a passionate man thirsty for novelty and the avant-garde: Pierre-Henri Deleau.
title: Deleau: Le cinéma en liberté

overview: At a secret forest hideout, suburban teen Dani meets up with her crush Jayde, only to discover an otherworldly presence has joined them.
title: The Palace

overview: In a crowded seaside town in Malta, Dimitrios drifts through a world of concrete, haunted by a mysterious past and detached from the world around him, until he meets Annie. Like him, she has a child she never sees, has suffered love's disappointments, and lives without freedom or companionship. Fate draws them together, yet circumstances pull them apart.
title: Zafzifa

overview: Two girls from Austin are driven by one's brother to New Orleans, and make a movie along the way.
title: Zucchini

original_title: Terdedah: 7 Artists in Search of a Cover
overview: Shahnon Ahmad's novel Terdedah (1965) has not been reprinted in decades. This rambunctious satire is about a young widow with two lovers. Why hasn't the book been seen for so long? Did it "dedah" (reveal or expose) too much? Amir Muhammad asks seven artists how they would design a cover of Terdedah if it were reprinted today. Through Zoom, they discuss how the novel can be presented visually. In an unfortunate twist, one of the artists disappeared after agreeing. So this artist is replaced by ChatGPT. The six human artists are Anderson Ee, Fahmi Mustaffa, Hannah, Mark Lee See Teck, Syuq Tone and Yante Ismail.
tagline: Revealing conversations about an old novel.
title: Terdedah: 7 Artists in Search of a Cover

overview: Girl power and killer harmonies. Stars from All Saints, Mis-Teeq, Little Mix and more take a trip through the highs and lows of being in a girl band - from adoration to the flip side of fame.
title: Girlbands Forever

overview: 10 year old Claire and her younger brother Kyle try to escape their angry home.
title: Jeggies

overview: Fourteen-year-old Ivan runs away from an orphanage to pursue his dream at a pioneer camp he learned about on the news. Arriving there incognito, he creates an entire media organization within an already entrenched system, without which internal order cannot exist. Ivan's following is so large that government officials responsible for public opinion listen to him. He creates an entire news empire that tells only the truth. However, he has no idea that he is the heir to a huge media corporation, one that he thought was being coveted by people very close to him.
title: Ты не один

overview: A Bulgarian woman, Sophia, goes through a heavy drama while divorcing her husband in Norway, who reports her to the child social welfare service Barnevernet, who place their kids in foster families. She's forced to restrain her hypersensitive personality in order to fit in a foreign society and win back her kids.
title: Good Parents

original_title: The Dog in the Long Grass
overview: Haunted by a glimpse of Death in the form of a black dog, a man embarks on a desperate search across the Sussex landscape to ask a single, unanswered question.
title: The Dog in the Long Grass

original_title: The Assassination of Michael D. Higgins
overview: On his final shift, a worn-down hospital employee decides to indulge a patient's fantasy that he is the president of Ireland.
title: The Assassination of Michael D. Higgins

overview: A yearly family photo inflates into a big old mess.
tagline: A family tradition that's full of hot air
title: PICTURE DAY

overview: Miura, an aging ex-yakuza, develops an unexpected bond with Kota, a blind orphan. As they grow closer like family, Miura learns that Kota's sight can be restored with surgery. Determined to help, he steals money from his former yakuza group and leaves it for Kota before turning himself in. 12 years later, Miura is released from prison. Upon learning this, the yakuza plans to kill both Miura and Kota. Miura sacrifices himself to protect Kota, and...
title: A Light in the Harbor

overview: Diego Kiai, a legendary 1980s world karate champion, receives a mysterious call from an old rival he believes he defeated, challenging him to a final fight to see who is the true winner. Diego Kiai, the Argentine Samurai, is the story of an old karate glory who fell into oblivion and fights against the passage of time.
title: Diego Kiai, el samurái argentino

overview: After 18 years in the underground music scene, Individual Distortion sets his sights on Indonesia's most prestigious music awards. Determined to be acknowledged, he navigates the complexities of the music industry, confronting challenges that test his identity and aspirations.
title: A Distorted Individual

original_title: Deux personnes échangeant de la salive
overview: In a society where kissing is punishable by death, and people pay for things by receiving slaps to the face, Angine, an unhappy woman, shops compulsively in a department store. There, she becomes fascinated by a playful salesgirl. Despite the prohibition of kissing, the two become close, raising the suspicions of a jealous colleague.
title: Two People Exchanging Saliva

overview: In a sterile audition room, Elias Grimwood stakes everything on his final shot at fame. As he performs, reality slips away. The female judge morphs into a sinister figure, her cryptic taunts driving him deeper into paranoia. What begins as a desperate plea for success spirals into a nightmarish breakdown, where ambition collides with madness. The Audition is a pulse-pounding psychological thriller about obsession, delusion, and the deadly cost of chasing your dreams.
tagline: Every dream has a price…
title: The Audition

overview: After forty years of radio silence, Sol meets his old friend Dicky to clear an incident from the past. Time is precious, as Dicky's death is scheduled for tomorrow.
title: Koffie in Lourdes

overview: Private cook Lai solves her clients' problems but struggles with her husband. Secretly learning to drive becomes her anchor. On her first road lesson, a small change unsettles her life.
title: Her Slope

overview: A policeman injured in the line of duty recovers at home, unaware that the nurse sent to take care of him is the girlfriend of the criminal he just put away for life.
title: Bitter Desire

overview: In an isolated 18th-century Estonian village, Elo struggles to survive in a community that offers her neither safety nor kindness.
title: Eyes of the Forest

overview: Hi, it's Anthony DeVito. Maybe you'll like what I made. For about 45 minutes I go on and on with jokes and stories about being poor, being a child, becoming an uncle, having a mom, climate change, Obama, reparations, the police, being middle aged, Gen Z, Stitch Fix, the insurrection and more! The whole special cost about $7000. And I don’t exactly have $7000 I can just throw around. My mom does need a new rack. So if you feel so inclined to throw me a couple shekels, here’s how you can do that.
title: Anthony DeVito: Straight Hoopin

original_title: Salute to Service 2025: A Veterans Day Celebration
overview: Country music legend Trace Adkins joins the U.S. Army Field Band to host "Salute to Service 2025: A Veterans Day Celebration." Featuring unforgettable performances by opera superstar Angel Blue, jazz vocalist Kurt Elling, and Trace Adkins himself.
title: Salute to Service 2025: A Veterans Day Celebration

overview: When a friend goes missing during a weekend getaway, Frank sets out to find the truth behind the disappearance, only to learn that the truth runs deeper than he could’ve imagined.
title: The Missing Part

overview: Efficiently known as the "Rasta Lawyer" or "Poor People's Lawyer," Diane Jobson has spent her life fighting for the fundamental rights of the poor in the ghetto. Now in her 80s, Diane reflects on a life devoted to defending the marginalised of Jamaica, while preparing to retire on her own terms. Between weekends with her best friend Sally, clouds of ganja smoke, and candid, wry observations about aging, Diane emerges as a rebel soul to the end. A terrible driver, a tireless advocate, and a woman who will never stop living fully.
title: Miss Jobson

overview: Brussels. During a night of concert in a huge cinema which has closed its doors for the night, 5 characters, among the public, remember an atrocious episode of their past life.
title: All the time

overview: Teresa Pla, an intersex individual assigned female at birth, navigates the rigid Spanish society of the early-mid 20th century while facing persecution for living as a man from guerrillas, bandits, and civil guards.
title: Els Mals Noms

overview: A remote town is plagued by a dark and twisted figure cloaked in tradition, turning cheer into terror. This psychological horror blends folklore, fear, and survival in a chilling new tale.
title: Santa-N the Red Awakening

overview: Lifelong best friends Queenie and Marcel have always kept it strictly platonic until a wild night celebrating Queenie's art debut lands them in bed together. Now they must navigate blurred lines for an unexpected chance at something more.
title: Friend Zone

tagline: Helping Others May Hurt You
title: Make Yourself at Home

overview: Neuroatypical extroverted Australian Andy charms the introverted elite of the “Happiest Country in the World” and talks himself into teaching at Aalto University in Helsinki. His achievements are praised and Andy acts as the spearhead of Finnish educational projects in Africa, refugee camps in the Middle East and even the Nevada desert for the Burning Man festival. At the peak of his career representing Finland in the Netherlands, Andy is attacked. A head injury causes PTSD and the deal is done. Almost everything possible in the Finnish healthcare system goes wrong and Andy falls through the safety nets of the Nordic welfare state into a “black hole.” Andy receives a bewildering number of different F-code diagnoses and eventually ends up in a closed ward, holding the unofficial world record for the most different F-code diagnoses given to one person.
tagline: When your personal life collapses and you discover that you hold the unofficial World Record in F-illness codes, at least you have a great story to tell!
title: The AlphabetMan

overview: Scientists create Epsilon to control nature, but it awakens and fights back.
title: Red Harvest

overview: A lonely teenage writer photographs strangers with his Polaroid camera, characterising those in each picture. When he re-encounters an eccentric girl whom he photographed earlier that day, his world is turned on its head.
title: Strangers

overview: Underscore is a meditative two-hander following grandfather Aodhán and granddaughter Laoise as they face the end of the world. Instead of hellfire and brimstone, it seems that their environment is collapsing on a micro-level. The very fabric of reality is mutating into something new.
tagline: The world is ending. But not in the way you might expect.
title: Underscore

overview: José Rosado, a U.S. citizen of Puerto Rican descent, flies to Madrid from Miami in 2021 for business and dinner with a friend. He stays at the luxurious Hotel Palace. He is married to a man but has an open relationship. After dinner, he decides to go out for drinks in the Chueca neighborhood, where he meets two other men and returns to his room with them. The next day, hotel staff find José Rosado dead in his bed. Natural causes?
title: Muerte en el hotel

overview: Still grieving her father’s death, Samira meets Michio, a tourist staying at her hotel, who has come to Stockholm to retrace the final steps of his late daughter.
tagline: Where loss meets connection.
title: Fish Out of Water

overview: Once a beloved playmate of her childhood, Markku had withdrawn into solitude, devoting his life to inner freedom and creativity rather than the expectations of society. Now his voice returns – sometimes playful, sometimes wounded, always searching – guiding Karin through his life’s work and opening space for an unusual collaboration between the living and the dead.
title: Days of Wonder

overview: Traces a family’s journey toward freedom, nurturing their bees and their young sons amid Georgia’s shifting seasons while they learn to care for the land that sustains them.
title: The Boys and the Bees

overview: Unemployed and restless, Semanur stumbles on a strange online hustle. But when her mother’s feet spark unexpected demand, she exploits her without consent—crossing into unsettling moral territory in a darkly ironic tale of self-commodification.
title: Happy Feet

overview: The incredible story behind the phone hacking scandal that shook Rupert Murdoch’s media empire that follows the small group of determined journalists and police officers who uncovered one of the biggest cover-ups in modern British media history. Featuring exclusive access and surprising new interviews with key figures—some speaking for the first time—it traces the trail of evidence that led from a single suspicious story to a scandal that reached the highest levels of power. As the truth emerged, it brought about a reckoning for the world’s most powerful media mogul, culminating in what became known as “the most humble day” of his life.
title: The Real Hack

overview: Between historic achievements, injuries, doubts and personal challenges, She Who Flies delves into the heart of the journey of an athlete who has become one of the most creative and accomplished figures in world freeskiing.
tagline: Mathilde Gremaud: the meteoric rise of a freeski champion.
title: She Who Flies: Mathilde Gremaud

overview: At a New Year's Eve party, wealthy businessman Bajwa bets $30 million that idealist Ahesaan Randhawa can't endure 15 years in a self-made jail. Ahesaan accepts, facing intense trials while Bajwa's life falls apart.
tagline: If you attempt to correct your past with a gun, your future could destroy you with a tank.
title: Sentence of 15

overview: Brothers struggle to find a way to express caring in a world where platonic love between men is often overshadowed by hypermasculinity.
title: How to Tell You, Brother

original_title: The Moonies: Married to the Cult
overview: The Unification Church, better known as the ‘Moonies’, promised peace and unity through matchmaking and spectacular mass weddings. But behind the smiles lay a darker reality: billions in global assets, families torn apart, and cult-like control. Now former insiders dare to speak out, including Reverend Moon’s illegitimate son Sam, telling his shocking story for the first time.
title: The Moonies: Married to the Cult

overview: A story about Edith and Arthur Thistle – for fifty-three years, they have managed to get by—never rich, never extravagant, but always together. That all changes in an instant when they win fourteen million pounds in the lottery. Arthur dreams of spending big, finally tasting the high life. But before the celebrations can begin, Edith drops a bombshell: she wants a divorce. Big Winners is about opportunity, who gets to seize the day and who gets left behind. A thrilling, funny, deeply emotional exploration of lives lived, and lives missed.
title: Big Winners

overview: A man watches a soothing ASMR video to help him sleep, but the voice meant to calm him soon reveals a chilling connection to his past.
title: Tingling

original_title: 大パルコ人⑤オカタイロックオペラ「雨の傍聴席、おんなは裸足…」
title: 大パルコ人⑤オカタイロックオペラ「雨の傍聴席、おんなは裸足…」

overview: Following the death of her family dog, Emma finds herself at a crossroads where grief and release play together: a midlife awakening is now in full throttle, and those closest to Emma feel the impact, including her best friend Stan  and her rambunctious daughter Maggie. To make matters more complicated and ripe for comedic mishaps, Emma's estranged ex-husband Andy returns to the city from Singapore down on his professional luck and aiming to rekindle things with his lost love.
tagline: They never really leave us.
title: All That We Love

overview: A documentary exploring Saudi Arabia's hidden film culture, following movie lovers who grew up without theaters in the 1980s and uncovering the nation's pre-1979 cinematic history through pioneers who kept their passion alive.
title: Anti-Cinema

overview: In order to save her young teammate from the bloody expectations of their coach, baton twirler Emma must confront her own insecurities in the middle of an important competition.
tagline: MAKE THE CUT
title: Majorette

overview: The events in this Altai epic take place in the 19th century. It is a story about greed and desire for revenge which can ruin the life of a person as well as entire families and generations. A common lad Tokna is in love with beautiful Kymyskai. But a well-to-do 40-year-old bachelor Kutus has set his eyes on her. Relying on his standing and traditions he kidnaps the girl. Naturally, she does not want to live with him and one day runs away to Tokna. The lovers hide in the mountains. After some time Kymyskai, who harbors a grudge against them, finds Tokna and Kykuskai and starts taking revenge. He kills the cow, family’s breadwinner. In response Tokna and his nephew eliminate half of the Kutus family sheep. Thus hostility turns into hatred and misunderstanding develops into a war of extermination.
title: Wolves

overview: In the pursuit of chasing her dreams, a young dancer must choose between her passion and the very roof over her head before reality takes its toll...
title: (Almost) A Star

overview: Ivy is a Gen Z private eye. She vapes. She takes Jell-O shots. And this next case might be her last.
title: Pinku

overview: Set in the rustic heart of northern Gujarat, Kundaalu (Circle) captures the harsh beauty of rural life where tradition reigns supreme and marriage defines destiny. Amid this unyielding world, Mangu, a destitute orphan, and Vikas, a spirited man burdened by a speech impediment, find a fragile connection, only to be separated by fate's cruelty. Their intertwined lives reflect a haunting portrait of love, loss, and resilience within a society that hears neither their voices nor their pain.
title: Kundaalu

overview: They quietly and selflessly work for the wellbeing of humanity, investing their efforts and talents in the realm of science and technology. What binds them is an invisible net of bright minds, which emerged from the academy of the renowned physics teacher Theodosiy Theodosiev. They are the socially strong people of Bulgaria who are building the future of the world.
title: Those to Whom Much is Given

overview: Four men gather for cards and cognac after the death of a close friend. What begins as a fellowship becomes raw confessions of infidelity, betrayal, guilt, and loss, forcing each man to speak their truth while strengthening their brotherhood.
title: Cards & Cognac

overview: A porn actress stars in the Devil’s cannibal snuff films in exchange for flawless skin. While luring a runaway bride to the studio to devour her on camera, she begins to develop feelings that will disrupt the Devil’s script.
title: Skin Flick

overview: Caught between three Christmas proposals, a businesswoman's fairy godmother whisks her through the past, present, and future, revealing that true love might be closer than she thinks.
title: Marry Me Christmas

overview: A woman's quiet routines begin to fray as the unseen weight of external unrest presses in, blurring the line between interior calm and a mysterious collapse.
title: Pin

overview: Max is unsatisfied with the mundanity of his town in which no person has ever left. But when Max discovers a black hole that seemingly leads to "the outside" his life is turned upside down at the imminent possibility of escape.
title: Black Hole

overview: A documentary that tells the extraordinary true story of how a lesbian bookseller (who also happened to be trans) created the largest gathering of LGBTQ+ women in the UK, and how from 1998 to 2008, the quietly conservative city of York became the unlikely centre of all things lesbian! For one thrilling decade, thousands of women flocked to the York Lesbian Arts Festival (YLAF) each autumn, to meet their favourite authors, buy books, hear top female artists live on stage and dance the night away at the ‘disco of a thousand lesbians.’
title: 3000 Lesbians Go To York
